Across 13 datasets it consistently improves the clean-robust trade-off. On eight fine-grained datasets, mean clean+adversarial accuracy rises from 65.7% to 71.4% for counterattack defenses and 68.4% to 73.2% for noise-anchoring; on ImageNet and four shifted variants, from 56.1% to 66.2% and 62.1% to 67.6%.

</details>


### [163] [Dream.exe: Can Video Generation Models Dream Executable Robot Manipulation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04811)
*Rui Zhao,Kaiming Yang,Jifeng Zhu,Siyang Chen,Ziqi Wang,Weijia Wu,Kevin Qinghong Lin,Heng Wang,Mike Zheng Shou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Dream.exe是一个评估视频生成模型物理世界理解能力的框架，通过将生成视频转化为机器人可执行轨迹并在物理模拟器中验证，揭示了视觉质量与物理可执行性之间的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽能合成视觉上令人信服的内容，但缺乏衡量其是否真正理解物理世界的标准。作者提出通过机器人操作任务作为具体、可量化的评估窗口，检验模型生成的视频运动是否能在真实物理环境中执行。

Method: 提出Dream.exe评估框架，包含视频到执行的流水线：给定场景图像和任务描述，合成操作视频，将生成的运动转换为机器人轨迹，在物理模拟器中执行。涵盖3个物理复杂度级别的101个操作任务，评估8个模型（闭源生成器、开源生成器、机器人专用模型）。

Result: 多个模型实现了可衡量的执行成功率，表明从互联网数据中学习的生成先验已编码了有意义的物理知识；但视觉质量与可执行性之间相关性弱，表明标准视觉评估无法捕获模型能力的这一维度。

Conclusion: 视频生成模型已蕴含一定物理知识，但视觉质量不等于物理可执行性，Dream.exe提供了超越纯视觉指标的评估新维度。

Abstract: Video generation models have made impressive strides in synthesizing visually compelling content, yet their outputs remain confined to the virtual domain. A natural question follows: how well do these models reflect the physical world when their generated videos leave the screen and enter reality? We propose robotic manipulation as a concrete, measurable window onto this question: if a model has truly internalized physical laws, the motion it depicts should translate into executable robot behavior. We introduce Dream$.$exe, an evaluation framework that operationalizes this criterion through a video-to-execution pipeline. Given a scene image and a task description, Dream$.$exe synthesizes a manipulation video, converts the generated motion into robot trajectories, and executes them in a physics simulator, yielding a grounding signal that purely visual metrics cannot offer. Using this pipeline, we evaluate 8 models spanning frontier closed-source generators, open-source generators, and robot-specific models. Our benchmark covers 101 manually curated manipulation tasks at three levels of physical complexity, measured across visual quality, trajectory fidelity, and execution success. Encouragingly, several models achieve measurable execution success, suggesting that generative priors learned from internet-scale data already encode meaningful physical knowledge. Yet visual quality proves a poor predictor of executability, exposing a dimension of model capability that standard visual evaluations do not capture. Dream$.$exe will be open-sourced at https://github.com/showlab/Dream.exe.

</details>

### [164] [Bio-plausible Neuromorphic Disturbance Observer Based on Emulation Theory: Extended Version](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05189)
*Hongfu Xu,Xiaoyu Guo,Shengbo Wang,Shuo Gao*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种神经形态干扰观测器与控制框架，使用脉冲时间编码替代传统连续时间信号处理，通过整合-发放神经元动力学构建干扰估计和控制输入，并引入基于尖峰频率适应的自适应阈值触发机制。仿真表明该方法具有神经启发的鲁棒性和适应性，且自适应阈值方案在噪声条件下将尖峰事件减少至固定阈值方案的42.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物神经系统通过稀疏、事件驱动的尖峰信息处理和自适应调节，在不确定环境中展现出卓越的鲁棒性和适应性，受此启发，本文旨在开发一种类脑的神经形态控制框架。

Method: 采用整合-发放(IF)神经元动力学通过离散尖峰事件构建干扰估计和控制输入，实现内在的事件驱动更新；并借鉴尖峰频率适应(SFA)机制设计自适应阈值触发机制，实现基于历史依赖的尖峰生成调节。

Result: 所提框架实现了神经启发的鲁棒性和适应性；在噪声条件下，自适应阈值尖峰方案将尖峰事件数量降低至固定阈值方案的42.6%。

Conclusion: 神经形态计算方法可有效应用于控制领域，事件驱动的尖峰通信和自适应阈值机制能在保持性能的同时大幅降低计算和通信开销。

Abstract: Biological neural systems achieve remarkable robustness and adaptability in uncertain environments through sparse, event-driven spike-based information processing and adaptive regulation. Inspired by this paradigm, this paper develops a neuromorhpic disturbance observer (NDO) and control framework that replaces conventional continuous-time signal representations with spike-timing encoding. Both disturbance estimates and control inputs are constructed via integrate-and-fire (IF) neuron dynamics from discrete spike events, yielding intrinsically event-driven updates. An adaptive-threshold triggering mechanism is inspired by spike-frequency adaptation (SFA), enabling history-dependent regulation of spike generation. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves neurally inspired robustness and adaptability, while the adaptive-threshold spiking scheme reduces spike events to 42.6% of the fixed-threshold case under noisy conditions.

</details>


### [165] [Ontology-constrained multi-LLM scoring of hypothesis support in the predictive processing literature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05206)
*Hamed Nejat,Alexander Maier,Jesse Spencer-Smith,André M. Bastos*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于本地多LLM委员会的文献合成流水线，通过本体约束的提示工程将预测编码神经科学中36个概念（分为三个假说）映射到31项研究的证据空间，利用假设空间温度等几何指标量化跨研究的一致性与分歧，尤其在局部与全局oddball范式中发现了结构化差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨学科领域（如预测编码神经科学）因方法多样、理论承诺繁杂而存在严重的文献碎片化问题，传统元分析缺乏统一的比较空间，难以综合来自计算理论、电生理、成像、行为学与建模的异构证据。

Method: 构建本地多LLM工作流：1) 读取论文并提取证据（含图表描述）；2) 使用专家定义的36个概念（分属预测抑制、前向误差传播、普遍性三个假说）的术语表构建约束提示；3) 十个本地语言模型组成委员会，在局部与全局oddball背景下对31项研究逐项评分（同意/不同意）；4) 进行配对研究一致性分析、跨模型比较和三维假设空间映射；5) 定义假设空间温度（几何分散度指标）量化研究在假设空间中的紧凑程度。

Result: 某些假说的一致性较高，另一些则较弱，揭示了结构化分歧，尤其在局部与全局oddball范式之间。局部oddball情境下的假设空间温度更低（研究更紧凑），全局oddball情境下温度更高（分散度更大）。评分几何还可估算实验情境之间的变化向量。

Conclusion: 本地多LLM委员会能够产生可审计的不一致性度量，将异质性文献映射到定量证据空间。该框架可推广至传统元分析缺乏共同比较空间的跨研究假说映射场景。

Abstract: Fragmentation is common in interdisciplinary fields with diverse methods and theoretical commitments. Predictive coding neuroscience is a clear example: its literature spans computational theory, electrophysiology, imaging, behavior, and modeling, creating a synthesis problem that conventional meta-analysis cannot easily resolve. Here, we describe a local multi-LLM pipeline for ontology-constrained literature synthesis. The pipeline reads papers, extracts evidence, incorporates figure descriptions, assembles constrained prompts, and validates outputs against an expert glossary. We manually defined a predictive-coding glossary of thirty-six concepts grouped into three hypotheses: predictive suppression, feedforward error propagation, and ubiquity. A council of ten local language models scored 31 studies according to their agreement or disagreement with each glossary factor across local and global oddball contexts. This enabled pairwise study-agreement analysis, cross-model comparison, and three-dimensional hypothesis-space mapping. Agreement was high for some hypotheses but weaker for others, revealing structured disagreement, particularly across local versus global oddball paradigms. We further define hypothesis-space temperature, a geometric dispersion metric measuring how compactly studies occupy the hypothesis space. Temperature was lower for local oddball contexts and higher for global oddball contexts, indicating greater dispersion in the latter. The scoring geometry also allowed us to estimate vectors of change between experimental contexts. These results demonstrate that local multi-LLM councils can produce auditable disagreement measurements that map heterogeneous literatures into quantitative evidence spaces. This framework may generalize to cross-study hypothesis mapping where conventional meta-analysis lacks a common comparison space.

</details>


### [166] [Cross-scale spatially-aware generative modeling of transcriptomic programs underlying neurodegenerative brain organization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05870)
*Krishnakumar Vaithianathan*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种跨尺度的空间感知生成框架，利用变分生成架构和空间平滑正则化，将区域转录组特征与阿尔茨海默病的皮质退行性变模式联系起来，实现了高精度的预测（R²=0.8604，空间相关r=0.9439），揭示了分子组织与宏观神经退行性变之间的结构化转录组程序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有成像-转录组学研究多依赖相关性分析，难以建模分子组织如何驱动神经退行性变的空间选择性；需要一种能够跨尺度建模分子组织与神经退行性变因果关系的生成式框架。

Method: 从Allen人脑图谱提取910个标志基因在68个皮质区域的转录组谱；从ADNI数据计算认知正常组与AD组皮质厚度差异构建退行性变易感性图；采用变分生成架构学习潜在生物学程序，并结合图空间平滑正则化约束以保留皮质空间组织。

Result: 模型解释了86.04%的退行性变方差，预测与观察的皮质退变轮廓空间相关系数达0.9439（p<0.001）；潜在表征揭示了与疾病易感性相关的结构化转录组组织。

Conclusion: 生物学约束的生成式建模能够桥接微观分子组织与宏观神经退行性变，为空间感知的生成神经生物学和计算神经科学奠定基础。

Abstract: Neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer's disease exhibit highly organized patterns of regional brain vulnerability, yet the biological mechanisms underlying this spatial selectivity remain incompletely understood. Existing imaging-transcriptomic studies have largely relied on correlation-based analyses between gene expression and neuroimaging phenotypes, limiting their ability to model how molecular organization gives rise to neurodegeneration. Here, we introduce a cross-scale spatially-aware generative framework for modeling transcriptomic programs underlying cortical neurodegeneration. Regional transcriptomic profiles were derived from the Allen Human Brain Atlas using 910 landmark genes across 68 cortical regions. Neurodegenerative vulnerability maps were constructed from ADNI FreeSurfer cortical thickness measurements by computing regional cortical thinning differences between cognitively normal controls (NC = 926) and Alzheimer's disease subjects (AD = 426). A variational generative architecture was used to learn latent biological programs linking regional gene-expression organization to cortical degeneration while incorporating graph-based spatial smoothness regularization to preserve cortical organization. The proposed framework achieved strong prediction of regional neurodegenerative vulnerability, yielding an explained variance of 0.8604 and a significant spatial correlation between predicted and observed cortical degeneration profiles (r = 0.9439, p < 0.001). The learned latent representations revealed structured transcriptomic organization associated with distributed disease susceptibility. These findings demonstrate that biologically constrained generative modeling can bridge microscale molecular organization with macroscale neurodegeneration, providing a foundation for spatially-aware generative neurobiology and computational neuroscience.

</details>


### [167] [Early psychosis shows deviations in scaling behaviour within a critical regime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06290)
*Irem Topal,Paola Moreno Ancalmo,Guillermo Montana Valverde,Philipp Homan,Wolfram Hinzen*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文通过整合现象学重整化群（PRG）、功率谱密度（PSD）和去趋势波动分析（DFA），发现早期精神病患者的大脑静息态活动并未丧失临界态动力学，而是在保留的标度区间内发生了集体动力学的系统性重组。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有证据表明大脑活动表现出近临界态的尺度不变动力学，且精神病学中临界性相关测量存在改变，但不同标度测量是否捕捉到了大规模脑动力学的共同改变尚不清楚。

Method: 结合现象学重整化群（PRG）框架、功率谱密度（PSD）和去趋势波动分析（DFA），对早期精神病患者和健康对照组的静息态fMRI数据进行多尺度标度特性分析。

Result: 健康对照组表现出与临界态组织一致的非平凡标度行为；早期精神病组保留了相同的尺度不变组织总体现象学，但多个观测量的标度指数发生系统性偏移。

Conclusion: 早期精神病并非简单地丧失临界态动力学，而是在保留的标度区间内发生了集体动力学的重组；结合粗粒化方法与时间标度分析为研究精神疾病的脑动力学提供了原则性框架。

Abstract: Accumulating evidence suggests that large-scale brain activity exhibits scale-invariant dynamics consistent with operation in a near-critical regime. Such dynamics have been associated with long-range correlations, efficient information processing, and the emergence of collective organization. While altered criticality-related measures have been reported in psychiatric disorders, previous findings remain fragmented across observables and modalities, making it unclear whether different scaling measures capture a common alteration of large-scale brain dynamics. Here, we investigated scaling properties in resting-state fMRI data from individuals with early psychosis and healthy controls. We combined a phenomenological renormalization group (PRG) framework with power spectral density (PSD) and detrended fluctuation analysis (DFA) to characterize collective dynamics across scales. In healthy controls, resting-state activity exhibited non-trivial scaling behavior consistent with critical-like organization. Early psychosis participants showed the same overall phenomenology of scale-invariant organization, but with systematic shifts in scaling exponents across multiple observables. These findings indicate that early psychosis is not characterized by a simple loss of critical-like dynamics, but rather by a reorganization of collective dynamics within a preserved scaling regime. More broadly, our results suggest that combining coarse-graining approaches with temporal scaling analyses provides a principled framework for studying large-scale brain dynamics in psychiatric disorders.

</details>


### [168] [Intrinsic Computational Functionalism: From Observer-Relative Maps to Observer-Independent Structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06424)
*Shuqin Ma,Ryota Kanai*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出内在计算功能主义（intrinsic computational functionalism），认为如果意识由计算构成，则必须依赖于系统自身内在实现的计算结构，而非外部观察者赋予的标签。作者提出两个操作化标准（系统内在实例化、因果-动力学组织）和一个三层分析框架（标签选择、分区选择、粒度选择），论证只有通过第三层（动力学内在粒度选择）识别的计算属性才能避免外部观察者相对性反驳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反计算论证表明外部强加的计算解释不能奠基意识，但并未证明所有计算组织都是观察者相对的。本文旨在发展一种内在计算功能主义，说明存在一种观察者独立的计算属性能够支撑意识。

Method: 提出两个操作化标准：(C1)系统内在实例化——属性无需观察者标签即可被指定，且在保持结构的变量重标号下不变；(C2)因果-动力学组织——属性基于状态空间结构，其变量相互约束，且在干预下有反事实响应。构建三层识别工作分解：标签选择（层i）、理论约束的分区选择（层ii）、动力学内在粒度选择（层iii），论证只有层iii可避免观察者相对性。

Result: 语法非语义论证、地图绘制者论证以及生物自然主义中关于观察者相对性的反驳，仅对将意识相关属性定位于层（i）的观点有效。区分三层后，内在计算功能主义可以存活下来。

Conclusion: 内在计算功能主义为计算意识理论提供了不受观察者相对性反驳影响的理论框架，但并未指定哪些内在结构承载经验，这为后续经验研究留下了空间。

Abstract: Anti-computational arguments show that externally imposed computational interpretations cannot ground consciousness, but they do not establish that all computational organisations are observer-relative. We develop intrinsic computational functionalism: the view that, if consciousness is computationally constituted, it depends on physically realised computational structures the system has in virtue of itself rather than on labels imposed by an external interpreter. Two criteria operationalise this view. (C1) System-intrinsic instantiation: the relevant property must be specifiable without an observer's labelling, and invariant under structure-preserving relabellings of the system's variables. (C2) Causal-dynamical organisation under intervention: the property must be grounded in a state-space structure whose variables mutually constrain one another, and whose organisation is exhibited in counterfactual response under intervention. Together these criteria specify what any candidate computational account must satisfy to remain observer-independent, without selecting which intrinsic structures bear on experience. The argumentative core is a three-tier decomposition of identification work: interpreter-relative label selection (tier i), theoretically constrained partition selection (tier ii), and dynamics-internal grain selection (tier iii). We argue that any computational property capable of avoiding the observer-relativity objection must be identified, if at all, through tier (iii) dynamics-internal grain selection, conditional on empirically disciplined tier (ii) choices. Syntax-is-not-semantics arguments, mapmaker arguments, and the observer-relativity component of biological-naturalist objections succeed against views that locate the consciousness-relevant property at tier (i); once the tiers are distinguished, intrinsic computational functionalism survives.

</details>


### [169] [Dynamical incompatibilities in paced finger tapping experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23661)
*Ariel D. Silva,Claudia R. González,Rodrigo Laje*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本研究通过实验和理论证明，节拍手指敲击任务中对步进变化和相位偏移两种扰动类型的反应之所以存在矛盾，是因为不同实验条件下积累的时间上下文不同导致动态系统不兼容；当在同一实验中随机呈现两种扰动时，反应变得兼容，可由单一机制解释，挑战了传统上认为不同扰动类型激活不同相位和周期校正过程的观点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决感觉运动同步文献中关于步进变化和相位偏移两种周期扰动类型反应存在根本性矛盾的长期争议。

Method: 通过对比实验设计（分别记录与同一实验内随机呈现两种扰动）结合理论分析，检验两种扰动类型反应是否兼容于单一动力学系统。

Result: 两种扰动类型在分开实验中记录时动态不兼容，无法由单一动力学系统描述；但在同一实验中随机呈现时，反应变得兼容，可由单一机制解释。

Conclusion: 单一底层动力学系统可表征所有扰动类型、符号和大小的反应，但受时间上下文校准；挑战了相位与周期校正过程分别激活的传统观点。

Abstract: Paced finger-tapping tasks are used to probe the error correction mechanism underlying sensorimotor synchronization. Despite their century-long history, fundamental contradictions persist in the literature. One such contradiction arises when comparing the two most common types of period perturbation: step change and phase shift. The stimulus sequence is exactly the same up to and including the (unexpected) perturbed stimulus. Why then would the timing of the next response be different between perturbation types, as observed? We show, both experimentally and theoretically, that responses to both types of perturbation are dynamically incompatible when recorded in separate experiments; that is, they cannot be described by a single underlying dynamical system due to the build-up of different temporal contexts. In contrast, when both types of perturbation are presented randomly within the same experiment, the responses become compatible and can be explained by a single mechanism. We conclude that a single underlying dynamical system can represent the response to all perturbation types, signs, and sizes, which is nevertheless calibrated by temporal context. Our results challenge the established idea of phase and period correction processes that are separately activated for different perturbation types.

</details>


### [170] [Contextual Role Modulates Object Representational Geometry in the Human Brain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23111)
*Julien Dirani,Shankar Chawla,Leila Wehbe,Bradford Z. Mahon*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 通过自然观影fMRI实验，发现人脑中的物体表征会根据情境角色（被动场景元素vs主动行为目标）动态重映射：目标物体激活顶叶动作网络并按动作属性组织，被动物体激活枕颞视觉网络并按语义组织，而视觉表征结构保持跨情境不变性，表明灵活性与不变性在同一表征系统的不同层级运作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究大脑如何在自然情境下，当同一物体在不同语境角色（被动场景元素 vs 主动行为目标）中转换时，动态重映射物体表征。

Method: 使用功能磁共振成像（fMRI）记录被试观看自然电影时的脑活动，分析同一物体作为被动场景元素与作为目标导向行为目标时的神经表征差异。

Result: 1）行为目标激活顶叶动作网络（缘上回、中央后回），被动物体激活枕颞视觉网络；2）情境选择性网络中呈现双重分离：目标物体按动作可供性和手姿可供性组织，被动物体按语义维度组织；3）视觉表征结构跨情境保持不变；4）网络外表征内容保持不变性。

Conclusion: 物体表征会根据情境角色的实时变化发生神经重映射，灵活性（情境依赖的组织方式）与不变性（视觉表征结构）在同一表征系统的不同层级共存运作。

Abstract: The human brain represents objects in a way that is both invariant across instances and flexible enough to support different contexts and tasks. Yet it remains unknown how object representations are dynamically remapped as the same object shifts across contextual roles. Using fMRI during naturalistic movie viewing we investigated how the same objects are represented when they are passive scene elements versus targets of goal-directed actions. Action targets engaged a parietal action network centered in the supramarginal and postcentral gyri, while passive objects recruited a distributed occipito-temporal network involved in visual object recognition. Within context-selective networks, representational geometry showed a double dissociation: target objects were organized by action affordance and hand posture affordance dimensions, while passive objects aligned with semantic dimensions. Visual representational structure was invariant to context. Outside these networks, representational content retained invariance, indicating that flexibility and invariance operate at different levels of the same representational system. These findings demonstrate neural remapping of object representations depending on moment-to-moment changes in contextual roles during a naturalistic scene.

</details>

### [171] [The Evaluation Blind Spot: A Stereological Theory of Benchmark Coverage for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05169)
*Jason Z Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了LLM基准测试覆盖的体视学理论，揭示了基准测试维度、结构盲区和排名不稳定性的定量关系，并给出了最优子集选择和 Gardner 问题 1.5 的独立理论贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM基准测试缺乏系统性的覆盖理论，无法量化基准测试的维度、结构盲区及其对排名可靠性的影响，需要一种几何/体视学框架来刻画基准测试的能力覆盖。

Method: 提出基于可见Hausdorff距离的体视学理论框架，结合有效维数d_eff刻画基准覆盖；通过交叉验证分析三个独立排行榜的维度特征；采用子模贪心算法（Nemhauser (1-1/e)保证）选择基准子集；利用卡方投影模型模拟先验分布对排名稳定性的影响；并通过反事实验证评估特征结构对评价可替代性的预测能力。独立地，利用S^(D-1)上的最优恢复理论解决了Gardner Problem 1.5，给出了C^2支撑函数下的极小极大率。

Result: (1) 三个排行榜的d_eff均在[2.86, 4.80]区间；(2) 结构盲区比排行榜亚军分差大两个数量级，是统计噪声的52-127倍；(3) 不同先验下前两名模型排名互换率稳定在[0.38, 0.49]；(4) 500次可见/保留随机划分中92%的试验发生排名翻转，平均2.83/5的top-5模型发生变化；(5) 4个基准即构成稳定核心，7/12的基准即可覆盖90%能力；(6) 特征结构能预测不可替代评价(rho=-0.69)和新信息引入(rho=+0.38)；(7) 解决了Gardner问题1.5，得到极小极大率Θ(R/(κ m^(2/(D-1))))。

Conclusion: LLM基准测试存在严重的结构盲区，导致排名高度不稳定；通过体视学理论可以量化这些盲区，并利用子模优化找到高效稳定的基准子集；同时独立地推动了凸体几何中Gardner问题在C^2支撑函数情形下的理论进展。

Abstract: We give a stereological theory of LLM benchmark coverage. For any suite with effective dimensionality d_eff, the visible Hausdorff distance between two convex capability profiles consistent with the same scores is bounded by epsilon + C R m^(-1/(d_eff-1)), with matching Lipschitz lower bound. Empirically, three independent leaderboards (Open LLM v2, an extended 12-benchmark suite, LiveBench) all have d_eff in [2.86, 4.80] on their competitive frontier; the structural blind spot exceeds the observed runner-up score gap by two orders of magnitude and dominates statistical noise by 52-127x. Under a chi-squared projection model, the isotropic prior is the optimistic case; across six hidden-capability priors and four ambient dimensions the simulated half-split swap rate of the top two models stays in [0.38, 0.49], and a 500-trial random visible/held-out split shows that 92% of trials swap the top-1 ranking with on average 2.83 of 5 top-5 models changing. A submodular greedy algorithm with the Nemhauser (1 - 1/e) guarantee finds a stable core of 4 benchmarks; 7 of 12 suffice for 90% coverage, and the trained subset transfers across temporal quarters with 93-97% retention. A counterfactual validation across 12 internal benchmarks and 27 Chatbot Arena categories confirms that the eigenstructure predicts which evaluations are irreplaceable (rho = -0.69, p = 0.013 for removal disruption) and which external evaluations bring new information (rho = +0.38). As a second, independent theoretical contribution, we resolve Gardner's Problem 1.5 (1995) for C^2 support functions, establishing the minimax rate Theta(R/(kappa m^(2/(D-1)))) in general dimension via optimal recovery theory on S^(D-1).

</details>


### [172] [ERRORQUAKE: Heavy-Tailed Error Severity Distributions in Open-Weight Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05170)
*Jason Z Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Errorquake-10k基准测试，通过连续0-4严重性评分评估21个开源LLM的错误严重度分布，发现不同模型在相同准确率下错误严重度分布存在显著差异（85/210模型对的b置信区间不重叠），证明错误率与严重度分布信息非冗余（64.5%的b方差无法由ε解释），低严重错误多为检索错误（71%），高严重错误多为捏造（39%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有幻觉基准将所有错误视为等价，只报告单一错误率，忽略了错误严重程度的巨大差异（如错误日期与捏造法庭裁决之间相差数个数量级），无法全面评估模型可靠性。

Method: 构建Errorquake-10k基准（10000查询，0-4连续严重性评分，8领域5难度层级）；拟合Gutenberg-Richter上尾斜率b作为严重度分布指标；通过3名评估者519项人类验证研究确认可靠性（ICC=0.85）和LLM评判排序一致性（rho=0.89）；证明非冗余性定理；构建严重性机制分类学（kappa=0.83）。

Result: 在210个模型对中，85对在匹配准确率下b的95%置信区间不重叠；密集模型缩放与人类数据的严重度分布相关（rho_s=-0.86）；错误率与严重度分布之间的互信息为1.56比特；低严重错误71%为检索错误，高严重错误39%为捏造。

Conclusion: 严重度分布应作为准确率的补充指标共同报告，它携带了错误率无法提供的区分性信息。

Abstract: At matched accuracy, open-weight LLMs differ substantially in the shape of their error severity distribution -- a difference invisible to the scalar error rate. Hallucination benchmarks report a single error count and treat all errors as equivalent, yet a wrong date and a fabricated court ruling differ by orders of magnitude. We introduce Errorquake-10k, a 10,000-query benchmark scoring each response on a continuous 0-4 severity scale across 8 domains and 5 difficulty tiers, and we fit per-model severity distributions for 21 open-weight models. For each model we estimate a severity distribution index (b, the Gutenberg-Richter upper-tail slope) with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. Headline: across the 210 model pairs, 85 have disjoint 95% b confidence intervals at matched accuracy (|Delta epsilon| < 0.05) on human-consensus scoring, e.g. deepseek-v3.2 vs. ministral-14b at epsilon = 0.586 and Delta b = 0.47. A 519-item three-rater human validation study confirms measurement reliability (ICC(2,k=3) = 0.85), validates the LLM-judge ranking (rho = 0.89), and confirms the dense-model scaling correlation on human data (rho_s = -0.86). We prove a Non-Reducibility Theorem showing that severity profile and error rate are informationally non-redundant (I(b; model | epsilon) = 1.56 bits; 64.5% of cross-model b variance is unexplained by epsilon). A severity mechanism taxonomy (kappa = 0.83) reveals that error type shifts categorically with severity: low-severity errors are retrievals (71%); high-severity errors are fabrications (39%) -- and this composition differs by model size (p < 0.0001). Severity distribution should be reported alongside accuracy; it carries discriminative information that the error rate cannot.

</details>


### [173] [Staged Factorial Screening for Budget-Constrained Micro-Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05186)
*Felipe Chavarro Polania*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了预算受限的微型预训练场景下，通过分阶段分数阶因子实验流程，在短预算（2/5/10分钟）内识别稳定效应结构，并验证了桥接模型在24小时内跨主机的优势，但无法实现硬件无关排名或通用超参数优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在预算受限的微型预训练中，需要先在共享加速器上筛选大量候选配方，再投入更大搜索预算。现有流程缺乏对早期稳定效应结构的系统恢复方法。

Method: 在固定单GPU训练循环上运行613次实验，包括2/5/10分钟的试点和后续筛查、5/10分钟的全16条件种子重跑、针对性锚点检查、同主机贪婪和随机基线、60分钟桥接包，以及Windows A100和Linux L40S上至24小时的锚点延续。

Result: 总批次、深度和宽度的主惩罚在短预算时最大，随预算增加而放松。在种子全屏幕系列中，D/A/B/C在5/10分钟经BH校正后仍保持非零估计，E则否。随机搜索可达强候选但重复在低惩罚区域且无因子归因。60分钟桥接锚点均值最低。24小时三锚点延续中桥接样本均值最低，非桥接排序对主机敏感。

Conclusion: 建议使用短设计屏幕识别高惩罚方向，通过重复运行确认有前景锚点，在缩减空间内局部优化。支持24小时内跨主机的桥接中心推荐，但无法实现硬件不变排名或通用超参数优化优势。

Abstract: Budget-constrained micro-pretraining often requires triaging many candidate recipes on a shared accelerator before larger search budgets are spent. We study whether a staged fractional-factorial workflow can recover stable early effect structure in this setting. On a fixed autoresearch-derived single-GPU training loop, we run 613 experiments across pilot and follow-up screens at 2, 5, and 10 minutes; full 16-condition seeded reruns at 5 and 10 minutes; targeted seeded anchor checks; same-host greedy and matched-cost random baselines; a 60-minute bridge package; and bounded Windows A100 and Linux L40S anchor continuations through 24 hours. Main penalties from total batch, depth, and width are largest at short budgets and relax as budget increases. Within the predeclared seeded full-screen families, D, A, B, and C retain non-zero estimates at 5 and 10 minutes after within-budget Benjamini-Hochberg correction, while E does not. Random search can reach strong incumbents in this 32-condition space, but repeatedly in the same low-penalty region and without factor attribution. The 60-minute bridge anchor has the lowest mean, although that package does not separate workflow refinement from the larger bridge model's capacity advantage. In bounded 12-hour and 24-hour three-anchor continuations on both hosts, the bridge has the lowest sample mean while the non-bridge ordering stays host-sensitive. We therefore present a bounded methods result: use short designed screens to identify high-penalty directions, confirm promising anchors under repeated runs, and refine locally inside the reduced space. The evidence supports a bridge-centered recommendation through 24 hours on two hosts, not hardware-invariant ranking or general hyperparameter-optimization superiority.

</details>


### [174] [PyCC.id: A package for hypothesis-driven equation discovery with structural identifiability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05191)
*Federico J. Gonzalez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了PyCC库，一种基于特征曲线（CCs）的结构骨架方法，用于从时间序列数据中发现ODE，通过将先验假设融入训练过程来解决逆问题的不适定性，并支持多种方程发现范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动方程发现中的逆问题通常是不适定的，会产生多个拟合数据同样好的候选模型。现有方法虽通过引入先验假设缩小搜索空间，但仍需依赖领域专家的后验手动筛选，缺乏系统性工具支持。

Method: 提出基于特征曲线（CCs）的假设驱动方法：用户定义与ODE族关联的结构骨架，基于领域知识迭代添加假设和先验；部分骨架具有可证明的结构可辨识性；该方法支持神经网络、符号回归和稀疏回归等多种范式，并集成为Python库PyCC。

Result: 开发了PyCC库，提供灵活的工具让用户无缝定义骨架和假设，从时间序列数据中发现ODE。

Conclusion: PyCC将基于特征曲线的假设驱动方程发现方法系统化、工具化，解决了逆问题不适定性带来的多候选模型问题，为研究人员和工程师提供了模块化、可扩展的ODE发现平台。

Abstract: Data-driven equation discovery is fundamentally an inverse problem that seeks to infer the governing differential equations of a system directly from time-series measurements. A known issue is the ill-conditioned nature of the inverse problem, which frequently produces multiple mathematical models that fit the data similarly well. One path to address this issue is by incorporating known hypotheses and constraints into the training phase beforehand. While this approach effectively reduces the search space, it still results in multiple candidate models, forcing practitioners to rely on post-hoc manual filtering based on their own domain expertise. A recent approach incorporates structural `skeletons' inspired by characteristic curves (CCs), defining a hypothesis-driven methodology. In this methodology, practitioners define a skeleton, which is associated with a family of ordinary differential equations (ODEs), and then add their hypotheses and priors based on their domain knowledge to refine the obtained model iteratively. An important advantage of this approach is that some skeletons have demonstrable structural identifiability properties, which are useful for checking whether the skeleton is correct or should be discarded. Furthermore, this formalism enables the use of multiple equation discovery paradigms due to its modularity (such as neural networks, symbolic regression, and sparse regression). In this work, we present the Python library PyCC, which condenses these efforts into a flexible tool that allows researchers and engineers to seamlessly define their skeletons and hypotheses to discover ODEs from time-dependent data.

</details>


### [175] [Temporal Preference Concepts and their Functions in a Large Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05194)
*Ian Rios-Sialer,Shantanu Darveshi,Shuai Jiang,Avigya Paudel,Anastasiia Pronina,Ipshita Bandyopadhyay,Justin Shenk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过机械可解释性方法，在蒸馏LLM（Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507）中因果定位了处理时间偏好的底层子图（集中在中上层），发现LLM对未来的折现远低于人类，且偏好不稳定。研究还表明，通过操纵表征向量可以调控模型的时间偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在需要权衡短期收益与长期后果的决策场景中应用日益广泛，但内部如何表征和解决这类时间权衡尚不清楚。作者希望揭示LLM处理时间偏好的内部机制，并为实现可靠控制提供基础。

Method: 使用梯度归因和激活补丁两种方法在Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507模型中进行因果定位，识别时间偏好的底层子图；通过残差流分析时间跨度几何编码；进行行为分析比较LLM与人类折现率的差异；最后探索通过操控向量（steering vectors）改变时间偏好的可能性。

Result: 成功定位了时间偏好相关的子图（集中在中上层）；验证了时间跨度几何信息编码在残差流相应层；发现未干预的LLM折现率远低于人类（更耐心），但偏好不稳定受上下文影响；初步证据表明操控向量可改变时间偏好。

Conclusion: 机械可解释性有助于实现对LLM规划和推理中时间偏好的可靠控制，相比隐式依赖训练，显式控制更为必要。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being deployed to make decisions that require trading off near-term gains against long-term consequences, yet little is known about how they internally represent or resolve these tradeoffs. In this work, we causally localize an underlying subgraph for temporal preference in a distilled LLM (Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507), identifying mid-to-upper-layer nodes through converging evidence from gradient-based attribution and activation patching. We find that the geometry of time horizon is encoded in the residual stream at the expected localized layers. A behavioral analysis reveals that unintervened LLMs discount the future several times less steeply than humans, yet this preference is unstable across contexts, motivating explicit control rather than implicit reliance on training. Finally, we find suggestive evidence that steering vectors can shift temporal preference. Our work demonstrates how mechanistic interpretability can bring us closer to reliable control over how LLMs plan and reason

</details>


### [176] [State commitment learning: training language models to distinguish computation from memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05201)
*Fei Ding,Yongkang Zhang,Runhao Liu,Yuhao Liao,Zijian Zeng,Huiming Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出状态承诺学习（State Commitment Learning）目标，通过反事实擦除强化学习（CERL）训练模型区分持久状态与临时计算，在数学、长链逻辑、科学问答和多轮工具使用任务中，在不牺牲准确率的前提下显著降低答案对隐藏思维的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理语言模型不区分用于计算的token和构成持久状态的token，所有隐藏的思考过程（包括失败的尝试、死胡同和私人草稿）都保留在上下文中并影响后续预测，导致下游推理可能依赖不应被安全依赖的内容。

Method: 提出反事实擦除强化学习（CERL），在相同前缀下同时评估保留隐藏思维和擦除隐藏思维两条路径，仅在擦除路径保持正确时给予奖励；同时引入擦除依赖协议（Erasure Dependence Protocol）进行度量。

Result: 在数学、长链逻辑、科学QA和多轮工具使用评估中，CERL显著降低了答案对隐藏思维的依赖，同时不牺牲准确率，一致优于仅使用正确性RL和长答案SFT基线。

Conclusion: 通过状态承诺学习训练模型明确区分应提交为持久状态的信息和可丢弃的临时计算，能够有效减少推理对隐藏思考过程的依赖，提升模型输出的可靠性和安全性。

Abstract: Reasoning language models do not distinguish tokens used for computation from tokens that constitute persistent state: once generated, all hidden thoughts remain in context and influence future predictions. As a result, downstream reasoning may depend on failed attempts, dead ends, and private scratch work that should not be safely relied on later. We recast this phenomenon as a new training objective, state commitment learning: training models to explicitly distinguish information that should be committed as persistent state from temporary computation that can be discarded. We define a counterfactual criterion, persistent-state sufficiency, which makes it trainable and measurable whether an answer remains usable after hidden thoughts are erased. We then propose Counterfactual Erasure RL (CERL), which evaluates, under the same prefix, both a path that keeps hidden thoughts and a path that erases them, and gives reward only when the erasure path remains correct. We also introduce the Erasure Dependence Protocol and show across mathematics, long-chain logic, scientific QA, and multi-turn tool-use evaluation that CERL substantially reduces answer dependence on hidden thoughts without sacrificing accuracy, consistently outperforming correctness-only RL and long-answer SFT baselines.

</details>


### [177] [Gradient Descent with Large Step Size Restores Symmetry in Deep Linear Networks with Multi-Pathway](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05219)
*Hee-Sung Kim,Sungyoon Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了深度线性网络中，离散梯度下降（GD）在大步长下会逆转梯度流（GF）预测的"赢家通吃"单路径特化现象，导致信号在多个路径间重新分布，形成共享表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究仅关注梯度流下的路径竞争，忽略了离散梯度下降中大步长对路径对称性破缺和信号分配的影响。

Method: 理论证明单路径解是尖锐极小值，而多路径分配可降低尖锐度（随路径数和深度增加而减弱）；通过分析Edge of Stability阶段的振荡行为，揭示大步长GD如何覆盖早期深度驱动的对称性破缺，进入信号重新平衡阶段。

Result: 大步长GD在Edge of Stability阶段的振荡会覆盖早期GF预测的对称性破缺，驱动网络进入信号重新分配阶段，最终形成跨路径的共享表示而非单路径主导。

Conclusion: 深度影响路径竞争的方式取决于优化算法和步长：大步长GD偏好共享表示，而GF偏好单路径特化。这解释了实践中深度网络为何倾向于学习分布式特征而非单一通路。

Abstract: Recent analyses of multi-pathway Deep Linear Networks use Gradient Flow to predict a "winner-takes-all" specialization in which path symmetry breaks and each feature concentrates in a single pathway. In this work, we show that discrete Gradient Descent (GD) with a large step size tells a different story. We prove that single-path solutions are sharp minima, whereas distributing signals across pathways reduces sharpness by a factor that decreases with both the number of pathways and depth. Consequently, while early training reproduces the depth-driven symmetry breaking predicted by GF, oscillations at the Edge of Stability subsequently override this tendency and drive the network into a re-balancing phase, where signals redistribute across pathways. Together, these results clarify how depth shapes pathway competition and explain why large-step GD favors shared representations rather than persistent single-pathway dominance.

</details>


### [178] [Differentiable Efficient Operator Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05232)
*Xiaohuan Pei,Jiyuan Zhang,Yuanfan Guo,Weiguo Feng,Tao Huang,Cho-Jui Hsieh,Chang Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出高效算子搜索（Efficient Operator Search, EOS），一种可微框架，用于联合搜索多模态基础模型中令牌缩减的位置、保留数量和处理方式，将手动设计的多种算子统一为共享算子空间的不同实例，并在多模态基准上取得竞争性的精度-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态基础模型的高效推理通常依赖手动设计的令牌缩减算子（如剪枝、合并、池化、自适应重加权），但这些算子的设计缺乏统一视角且搜索空间未被系统探索。

Method: 提出可微的算子搜索框架，参数化三个维度：层激活（where to reduce）、保留预算（how many to retain）和算子行为（how to process reduced tokens），在单边预算和成本约束下优化任务性能。搜索空间将多种手动算子恢复为特例，并能发现混合算子。

Result: 在多模态基准上，搜索得到的算子在精度-效率权衡上具有竞争力，尤其在激进的视觉令牌缩减场景下表现突出。

Conclusion: 高效多模态推理可以从手动算子设计转向可微算子搜索。

Abstract: Efficient multimodal foundation models often rely on manually designed token-reduction operators, such as pruning, merging, pooling, and adaptive reweighting. Although these operators appear different, we show that they can be interpreted as distinct regimes of a shared operator space. Based on this view, we introduce Efficient Operator Search, a differentiable framework that jointly searches where to reduce tokens, how many tokens to retain, and how reduced token information should be processed. The proposed search space parameterizes layer activation, retention budget, and operator behavior, while the search policy optimizes task performance under one-sided budget and cost constraints. This formulation recovers representative hand-designed baselines as special cases and further discovers hybrid operators beyond isolated manual designs. Experiments on multimodal benchmarks show that the searched operators achieve competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs, especially under aggressive visual-token reduction. These results suggest that efficient multimodal inference can be reframed from manual operator design to differentiable operator search.

</details>


### [179] [DiffSlack: Learning under Nonlinear Inequality Constraints via Learnable Slack Variables](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05247)
*Ziqian Wang,Chenxi Fang,Zhen Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DiffSlack提出了一种可微投影层，通过引入可学习的松弛变量将非线性不等式约束转化为等式约束，并结合阻尼高斯-牛顿投影实现硬约束满足，在车辆路径规划等工程问题上表现出优于现有基线方法的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在神经网络中强制执行非线性不等式约束仍然具有挑战性，尤其是当输出受多个耦合约束限制时。现有的硬约束方法通常对约束集施加结构性限制，或在大规模非线性问题上引入大量计算开销。

Method: DiffSlack将不等式约束重构为带可学习松弛变量的等式约束，松弛变量作为增强网络输出的一部分进行预测，为阻尼高斯-牛顿投影提供数据驱动的热启动。投影层将原始预测映射到增强可行流形上，同时保持端到端可微性。两级课程学习进一步稳定训练并提高约束满足度。

Result: 在包含200个非线性不等式约束（碰撞避免、曲率限制、航点间距）的车辆路径规划任务上，DiffSlack相比现有基线方法实现了更高的规划成功率和更强的几何约束满足度，推理开销相当。消融实验表明硬投影层降低了对监督质量的敏感性。CARLA闭环跟踪和实车实验验证了生成轨迹的可执行性。

Conclusion: DiffSlack为在神经网络中嵌入硬不等式约束提供了一种实用且可扩展的方法，适用于工程应用。

Abstract: Enforcing nonlinear inequality constraints in neural networks remains challenging, especially when the output is subject to many coupled constraints. Existing hard constraint methods often impose structural restrictions on the constraint set or introduce substantial computational overhead for large-scale nonlinear problems. Here, we propose DiffSlack, a differentiable projection layer for nonlinear inequality-constrained neural prediction. DiffSlack reformulates inequalities as equalities with learnable slack variables, which are predicted as part of the augmented network output and provide a data-driven warm start for damped Gauss-Newton projection. The projection layer maps raw predictions onto the augmented feasible manifold while preserving end-to-end differentiability. A two-stage curriculum further stabilizes training and improves constraint satisfaction. We evaluate DiffSlack on vehicle path planning with 200 nonlinear inequality constraints from collision avoidance, curvature limits, and waypoint spacing. Compared with existing learning-based baselines, DiffSlack achieves a higher planning success rate and stronger geometric constraint satisfaction under a comparable inference budget. Ablation studies further show that the hard projection layer reduces sensitivity to supervision quality. Closed-loop tracking in CARLA and real-world vehicle experiments confirms the executability of the generated trajectories. These results demonstrate that DiffSlack provides a practical and scalable approach to embedding hard inequality constraints into neural networks for engineering applications.

</details>


### [180] [Alpha-RTL: Test-Time Training for RTL Hardware Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05253)
*Peilong Zhou,Zhirong Chen,Cangyuan Li,Haoyu Gao,Kaiyan Chang,Ziming Qu,Ying Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TTT-RTL，首个针对RTL设计的测试时训练框架，通过EDA反馈在线更新LLM策略，在RTLLM v2.0上将PPA乘积降低65.1%，优于冻结策略基线（26.1%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM生成RTL的方法要么训练通用生成器后部署，要么使用冻结策略进行测试时搜索，无法针对具体设计问题利用EDA反馈动态调整策略。作者希望实现测试时策略自适应，让LLM根据可执行的EDA反馈为特定RTL问题优化。

Method: 1) 采样候选实现并通过语法检查和仿真验证；2) 使用综合导出的PPA乘积对有效设计评分；3) 通过PUCT索引的设计状态池重用高奖励变体；4) 使用熵策略梯度目标更新策略；5) 引入自适应KL预算控制器，根据参考KL、有效样本量和奖励饱和信号调整熵约束。

Result: 在RTLLM v2.0/Nangate 45nm上，几何平均PPA乘积降低65.1%（最强冻结策略基线26.1%）；在XuanTie C910 FPU/ Sky130上，ADP降低59.4%；消融实验验证了策略自适应、状态重用和KL预算控制均有贡献。

Conclusion: 测试时训练结合可执行EDA反馈能够将LLM-based RTL生成从功能正确性推进到物理优化的硬件设计，表明在线策略自适应是提升RTL质量的关键方向。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown increasing promise in generating
  functionally correct register-transfer-level (RTL) hardware designs.
  Recent systems improve further through EDA-integrated reinforcement
  learning with syntax, simulation, and PPA rewards, but train a general
  RTL generator before deployment while test-time approaches search with
  a frozen policy. We instead perform reinforcement learning at test time,
  allowing the LLM policy to adapt to executable EDA feedback for the
  specific RTL problem at hand. We propose TTT-RTL, to our knowledge the
  first per-design test-time training framework that closes the loop
  between an LLM policy and an EDA pipeline for RTL optimization. TTT-RTL
  samples candidate implementations, verifies them through syntax checking
  and simulation, scores valid designs using synthesis-derived PPA product,
  reuses high-reward variants through a PUCT-indexed design-state pool,
  and updates the policy with an entropic policy-gradient objective. To
  stabilize policy updates under sparse or plateaued rewards, we introduce
  an adaptive KL-budget controller that adjusts the entropy constraint
  using reference KL, effective sample size, and reward saturation signals.
  On RTLLM v2.0 under Nangate 45nm, TTT-RTL reduces the geometric-mean
  PPA product by 65.1% over the reference, outperforming the strongest
  published frozen-policy agent baseline at 26.1%. On an industrial
  XuanTie C910 FPU leading-zero-anticipation unit under Sky130, TTT-RTL
  achieves a 59.4% ADP reduction, and ablations confirm that policy
  adaptation, state reuse, and KL-budget control each contribute. These
  results suggest that test-time training with executable EDA feedback can
  move LLM-based RTL generation beyond functional correctness toward
  physically optimized hardware.

</details>


### [181] [Flash-WAM: Modality-Aware Distillation for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05254)
*Arman Akbari,Ci Zhang,Arash Akbari,Lin Zhao,Yixiao Chen,Weiwei Chen,Xuan Zhang,Geng Yuan,Yanzhi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Flash-WAM提出了一种模态感知的步骤蒸馏框架，通过为视频和动作流分别设计一致性函数（线性梯度缩放参数化用于低噪声动作流，方差保持参数化用于高噪声视频流），将世界-动作模型的推理从数十步压缩到单步，在L40S上实现23倍加速（从8.1秒降至348毫秒），同时保持任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界-动作模型虽在机器人操作任务中表现优异，但需要数十步去噪迭代，计算成本过高，无法用于实时控制。步骤蒸馏是自然解决方案，但现有单模态蒸馏方法无法处理视频与动作流之间因使用不同SNR偏移噪声调度而导致的边际噪声分布不对称问题。

Method: 受一致性蒸馏启发，提出模态感知步骤蒸馏框架Flash-WAM。通过对一致性函数家族的结构分析，为动作流的低噪声区域设计线性梯度缩放参数化，为视频流的高噪声区域设计方差保持参数化，使各模态匹配自身的噪声机制。

Result: 在LingBot-VA上实现单步推理；在RoboTwin 2.0上将每块延迟从8.1秒降至348毫秒（23倍加速）；仿真任务成功率达85.5%（RoboTwin 2.0）和95.7%（LIBERO）；在Unitree G1人形机器人上达到60%真实世界平均成功率，而朴素一致性蒸馏在相同步数下仅24%。

Conclusion: Flash-WAM通过模态感知的蒸馏策略有效解决了多模态噪声调度不对称问题，在实现实时推理的同时保持了任务性能，为世界-动作模型在实际机器人系统中的应用铺平了道路。

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) jointly generate future video and robot actions through iterative diffusion, achieving strong performance on manipulation benchmarks but requiring tens of denoising steps, a cost that precludes real-time control. Step distillation has emerged as the natural remedy, but off-the-shelf methods break down in the joint video-action setting because video and action streams use different SNR-shifted noise schedules and reach training with substantially different marginal noise distributions, an asymmetry that single-modality distillation methods cannot accommodate. We introduce \textbf{Flash-WAM}, a modality-aware step-distillation framework inspired by consistency distillation that selects the consistency function for each modality to match its noise regime: a linear-gradient-scaling parametrization for the action stream's low-noise regime, paired with a variance-preserving parametrization for the video stream's high-noise regime, grounded in a structural analysis of the consistency-function family that characterizes the achievable gradient scaling under the consistency boundary condition. Instantiated on LingBot-VA, Flash-WAM compresses inference to a single step in each modality. On RoboTwin 2.0, this reduces per-chunk latency from $8.1$ seconds to $348$ ms on NVIDIA L40S, a $23{\times}$ speedup that enables real-time inference. Flash-WAM preserves task success on simulation benchmarks ($85.5\%$ RoboTwin 2.0, $95.7\%$ LIBERO) and substantially recovers real-world performance ($60\%$ average on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot), while naive consistency distillation drops to $24\%$ at the same step budget.

</details>


### [182] [Scaling Laws for Behavioral Foundation Models over User Event Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05257)
*Rickard Brüel Gabrielsson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了行为基础模型（如推荐、支付、欺诈等领域的用户行为序列模型）的缩放规律。通过约600次实验，发现：小嵌入器（约2%参数）是计算最优的；训练偏向数据密集型；损失函数与排序指标之间存在可缩放的差异性；评估指标本身会改变计算最优配方。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型越来越多地用于用户行为序列建模，但缺乏类似语言模型缩放律的计算校准方法，亟需系统研究行为模型的计算最优训练策略。

Method: 在真实交互数据上进行了约600次实验（训练FLOPs覆盖10^15-10^19），联合变化四个关键轴：两部分参数分配、关键批次大小、模型/数据分配、冻结嵌入器后的负采样数量。

Result: 1) 小嵌入器（约2%参数）在所有预算下计算最优；2) 低计算时数据偏重，高计算时D/N比率趋近Chinchilla启发式；3) 损失与排序指标的差异本身具有缩放特性；4) 大预算下更多负样本更优，10^19 FLOPs时受限于候选轴内存而非FLOPs。

Conclusion: 在行为基础模型中，评估指标本身应被视为缩放律的一部分，因为改变指标会改变计算最优的训练配方。

Abstract: Foundation models are increasingly trained on sequences of user actions in recommendation, payments, fraud, and commerce, but these models still lack the kind of compute calibration that scaling laws provide for language models. We study a common two-part behavioral-model architecture: a feature-based event embedder maps each multi-modal item to a vector, and a decoder-only transformer predicts the next event from the resulting sequence. Across roughly 600 runs on real interaction data, spanning $10^{15}$-$10^{19}$ training FLOPs, we jointly vary four deployment-relevant axes: the two-part parameter split, critical batch size, model/data allocation, and the number of sampled negatives used after freezing the embedder. A small embedder ($s^{\star}\!\approx\!2\%$ of parameters) is compute-optimal at every budget we test because embedder parameters are both more expensive per step and exposed to far more repeated items than contextualizer parameters. Compute-optimal training is data-heavy relative to text at low compute, but its $D/N$ ratio moves toward the Chinchilla heuristic as compute increases. The sampled training objective and deployed ranking metrics disagree in ways that themselves scale: critical batch size, optimal negative count after freezing, and the agreement between loss and ranking quality all shift with compute and with the chosen evaluation metric. For negative sampling, larger budgets increasingly prefer more negatives; by $10^{19}$ FLOPs the active constraint is candidate-axis memory rather than FLOPs. In behavioral foundation models, the evaluation metric is therefore part of the scaling law: changing it can change the compute-optimal recipe.

</details>


### [183] [Policy-Conditioned Counterfactual Credit for Verifiable Reinforcement Learning of Long-Horizon Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05263)
*Renwei Meng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CVT-RL是一种基于约束策略梯度的强化学习算法，通过密集可验证奖励、干预有效性门控和策略条件反事实贡献（PCCC）估计器，解决了长程语言智能体中的证据链不可靠、信念漂移和捷径行为等问题。在长上下文问答、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和网页/工具任务上，平均任务成功率从71.8%（非因果RL）和75.4%（信息匹配的反事实基线）提升至78.9%，证据F1从78.9提升至82.8，黑客行为从7.2%降至3.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法中，具有可验证奖励的强化学习虽能改善推理和工具使用，但长程语言智能体仍存在学习不可靠证据链、信念漂移以及仅满足终端检查的捷径行为。现有过程奖励大多是相关性的，它们奖励类似检索、反思或验证的步骤，而不估计该步骤在指定干预下是否对最终的验证成功有贡献。

Method: 提出CVT-RL算法，包含三个核心组件：1) 密集可验证奖励；2) 干预有效性门控；3) 策略条件反事实贡献（PCCC）估计器。具体包括：删除、语义替换、证据替换和工具输出扰动四种受控干预；从冻结的参考策略采样续接；使用选择调整的双重稳健估计器增强优势估计。信念控制仅使用前缀可观测标签，通过增广拉格朗日方法约束不可靠主张、跳过验证、工具篡改和不安全调用。

Result: 在长上下文QA、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和网页/工具任务上，CVT-RL相比计算匹配的非因果RL（71.8%）和信息匹配的反事实过程基线（75.4%），平均任务成功率提升至78.9%；证据F1从78.9提升至82.8；测量黑客行为从7.2%降至3.9%。独立人类审计估计黑客行为为4.6%（基线8.1%），自适应检测规避攻击仅将黑客行为提升至7.1%。分层bootstrap和混合效应检验在Holm校正后所有主要指标p<0.01。

Conclusion: 精心设计的反事实信用分配与有效性门控、诊断和可验证约束相结合，为更可靠的长程RL语言智能体提供了可复现的路径。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves reasoning and tool use, yet long-horizon language agents still learn unsupported evidence chains, belief drift, and shortcut actions that satisfy terminal checks. Existing process rewards are mostly correlational: they reward retrieval-, reflection-, or verification-like steps without estimating whether the step contributes to final verified success under a specified intervention. We propose CVT-RL, a constrained policy-gradient algorithm with dense verifiable rewards, intervention-validity gating, and a policy-conditioned counterfactual contribution (PCCC) estimator. Deletion, semantic substitution, evidence substitution, and tool-output perturbation define separate controlled interventions; continuations are sampled from a frozen reference policy, and a selection-adjusted doubly robust estimator augments the advantage. Belief control uses only prefix-observable labels, while an augmented Lagrangian constrains unsupported claims, skipped verification, tool tampering, and unsafe calls. On long-context QA, ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and web/tool tasks, CVT-RL improves average task success from 71.8% for compute-matched non-causal RL and 75.4% for an information-matched counterfactual-process baseline to 78.9%, improves evidence F1 from 78.9 to 82.8 over the information-matched baseline, and reduces measured hacking from 7.2% to 3.9%. Independent human audit estimates 4.6% hacking for CVT-RL versus 8.1% for the information-matched baseline, and adaptive detector-evasion attacks raise hacking only to 7.1%. Stratified bootstrap and mixed-effects tests give p<0.01 after Holm correction for all primary metrics. Carefully scoped counterfactual credit, paired with validity gating, diagnostics, and verifiable constraints, provides a reproducible route toward more reliable long-horizon RL for language agents.

</details>


### [184] [REGEN: Reference-Guided Synthetic Multivariate Time Series Generation for Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05264)
*Moulik Gupta,Dhruv Kumar,Murari Mandal,Saurabh Deshpande*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ReGeN，一种参考引导的生成管道，将观测序列分解为可解释的周期性骨干、随机残差和跨变量依赖三个组件，通过可控合成生成多样化时间序列数据，在低数据场景下能有效替代真实数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列生成方法存在不足：基于先验的方法生成领域无关样本，数据驱动方法将参考序列视为黑盒监督，缺乏对周期结构、局部变异和跨变量动力学的显式控制。需要一种能利用参考序列作为结构支架进行可控合成的方法。

Method: ReGeN将每个参考序列分解为三个可解释组件：相位对齐的周期性骨干（捕获领域主导形态）、每变量随机残差（使用深核高斯过程建模）、以及通过结构因果模型注入的滞后感知跨变量依赖（带拟合耦合系数）。通过可控温度采样这些组件来扩展分布覆盖，同时保留领域基础结构。

Result: ReGeN生成的数据能持续替代真实兄弟数据且预测退化最小；在强周期领域（如交通）甚至优于真实源数据。在ReGeN语料上预训练的基座模型优于基于先验和数据驱动的合成替代方案预训练的模型。

Conclusion: 在低数据场景下，如何结构性利用参考数据与拥有多少数据同等重要。

Abstract: Training robust multivariate time series forecasting models requires large, diverse corpora, yet many real-world domains provide only a handful of observed sequences. Existing generators fail to resolve this mismatch: prior-based approaches (e.g., CauKer, TimePFN) produce domain-agnostic samples, while data-driven methods (e.g., TimeGAN) treat references as black-box supervision, forfeiting explicit control over periodic structure, local variability, and cross-variable dynamics.
  We propose ReGeN, a reference-guided generative pipeline that treats observed sequences not as examples to imitate, but as structural scaffolds for controllable synthesis. ReGeN decomposes each reference into three interpretable components: a phase-aligned periodic backbone capturing dominant domain morphology; per-variable stochastic residuals modeled with a deep-kernel Gaussian process; and lag-aware cross-variable dependencies injected through a structural causal model with fitted coupling coefficients. Sampling these components at controllable temperature broadens distributional coverage while preserving domain-grounded structure.
  We show that ReGeN-generated data consistently substitutes for real sibling data with minimal forecasting degradation, and in strongly periodic domains such as traffic, can outperform the real source itself. We further show that a foundation model pretrained on ReGeN corpora outperforms those pretrained on prior-based and data-driven synthetic alternatives. This suggests that in low-data regimes, how reference data is structurally exploited can matter as much as how much data is available.

</details>


### [185] [Data-efficient flood depth prediction through domain-aware coreset selection and tabular foundation models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05265)
*Lipai Huang,Adithi Srinath,Manas Singh,Junwei Ma,Ali Mostafavi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于领域感知的核心集构建流程，通过仅使用0.7%的训练数据即可在条件化表格基础模型上实现接近监督学习精度的洪水深度预测，并支持跨流域迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近实时洪水深度预测需要既准确又快速的替代模型，且需具备跨流域迁移能力。监督式替代模型精度虽高，但每个流域需要数百万训练样本且无法外推至新网格。

Method: 提出领域感知的核心集构建流程：按重现期和受影响最严重的流域对风暴分层，然后使用目标感知的空间选择器采样六边形。在推理时条件化表格基础模型，仅使用每个流域0.7%的训练数据。

Result: 在休斯顿地区九个流域上平均R²为0.663，达到监督参考模型（R²=0.673）的98.5%精度。无需任务特定微调即可迁移到未见流域，在远分布外真实风暴案例上超过监督参考模型。

Conclusion: 领域感知的核心集构建使表格基础模型能够实现数据高效、跨流域可迁移的洪水预测，无需针对每个流域进行单独训练。

Abstract: Near-real-time flood depth prediction demands surrogate models that are accurate, fast, and transferable across watersheds. Supervised surrogates can match physics-based simulators in accuracy but need millions of training rows per watershed and cannot extrapolate beyond their original mesh. We propose a domain-aware coreset construction pipeline that conditions a tabular foundation model at inference time. The pipeline stratifies storms by return period and most-affected watershed, then samples hexagons with a target-aware spatial selector. With 0.7% of the per-watershed training pool, the model attains a mean $R^2$ of 0.663 across nine Houston-area watersheds, within 98.5% of the supervised reference ($R^2$ = 0.673). It transfers to held-out watersheds without task-specific retraining, staying ahead of a coreset-trained supervised baseline. On real storms it exceeds the supervised reference on a far out-of-distribution case and trails it on a mostly in-distribution one. Domain-aware coreset construction lets tabular foundation models deliver data-efficient, watershed-transferable flood predictions without per-watershed training.

</details>


### [186] [Sharp Low-Degree Thresholds for Planted-vs-Planted Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05266)
*Anda Skeja,Daniel Gutiérrez Espinoza,Fiona Skerman,Alexander S. Wein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在"种植vs种植"设定下建立了低度多项式检验的首个尖锐阈值，证明了种植子矩阵和种植稠密子图模型中计数社区的匹配低度上下界，并识别了弱检验的光滑转变现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在"种植vs种植"设定中，需要以渐消失误差判断数据由哪个结构化种植机制生成，但此前缺乏低度多项式检验的尖锐阈值理论。

Method: 基于低度恢复中的潜变量展开构建框架，并采用新方法识别和修剪非信号贡献。

Result: 建立了匹配的低度上下界，检验阈值与已知低度恢复阈值在尖锐常数上一致；弱检验则呈现光滑转变而非尖锐阈值。

Conclusion: 首次刻画了种植vs种植设定下低度检验的尖锐阈值，揭示了不同检验任务（强检验与弱检验）之间的本质差异。

Abstract: We establish the first sharp thresholds for low-degree polynomial tests in planted-vs-planted settings, where the goal is to determine with vanishing error which of two structured planted mechanisms generated the observed data. We prove matching low-degree upper and lower bounds for counting communities in the planted submatrix and planted dense subgraph models. The resulting testing threshold coincides, down to the sharp constant, with the known low-degree recovery threshold. In contrast, the task of weak testing, where the goal is to outperform random guessing, does not have a sharp threshold but rather a smooth transition, which we identify. To prove our results, we develop a framework for planted-vs-planted testing that builds on a latent-variable expansion originating in low-degree recovery and employs new methods to identify and prune non-signal contributions.

</details>


### [187] [Learning Manifold and Itô Dynamics with Branched Neural Rough Differential Equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05272)
*Luke Thompson,Dai Shi,Lequan Lin,Junbin Gao,Andi Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出分支神经粗糙微分方程（B-NRDEs），利用Hopf代数框架将NRDE的log-ODE步骤重构为流形上的几何数值积分，通过匹配驱动代数与相应微积分（Grossman-Larson树用于欧几里得Itô动力学，Munthe-Kaas-Wright平面树用于流形上的有序协变导数，shuffle代数用于经典Stratonovich情形），使得Itô动力学和流形约束得以精确保持，并引入分支签名核目标使二次变差项在训练中可见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NRDEs依赖shuffle代数（Stratonovich微积分的代数对应），无法处理Itô动力学所需的二次变差项，也无法处理带联络流形上的有序协变导数，限制了其在非Stratonovich场景下的应用。

Method: 将NRDE的log-ODE步骤重构为流形上的几何数值积分，根据动力学类型选择对应的Hopf代数结构（Grossman-Larson树、Munthe-Kaas-Wright平面树或shuffle代数），并引入分支签名核目标以在训练中暴露二次变差项。

Result: 在粗糙Bergomi波动率、sim-to-real SO(3)动力学预测和SPD协方差动力学三个任务上，B-NRDEs在欧几里得-Stratonovich设置之外提供了统一有效的随机与流形值动力学处理方案。

Conclusion: B-NRDEs通过代数结构的灵活选择，将NRDEs推广到Itô动力学和流形场景，为处理不规则采样的随机微分方程提供了更通用的框架。

Abstract: Neural rough differential equations (NRDEs) stay accurate under irregular sampling while taking far fewer integration steps than standard neural differential equations, summarising a finely sampled driver by its log-signature and advancing the hidden state over coarse intervals using the log-ODE method. This efficiency rests on the shuffle algebra, the algebraic counterpart of Stratonovich calculus. This reliance means NRDEs cannot expose the quadratic-variation terms Itô dynamics require, nor the ordered covariant derivatives that govern Itô flows on connection-equipped manifolds. Ameliorating this, we introduce Branched Neural Rough Differential Equations (B-NRDEs), a Hopf-algebraic framework that recasts the NRDE log-ODE step as geometric numerical integration on the state-space manifold, matching the driving algebra to the governing calculus: Grossman--Larson rooted trees for Euclidean Itô dynamics, Munthe-Kaas--Wright planar rooted trees for ordered covariant derivatives on manifolds, and the shuffle algebra in the classical Stratonovich case. This yields intrinsic coarse-step dynamics that exactly preserve manifold constraints. Finally, we introduce a branched signature-kernel objective to enable Itô-consistent law matching by making quadratic-variation terms visible during training. On rough Bergomi volatility, sim-to-real $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ dynamics forecasting, and SPD covariance dynamics, B-NRDEs offer a unified, effective approach to stochastic and manifold-valued dynamics beyond the Euclidean--Stratonovich setting.

</details>


### [188] [Anomaly Detection for Electro-Hydrostatic Actuators using LSTM Autoencoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05274)
*Nehal Afifi,Abdelmonem Elhendawi,Felix Leitenberger,Nadine Piat,Sven Matthiesen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于LSTM自编码器的离线异常检测框架，用于电液伺服作动器（EHA）传感器信号（温度和压力），在故障注入场景下实现了99.0%的平均准确率、最高100%的精确率以及93.1%-99.8%的F1分数，显著优于传统统计和机器学习方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EHA系统中传感器异常检测至关重要，但现有传统统计方法和经典机器学习方法（如Z-score、IQR、MAD、孤立森林、高斯混合模型、k-means）难以捕捉EHA信号中的时间依赖性，导致检测精度低、误报率高；且缺乏针对EHA系统的数据驱动异常检测方法的系统评估。

Method: 采用基于重建的长短期记忆（LSTM）自编码器方法，利用验证集重建误差分布进行校准和评估；在控制测试台采集的温度和压力单变量传感器数据上进行离线异常检测，并在多种故障注入场景下使用准确率、精确率、召回率和F1分数评估性能，同时进行不同运行条件下的敏感性分析。

Result: LSTM自编码器在所有评估传感器上平均准确率99.0%，精确率最高达100%，召回率在90.2%-99.6%之间，F1分数在93.1%-99.8%之间，检测灵敏度高且误报率极低。

Conclusion: 证明了数据驱动离线异常检测方法在EHA系统中的可行性；未来工作将聚焦于将该框架适配到在线（实时）环境中。

Abstract: Electro-Hydrostatic Actuators (EHAs) are widely used in aerospace and industrial systems, where timely detection of sensor anomalies is essential to ensure safe and reliable operation. However, the large volume and high sampling frequency of EHA sensor data pose challenges for accurate and efficient anomaly detection. Conventional statistical and classical machine-learning methods such as Z-score, Interquartile Range (IQR), Median Absolute Deviation (MAD), Isolation Forest, Gaussian Mixture, and k-means often fail to capture the temporal dependencies inherent in EHA signals, resulting in limited detection accuracy and elevated false-alarm rates. Furthermore, systematic evaluations of data-driven anomaly detection approaches for EHA systems remain scarce, particularly under varying operational conditions. This study presents an offline anomaly-detection framework for univariate EHA sensor signals, focusing on temperature and pressure data collected from a controlled test bench. The method employs a reconstruction-based Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) autoencoder, calibrated and evaluated using validation-set reconstruction-error distributions. Performance is assessed across multiple fault-injection scenarios using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, complemented by sensitivity analyses under varying operating conditions. The LSTM autoencoder achieved an average accuracy of 99.0\%, precision up to 100\%, recall between 90.2\% and 99.6\%, and F1-scores from 93.1\% to 99.8\%, demonstrating high detection sensitivity and a very low false-alarm rate across all evaluated sensors. These results highlight the feasibility of data-driven offline anomaly detection for EHAs. Future work will focus on adapting the developed framework for an online (real-time) environment.

</details>


### [189] [Agentic Monte Carlo: Simulating Reinforcement Learning for Black-Box Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05296)
*Dae Yon Hwang,Raunaq Suri,Valentin Villecroze,Anthony L. Caterini,Jesse C. Cresswell,Noël Vouitsis,Brendan Leigh Ross*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Agentic Monte Carlo (AMC)方法，利用强化学习与贝叶斯推断之间的等价性，通过序贯蒙特卡洛采样从最优策略的后验分布中直接采样，从而在不改变底层模型参数的前提下对黑盒LLM智能体进行优化，在AgentGym基准测试中取得了优于提示工程基线甚至GRPO的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM智能体分为开放权重（可通过RL优化）和黑盒（仅API访问，无法进行参数级优化）两种。对于黑盒智能体，虽然通常由最先进的专有LLM驱动，但API-only的限制使得大多数强化学习方法无法适用，亟需一种无需参数更新的黑盒优化方法。

Method: 利用RL与贝叶斯推断之间的等价关系，将最优策略建模为轨迹的后验分布，以固定黑盒LLM智能体为先验。通过学习价值函数引导智能体行为，同时保持底层黑盒模型不变，使用序贯蒙特卡洛（Sequential Monte Carlo）方法从该后验分布中采样。

Result: 在AgentGym基准的三个多样化环境中，AMC显著优于提示工程基线，并且在扩展测试时计算量时甚至超越了Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)。

Conclusion: AMC证明了无需参数更新即可对黑盒LLM智能体进行原则性的RL风格优化的可行性，为黑盒LLM智能体的优化提供了新范式。

Abstract: LLM agents operate in two distinct regimes: open-weight agents amenable to reinforcement learning (RL) and black-box agents whose behaviour must be controlled purely at test time. Although black-box agents are often backed by state-of-the-art proprietary LLMs, API-only access precludes parameter-level optimization, rendering most RL methods inapplicable. To address this limitation, we turn to a known equivalence between RL and Bayesian inference. We propose Agentic Monte Carlo (AMC) to directly sample from the optimal policy of a black-box agent rather than training it through RL. The optimal policy is a posterior over trajectories whose prior we define as the fixed black-box LLM agent. We employ Sequential Monte Carlo to sample from this posterior by learning a value function to steer the agent while leaving the underlying black-box model unchanged. We validate AMC on three diverse environments from the AgentGym benchmark, demonstrating significant improvements over prompting baselines and even outperforming Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) as we scale the test-time compute of our method. AMC demonstrates the feasibility of performing principled RL-style optimization of black-box LLM agents. Code is available at https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/Agentic-Monte-Carlo

</details>


### [190] [Statistically Reliable LLM-Based Ranking Evaluation via Prediction-Powered Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05308)
*Abhishek Divekar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRECISE 扩展了 Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI)，通过结合少量人工标注和大量 LLM 评判，对排序评估指标产生无偏校正估计。该方法将输出空间计算复杂度从 O(2^|C|) 降至 O(2^K)，使其适用于 Precision@K 等层次化指标。在 ESCI 基准上，30 个人工标注结合 Claude 3 评判使 Precision@4 的标准误差降低 21%；在生产系统中，100 个人工标签和 2 小时专家标注即可正确识别最佳系统变体，A/B 测试验证该排序带来 +407 bps 日销售额提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有排序评估依赖大量人工标注，成本高昂；而 LLM 评判虽廉价但存在系统性偏差。需要一种方法既能利用 LLM 的大规模评判能力，又能保证评估结果无偏。

Method: 将 Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI) 扩展到层次化排序评估指标（如 Precision@K），通过将输出空间计算从 O(2^|C|) 降至 O(2^K) 解决组合爆炸问题，实现少量人工标注与大量 LLM 评判的统计融合，产生无偏方差缩减估计。

Result: 在 ESCI 基准上，30 个人工标注+Claude 3 评判使 Precision@4 标准误差从 4.45 降至 3.50（降低 21%）；在生产系统中，100 个人工标签+2 小时专家标注正确识别最佳系统变体，A/B 测试验证该排序带来日销售额提升 +407 bps。

Conclusion: PRECISE 框架能有效利用 LLM 大规模评判能力，在极少量人工标注下产生无偏且方差更小的排序评估指标估计，显著降低评估成本，并在实际生产系统中有效指导系统变体选择，带来可观业务收益。

Abstract: With PRECISE, we extended Prediction-Powered Inference to produce bias-corrected estimates of ranking evaluation metrics by combining a small human-labeled set with a large LLM-judged set. PPI is provably unbiased regardless of the LLM judge's error profile. We make it applicable to hierarchical metrics like Precision@K, where annotations are per-document but the metric is per-query, by reducing the output-space computation from O(2^|C|) to O(2^K). On the ESCI benchmark, augmenting 30 human annotations with Claude 3 Sonnet judgments reduces the standard error of Precision@4 estimates from 4.45 to 3.50 (a 21% relative reduction). In a production system, our framework correctly identified the best of three system variants from 100 human labels and 2 hours of domain-expert annotation; A/B testing confirmed this ranking with +407 bps in daily sales.

</details>


### [191] [The Stability of Online Algorithms in Performative Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.24207)
*Gabriele Farina,Juan Carlos Perdomo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了任何无遗憾算法在执行性预测环境中都能收敛到（混合）执行性稳定均衡，无需对模型如何影响数据分布施加任何假设，并通过鞅论证和随机化避免了确定性稳定模型的计算困难性结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算法预测在决策中的应用会导致反馈循环：部署的模型积极影响后续用于训练的数据分布。先前的工作需要对模型如何影响分布施加强假设，且存在确定性稳定模型计算复杂性的困难结果，因此需要在更一般条件下理解这一动态。

Method: 采用鞅论证并允许算法随机化，将无遗憾算法与执行性稳定均衡建立无条件的归约关系，从而避免对种群如何响应预测的任何假设。

Result: 任何无遗憾算法在执行性环境中都能收敛到（混合）执行性稳定均衡，即模型主动塑造数据分布使其自身预测在事后看来最优。

Conclusion: 该连接揭示了常见算法（如梯度下降）天然具有稳定化作用并能防止失控反馈循环的原因，为在线优化与执行性之间的技术迁移奠定了基础。

Abstract: The use of algorithmic predictions in decision-making leads to a feedback loop where the models we deploy actively influence the data distributions we see, and later use to retrain on. This dynamic was formalized by Perdomo et al. 2020 in their work on performative prediction. Our main result is an unconditional reduction showing that any no-regret algorithm deployed in performative settings converges to a (mixed) performatively stable equilibrium: a solution in which models actively shape data distributions in ways that their own predictions look optimal in hindsight. Prior to our work, all positive results in this area imposed strong restrictions on how models influenced distributions. By using a martingale argument and allowing randomization, we avoid any assumption on how populations respond to predictions and sidestep recent hardness results showing that deterministic stable models are in general PPAD-hard to compute. Lastly, on a more conceptual note, our connection sheds light on why common algorithms, like gradient descent, are naturally stabilizing and prevent runaway feedback loops. We hope our work enables future technical transfer of ideas between online optimization and performativity.

</details>


### [192] [Multimarginal flow matching with optimal transport potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05327)
*Raghav Kansal,David Crair,Nghia Nguyen,Scott Pope,Bradley Parry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出OTP-FM方法，通过将动态最优传输中的势项引入条件流匹配学习目标，实现了一种高效、无模拟的多边际流匹配算法，在单细胞RNA测序、海洋学和气象学数据集上取得了最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流匹配方法主要关注两个端点分布之间的传输映射，但在许多科学领域中存在可采样的中间观测边际分布（如时间序列数据），这些中间分布有助于约束端点间的流。作者希望利用这些中间边际信息来引导学习过程。

Method: 基于流匹配与动态最优传输之间的联系，通过向动态最优传输作用量中添加势项来软性地引导流朝向中间边际分布。将条件流匹配学习目标扩展以纳入这些势项，从而推导出高效、无模拟的多边际流匹配算法。

Result: 在单细胞RNA测序、海洋学和气象学数据集上，OTP-FM取得了最先进的性能，并且训练效率高。

Conclusion: OTP-FM通过引入动态OT势项，成功解决了多边际流匹配问题，在多个科学领域的数据集上展现出优越的性能和训练效率。

Abstract: Flow matching (FM) has emerged as a powerful framework for learning dynamic transport maps between two empirical distributions. However, less explored is the setting with intermediate observed marginals that can help constrain the flows between the endpoints. This "multimarginal" regime is central to modeling temporal evolution in dynamical systems in many scientific domains that can sample sequential distributions. We tackle this problem with a novel approach that leverages the connection between FM and dynamic optimal transport (OT), softly steering the flow towards the intermediate marginals through potential terms in the dynamic OT action. By extending the conditional FM learning target to incorporate these potentials, we derive an efficient, simulation-free algorithm for multimarginal FM that offers considerable flexibility in the spatiotemporal dynamics of the learned flows. We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and training efficiency of OT-potential FM (OTP-FM) on diverse single-cell RNA sequencing, oceanographic, and meteorological datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/Bexorg-Inc/OTP-FM.

</details>


### [193] [Moral Sensitivity in LLMs: A Tiered Evaluation of Contextual Bias via Behavioral Profiling and Mechanistic Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.03217)
*Yash Aggarwal,Atmika Gorti,Vinija Jain,Aman Chadha,Krishnaprasad Thirunarayan,Manas Gaur*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出道德敏感性指数(MSI)量化LLM的偏见输出概率，通过七级压力测试对模型进行行为剖析，并通过机制验证发现偏见存在U型曲线：小模型偏见强，指令微调消除偏见，推理蒸馏重新引入偏见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有偏见评估将模型输出简单二分为"有偏见"或"无偏见"，忽略了偏见在实际应用中渐进、上下文敏感的出现方式。

Method: 两阶段方法：行为剖析阶段提出MSI指标，在七级压力测试中量化偏见概率；机制验证阶段通过logit lens、注意力分析、激活补丁和语义探针对六种模型进行电路级分析。

Result: 识别出不同对齐设计导致的不同行为特征；发现偏见U型曲线：小语言模型偏见强，指令微调消除偏见，推理蒸馏重新引入与小模型相当的偏见水平；社会负载线索激活的偏见电路与机制分析结果一致。

Conclusion: 偏见的出现并非简单的二元问题，而是与模型架构、对齐设计和训练方式密切相关；推理蒸馏可能压缩推理轨迹从而重新激活浅层统计关联。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in settings that require nuanced ethical reasoning, yet existing bias evaluations treat model outputs as simply "biased" or "unbiased." This binary framing misses the gradual, context-sensitive way bias actually emerges. We address this gap in two stages: behavioral profiling and mechanistic validation. In the behavioral stage, we introduce the Moral Sensitivity Index (MSI), a metric that quantifies the probability of biased output across a graduated, seven-tier stress test ranging from abstract numerical problems to scenarios rooted in historical and socioeconomic injustice. Evaluating four leading models (Claude 3.5, Qwen 3.5, Llama 3, and Gemini 1.5), we identify distinct behavioral signatures shaped by alignment design: for instance, Gemini 1.5 reaches 72.7% MSI by Tier 5 under socioeconomic framing, while Claude exhibits sharp suppression consistent with identity-based safety training. We then verify these behavioral patterns mechanistically. We select criminal-bias scenarios, which produced the highest MSI scores across models, as probes and apply logit lens, attention analysis, activation patching, and semantic probing to a controlled set of six models spanning three capability tiers: small language models (SLMs), instruction-tuned base models, and reasoning-distilled variants. Circuit-level analysis reveals a U-curve of bias: SLMs exhibit strong criminal bias; scaling to instruction-tuned models eliminates it; reasoning distillation reintroduces bias to SLM-like levels despite identical parameter counts, suggesting distillation compresses reasoning traces in ways that reactivate shallow statistical associations. Critically, the socially loaded cues that drive high MSI scores activate the same bias-driving circuits identified mechanistically, providing cross-stage validation.

</details>


### [194] [A prism hierarchy of learning regimes in large linear autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05335)
*Eugene Golikov,Yaroslav Gusev,Dmitry Yarotsky*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对权重绑定的线性自编码器，系统性地识别了梯度下降学习中所有定性不同的极端学习 regimes，这些regimes与三角棱柱的各个面自然对应，并在其中四个regimes中推导出了训练损失和总体损失演化的显式表达式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习模型的理论研究通常考虑不同的极限regime，但缺乏对某一类模型所有定性不同的极端学习regimes的系统性刻画。本文旨在为权重绑定的线性自编码器建立这样一个完整的图景。

Method: 以形式损失展开层级为工具，将极端regimes与三角棱柱的各个面自然关联；针对其中四个基本regimes（大数据、小数据、平均场、窄隐层）推导了梯度流下训练损失和总体损失的显式演化表达式。

Result: 识别出五个基本极端regimes：大数据、小数据、平均场、窄隐层和自由regime；在前四个regimes中得到的理论表达式与实验结果高度吻合。

Conclusion: 本文为权重绑定线性自编码器提供了完整的极端学习regimes系统分类，并在其中四个regimes上实现了理论结果与实验的良好一致。

Abstract: Theoretical studies of machine learning models commonly consider different limiting regimes in which the learning dynamics of gradient descent becomes theoretically tractable. It is, however, desirable to have a systematically obtained picture of all qualitatively different extreme learning regimes for a particular type of models. In this paper we propose such a picture for large weight-tied linear autoencoders characterized by input and latent dimensions, initialization magnitude, and training set size. This model is nonlinear in the weights and its gradient flow does not have a general theoretical solution. We show that at the level of the formal loss-expansion hierarchy, its extreme regimes are naturally associated with faces of a triangular prism. In particular, there are five basic extreme regimes associated with the 2-faces of the prism: (1) large-data, (2) small-data, (3) mean-field, (4) narrow-latent, and (5) free. For regimes (1,2,3,4), we derive explicit expressions for both train and population limiting loss evolutions under gradient flow, obtaining very good agreement with experimental results.

</details>


### [195] [PJ-RoPE: A Fourier-Jet-Affine Position Space for Relative Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05345)
*Yaobo Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PJ-RoPE框架，统一了RoPE、Jordan-RoPE和ALiBi三种相对位置编码方法，将其归纳为一个可学习的傅里叶-喷注-仿射相对位置空间，并通过可控实验验证了不同任务对该空间不同区域的选择性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的相对位置编码方法（RoPE、Jordan-RoPE、ALiBi）各有其数学形式和应用场景，但缺乏一个统一的框架来理解它们之间的内在联系和任务适应性差异。作者希望建立一个统一的数学空间，揭示不同位置编码方法背后的代数结构，并研究不同任务如何在该空间中选择不同的位置表征区域。

Method: 1) 构建PJ-RoPE框架：将RoPE的傅里叶相位、Jordan-RoPE的有限喷注和ALiBi的仿射近因性统一到单一的可学习相对位置空间中；2) 代数层面：将上述原始形式统一为有限常系数差分模，移位算子的单根对应傅里叶/RoPE特征，非零重根对应Jordan/傅里叶喷注，单位重根对应ALiBi类仿射近因性；3) 引入标量PJ偏置核与精确PJ旋转特征变换的分离、自适应扇形诊断方法，以及LC/快度坐标系来稳定高阶喷注；4) 通过可控探针实验、小规模语言模型运行和音乐token流进行验证。

Result: 可控探针验证了扇形包含与选择性；小规模语言实验揭示了仿射/近因性边界；音乐token流提供了最清晰的案例，LC/仿射变体保持强性能同时携带可测量的高阶修正；LC诊断显示尺度稳定性增益伴随相位分辨率损失。

Conclusion: PJ-RoPE提供了一个统一的数学框架来理解和选择不同的相对位置编码方法，不同任务会自适应地选择该空间中不同的区域。该框架为位置编码的设计和分析提供了新的理论工具，特别是在处理高阶喷注修正时，LC/快度坐标系在稳定性和相位分辨率之间存在权衡。

Abstract: We unify RoPE's Fourier phase, Jordan-RoPE's finite jets, and ALiBi's affine recency into a single learnable relative-position space, and study which regions of this space are selected by different tasks. PJ-RoPE is a Fourier-Jet-Affine formulation for relative attention, with an optional Poincare-type reading as the affine completion of a homogeneous Fourier-jet positional representation. Algebraically, the same primitives form a finite constant-coefficient difference module: simple roots of the lag-shift operator give Fourier/RoPE characters, repeated nonzero roots give Jordan/Fourier jets, and the repeated unit root gives ALiBi-like affine recency.
  The framework separates scalar PJ-bias kernels from exact PJ-rotary feature transforms, introduces adaptive sector diagnostics, and uses LC/rapidity coordinates to stabilize high-order jets. Controlled probes verify sector containment and selection; small language runs expose an affine/recency boundary; music-token streams provide the clearest case where LC/affine variants remain strong while carrying measurable high-order corrections; and LC diagnostics show a scale-stability gain coupled to phase-resolution loss.

</details>


### [196] [Mamba-Assisted Non-Markovian Closure for Reduced-Order Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05371)
*Zhi-Feng Wei,Saad Qadeer,Panos Stinis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Mamba-Assisted Closure (MAC)框架，利用Mamba序列模型替代Mori-Zwanzig形式中的非马尔可夫闭包项，通过状态空间模型的双重表示实现高效训练与推理，在粘性Burgers方程和Lorenz '96系统上显著优于马尔可夫降阶模型、GRU序列模型及Wilks方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维动力系统的降阶建模常因非马尔可夫闭包项（表征未解析变量对解析变量的影响）而受阻，现有方法难以准确捕捉该记忆效应。

Method: 受Mori-Zwanzig形式启发，将闭包建模转化为序列建模问题。采用Mamba模型（基于状态空间模型）作为序列模型，利用其双重表示：训练时通过卷积形式进行序列到序列学习，部署时通过循环形式进行自回归逐步 rollout，实现高效长轨迹训练和恒定每步推理成本。模型与降阶控制方程通过数值积分器耦合。

Result: 在粘性Burgers方程和混沌双尺度Lorenz '96系统上，MAC模型在预测精度和长时间 rollout 稳定性方面显著优于马尔可夫降阶模型、GRU序列模型和Wilks方法。

Conclusion: 将Mamba序列模型用于非马尔可夫闭包建模有效且高效，展示了状态空间模型双重表示在动力系统降阶中的实用价值。

Abstract: Reduced-order modeling of high-dimensional dynamical systems is often hindered by the non-Markovian closure term that represents the effect of unresolved variables on the resolved dynamics. Inspired by the Mori--Zwanzig formalism, in which the closure takes the form of a memory functional of the resolved trajectory, we recast closure modeling as a sequence modeling problem and propose the Mamba-Assisted Closure (MAC) framework: a Mamba-based sequence model, trained to predict the closure from the resolved trajectory, is coupled with the reduced-order governing equations through a numerical integrator to advance the resolved variables in time. A key feature of the framework is its exploitation of the dual representation of state-space models -- the model is trained in a sequence-to-sequence fashion via the convolutional form, and deployed for step-by-step autoregressive rollout via the recurrent form, yielding both efficient long-trajectory training and constant per-step inference cost. On the viscous Burgers' equation and the chaotic two-scale Lorenz '96 system, the MAC model substantially outperforms the Markovian reduced-order model, the GRU-based sequence model, and the Wilks method in predictive accuracy and long-time rollout stability.

</details>


### [197] [Evidence-Guided Neural Architecture Selection under Uncertainty for Subject-Specific Blood Glucose Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05373)
*Md Azharul Islam,Dwyer Deighan,Tarunraj Singha,Danial Faghihi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出EVIDENT框架，通过贝叶斯训练、基于证据的排序和不确定性下的任务特定验证，在有限、噪声和异构数据中实现可靠的时间序列神经网络架构选择，在1型糖尿病血糖预测中验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在数据有限、噪声大且异构的时间序列预测场景下，标准启发式架构设计与验证方法无法确保准确可靠的预测和泛化，亟需可靠的神经架构选择方法。

Method: EVIDENT框架整合了贝叶斯训练、基于证据的排序和不确定性下的任务验证，通过探索候选架构池，识别满足预设验证标准的最低容量模型，并支持多架构竞争时的加权集成预测。

Result: 在1型糖尿病血糖预测任务中，EVIDENT系统性地拒绝了过参数化和欠参数化的TCN架构，识别出在未见患者上可靠泛化的模型；相比随机搜索基线，发现了更小且预测更一致的架构。

Conclusion: EVIDENT为数据有限、异构的高风险预测场景提供了一种可靠的神经架构发现策略，能够实现可靠的模型选择。

Abstract: Reliable neural architecture selection is an open challenge in time-series forecasting under limited, noisy, and heterogeneous data, where standard heuristic architecture design and validation approaches fail to ensure accurate and reliable prediction and generalization. We propose EVIDENT (EVidence-based IDEntification of Neural archiTectures), a framework for architecture selection that integrates Bayesian training, evidence-based ranking, and task-specific validation under uncertainty. The framework explores the candidate architecture pool and identifies the lowest-capacity model that satisfies a prescribed validation criterion. We demonstrate this method using temporal convolutional networks (TCNs) for individualized blood glucose forecasting in type 1 diabetes patients. The results show that EVIDENT systematically rejects both under- and over-parameterized TCN architectures on population-level diabetes data, while identifying models that generalize reliably to unseen patients. When multiple architectures are competitive, the framework further supports plausibility-weighted ensemble predictions that enhance predictive performance. Compared with a random-search baseline, EVIDENT identified smaller architectures with more consistent forecasting performance on unseen patients. These findings establish EVIDENT as a strategy to neural architecture discovery, enabling reliable model selection for high-consequence forecasting in data-limited and heterogeneous settings.

</details>


### [198] [SHALA-LLM: Smartly Handling Ambiguous Labels in Aligning LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05376)
