We make our code and datasets available at github.com/m-anas-j/CaliDist.

</details>


### [235] [SALT: When More Rollouts Don't Help in Group-Based Policy Optimization and How to Make Them Matter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05800)
*Powei Chang,Jinpeng Zhang,Chaoqun Sun,MiniWell Tsao,Lianrui Li,Jianxiang Xiang,Chenyu Wang,Yukang Gao,Dongying Kong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RLVR中的GRPO式分组归一化会导致梯度在低秩有符号几何结构中相互抵消，SALT通过子空间自适应重加权来解决这一问题，提升有效更新几何与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO-style组相对更新中，增加rollout数量并不能可靠地增强学习，因为分组归一化下每个rollout的策略梯度特征会集中到低秩有符号几何结构中，导致聚合时大量相互抵消，削弱有效更新。

Method: 提出SALT组件：从mini-batch Gram几何中估计主导共享子空间，将组相对系数分解为共享通道和残差通道，当有符号抵消严重时自适应放大残差通道的权重。

Result: 在多种推理导向的RLVR基准和模型规模上，SALT在不修改奖励模型或rollout采样过程的情况下，改善了有效更新几何并提升了性能。

Conclusion: SALT通过子空间自适应几何重加权有效解决了GRPO式组归一化中的梯度抵消问题，是一种轻量且有效的即插即用改进方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) often adopts GRPO-style group-relative updates, sampling multiple rollouts per prompt to construct normalized learning signals. However, merely increasing the number of rollouts does not reliably strengthen learning: under GRPO-style group normalization, per-rollout policy-gradient features can concentrate into a low-rank, signed geometry, causing substantial cancellation during aggregation and weakening the effective update. We address this failure mode with SALT, a Subspace-Adaptive geometry pLug-in componenT that uses sample-wise gradient geometry to reweight the coefficients of group-relative updates. SALT estimates a dominant shared subspace from the mini-batch Gram geometry, decomposes group-relative coefficients into shared and residual channels, and adaptively amplifies the residual channel when signed cancellation is severe. Across diverse reasoning-oriented RLVR benchmarks and model scales, SALT improves effective update geometry and performance without modifying the reward model or the rollout sampling procedure

</details>


### [236] [Robust and sparse support vector machine via hybrid truncated loss for supervised classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05814)
*Yuliang Yang,Chen Chen,Yuxiang Liu,Huiru Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合截断损失函数L_ht，构建了单视图L_ht-SVM模型及其多视图扩展MvL_ht-SVM，通过P-驻点建立最优性条件，并设计带工作集策略的ADMM算法实现全局收敛。实验表明，L_ht-SVM在单视图分类中精度更高、支持向量更少、噪声鲁棒性更强，MvL_ht-SVM在多视图分类中优于六种对比方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 凸损失函数（如hinge损失、最小二乘损失）对异常值敏感，而有界非凸损失函数计算成本高，现有损失函数难以同时兼顾稀疏性、有界性和计算效率。

Method: 提出混合截断损失函数L_ht（兼具稀疏性和有界性），构建L_ht-SVM模型；引入P-驻点建立一阶必要充分最优性条件；设计带工作集策略的ADMM算法实现全局收敛；进一步将L_ht-SVM扩展至多视图学习MvL_ht-SVM，加入结构信息和视图权重，遵循一致性与互补性原则。

Result: 在合成、真实世界和图像数据集上，L_ht-SVM相比五种单视图方法精度更高、支持向量更少、噪声鲁棒性更强；MvL_ht-SVM在精度、查准率、查全率和F1分数上优于六种多视图方法。

Conclusion: 混合截断损失函数有效平衡了鲁棒性与计算效率，所提模型在单视图和多视图分类任务中均取得了显著优于现有方法的性能。

Abstract: The support vector machine (SVM) is a widely used classifier, but choosing an appropriate loss function remains difficult. Convex losses such as the hinge loss and least-squares loss are sensitive to outliers, while bounded non-convex losses often lead to high computational cost. To address this, we propose a hybrid truncated loss function ($L_{\mathrm{ht}}$) that is both sparse and bounded, and build the $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM model for single-view classification. We introduce the P-stationary point and use it to establish the first-order necessary and sufficient optimality conditions. Based on these conditions, we design an alternating direction method of multipliers with a working-set strategy that reduces computational cost and achieves global convergence. We further extend $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM to multi-view learning by adding structural information and view weights, resulting in Mv$L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM, which follows both the consensus and complementarity principles. Experiments on synthetic, real-world, and image datasets show that $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM achieves higher accuracy with fewer support vectors and better noise robustness than five single-view methods, while Mv$L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM outperforms six multi-view methods in accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score.

</details>


### [237] [Consistency Training Along the Transformer Stack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05817)
*Sukrati Gautam,Neil Shah,Arav Dhoot,Bryan Maruyama,Caroline Wei,Rohan Kapoor,Robert Sidey,Prakhar Gupta,Zi Cheng Huang,David Demitri Africa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文扩展了一致性训练在模型对齐中的应用，提出了两种新的内部一致性目标（MLPCT和AttCT），并在四种新的安全威胁场景下验证了其有效性，发现跨威胁泛化能力，并揭示了不同一致性训练方法的机制差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的一致性训练主要针对谄媚和越狱攻击等有限场景，作者希望拓宽其应用范围，探索一致性训练是否能在更多安全威胁场景下减少模型失调，并建立统一的防御框架。

Method: 提出了两种新的内部一致性目标：MLP一致性训练（MLPCT，匹配后激活MLP状态）和注意力一致性训练（AttCT，匹配每头注意力分布）。在四种新的安全威胁（人物角色上下文学习攻击、对抗性挫败、前缀攻击、条件性失调）上进行评估。

Result: 一致性训练在多种模型和威胁场景下显著减少了失调，超越了先前工作中仅适用于谄媚和越狱的设置。观察到跨威胁泛化现象，即针对一种失败模式训练能提升对另一种的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 一致性训练是一个灵活且可扩展的对齐框架，能够统一防御更广泛类别的模型病理行为。ACT、MLPCT和AttCT共享残差流机制，而BCT在机制上具有独特性。

Abstract: Consistency training encourages models to behave similarly across different contexts, and has shown promise for reducing misalignment. We broaden the scope of consistency training in two ways. First, we introduce two new internal consistency targets: MLP Consistency Training (MLPCT), which matches post-activation MLP states, and Attention Consistency Training (AttCT), which matches per-head attention distributions. Second, we apply consistency training to four additional safety threats: persona in-context learning attacks, adversarial frustration, prefill attacks, and conditional misalignment. Across several models and threat settings, we find that consistency training reduces misalignment well beyond the sycophancy and jailbreak settings studied in prior work. We also find cases of cross-threat generalization, where training against one failure mode improves robustness to another, and identify a shared residual-stream mechanism underlying ACT, MLPCT, and AttCT, while distinguishing BCT as mechanistically distinct. Our results suggest that consistency training is a flexible and extensible framework for alignment, capable of unifying defenses against a broader class of model pathologies.

</details>


### [238] [GenAutoML: An Agentic Framework for Dynamic Architecture Generation and Optimization in Time-Series Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05860)
*Oleeviya Babu Poikarayil,Cédric Schockaert,Abdulrahman Nahhas,Christian Daase,Mursal Dawodi,Jawid Ahmad Baktash*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GenAutoML是一种基于大语言模型的智能体框架，能够根据自然语言需求自动生成轻量级时序预测与异常检测神经网络架构，其中WaveInterferenceNet在保持竞争力的同时实现了低于0.01ms/样本的推理延迟，适用于边缘AI部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统AutoML系统依赖静态预定义的搜索空间，难以适应多样化数据特征；同时时序预测与异常检测的神经架构设计需要大量领域专业知识且资源消耗大。

Method: 提出GenAutoML框架，包含三个核心组件：1) 以LLM为神经架构师，将自然语言需求转化为可执行的PyTorch实现；2) Sandboxed Reflection Loop实现自主代码优化与反射；3) Signature-Aware Runtime确保架构一致性与执行安全性。此外引入Dynamic Reversible Instance Normalization (Dyn-RevIN)包装器增强非平稳条件下的鲁棒性。

Result: 在ETTh1、ETTm1和Weather基准测试上，GenAutoML能动态生成适配数据集特性的任务特定架构。其中WaveInterferenceNet实现每样本0.01ms以下的推理延迟，同时保持有竞争力的预测性能。

Conclusion: GenAutoML通过强调计算效率、架构适应性和稳定优化行为，能够创建适用于资源受限和延迟敏感的Edge AI部署的超轻量级神经网络，为AutoML在时序任务中的应用提供了新范式。

Abstract: Designing neural architectures for time-series forecasting and anomaly detection remains a resource-intensive task that often requires substantial domain expertise. Traditional Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) systems typically rely on static, predefined search spaces, limiting their ability to adapt to diverse data characteristics. We present GenAutoML, an agentic framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) as neural architects to bridge natural-language requirements and executable PyTorch implementations. The framework incorporates a Sandboxed Reflection Loop for autonomous code refinement and a Signature-Aware Runtime that enforces architectural consistency and execution safety. To improve robustness under non-stationary conditions, we further introduce a Dynamic Reversible Instance Normalization (Dyn-RevIN) wrapper. Experiments on the ETTh1, ETTm1, and Weather benchmarks demonstrate that GenAutoML can dynamically generate task-specific neural architectures tailored to dataset characteristics. Among the generated models, WaveInterferenceNet achieves inference latency below 0.01 ms per sample while maintaining competitive predictive performance. By emphasizing computational efficiency, architectural adaptability, and stable optimization behavior, GenAutoML enables the creation of ultra-lightweight neural networks suitable for resource-constrained and latency-sensitive Edge AI deployments.

</details>


### [239] [Deciphering Two Training Clocks in Grokking via Deep Linear Network Theory with Conditional ReLU Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05863)
*Hu Tan,Kuo Gai,Shihua Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出了"两个训练时钟"的概念，形式化了分类损失的快速衰减与表示简化的慢速过程在深度线性网络和ReLU网络中的分离现象，并通过模加法实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解释"Grokking"现象——训练数据拟合与潜在简单规则学习发生在不同时间尺度上的机制。

Method: 1) 提出"两个训练时钟"框架：分类损失快速衰减与表示简化慢速过程；2) 深度线性网络：后间隔间隙增长或单步尾收缩条件使交叉熵损失在对数时间尺度上降到ε；3) 引入逐层权重衰减→端到端映射的Schatten型惩罚→在Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz尾部条件下结构能在多项式时间尺度上收敛；4) ReLU MLP：激活模式固定时退化为线性模型；两层ReLU嵌入模型中，分类头获得更大有效梯度，支持"先拟合后简化"的两阶段机制。

Result: 深度线性网络：分类损失在对数时间尺度快速下降，表示简化在多项式时间尺度慢速完成；ReLU网络：分类头先拟合，嵌入表示后续简化；模加法实验验证了该两时钟分离现象。

Conclusion: 形式化了Grokking现象中拟合与泛化不同时间尺度的内在机制。深度线性理论提供了严格核心分析，ReLU结果以条件约简形式解释经验行为，而非全局非线性训练动态证明。

Abstract: Grokking suggests that fitting the training data and learning a simple underlying rule may occur on different time scales. We formalize this phenomenon by separating the fast decay of the classification loss from the slower simplification of the learned representation, and we call the resulting pair of stopping times two training clocks. For deep linear networks, we show that a post-margin gap-growth or one-step tail-contraction condition reduces the cross-entropy loss to level epsilon on a logarithmic time scale. In contrast, when layerwise weight decay is present, the induced regularization on the end-to-end map can be expressed as a Schatten-type penalty; under a sharp late-time Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz tail, this structural energy closes on a polynomial time scale. The two clocks, therefore, separate fitting from representation simplification. We then explain how the same mechanism can appear in ReLU MLPs. In regions where the activation patterns on the training set remain fixed, the network reduces to a linear model in the active coordinates. In a two-layer ReLU embedding model, chain-rule estimates further show that the classifier head can receive larger effective gradients than the embedding block under controlled downstream norms. This supports a two-stage mechanism in which the classifier fits first, while the representation continues to simplify later. We use modular addition as the main experimental setting. The deep linear theory provides the rigorous core of the analysis. But the ReLU results are formulated as conditional reductions that account for empirical behavior without claiming a global proof for nonlinear training dynamics.

</details>


### [240] [TS-ICL: A Flexible Time-Indexed Foundation Model for Time Series via In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05878)
*Etienne Le Naour,Tahar Nabil,Adrien Petralia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TS-ICL，一种基于概率上下文学习的编码器-回归器Transformer，统一了时间序列预测和插补任务，在插补任务上达到SOTA，在预测任务上与领先基础模型竞争力相当，尤其擅长部分观测回溯窗口下的预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型主要聚焦于预测任务，但现实中的时间序列常常是不规则且部分观测的，需要模型能够同时处理预测、缺失值插补以及降采样条件下的建模。

Method: 提出TS-ICL，一个概率式上下文学习（In-Context Learning）编码器-回归器Transformer。将时间序列任务建模为时间戳对齐的回归问题，通过新颖的因果数据先验生成合成依赖结构来自然融入协变量。

Result: 在插补任务上达到新SOTA；在单变量和协变量感知基准上，与领先的预测基础模型保持竞争力；在部分观测回溯窗口下的预测任务中表现尤为出色。

Conclusion: TS-ICL成功统一了预测与插补两大时间序列任务，在多种退化采样条件下均表现出强鲁棒性，推动了时间序列基础模型向通用零样本模型的发展。

Abstract: Foundation models mark a profound paradigm shift in time series modeling, with task-specific models being superseded by general-purpose zero-shot models. Yet, current approaches primarily focus on forecasting, while real-world time series are often irregularly and partially observed, requiring models that can jointly forecast, impute missing values, and handle degraded sampling conditions. To address these challenges, we introduce TS-ICL, a novel probabilistic In-Context Learning encoder--regressor Transformer that unifies forecasting and imputation. TS-ICL formulates time series tasks as timestamp-aligned regression and naturally incorporates covariates by training on synthetic dependency structures generated from a novel causal data prior. Empirically, TS-ICL achieves a new state-of-the-art in imputation, while remaining competitive with leading forecasting foundation models across both univariate and covariate-aware benchmarks. It shows particularly strong performance in forecasting with partially observed look-back windows.

</details>


### [241] [When Denser Credit Is Not Enough: Evidence-Calibrated Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05885)
*Yuanfan Li,Qi Zhou,Wenjing Duan,Lu Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ECPO算法，通过证据校准的动作优势估计和方差门控信用加权，解决长程LLM智能体在稀疏奖励下基于组的策略优化中存在的锚点偏差和训练振荡问题，在ALFWorld和WebShop任务上显著优于GiGPO等基线，且计算开销极低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于组的方法（如GiGPO）虽能通过锚点状态构建步骤级优势，但在有限 rollout 下，稀有但偶然获得高回报的动作可能被赋予过大的优势估计，导致锚点偏差和后期训练振荡，需要更可靠的步骤级信用分配方法。

Method: 提出Evidence-Calibrated Policy Optimization (ECPO)，包含两个核心组件：1) Evidence-Calibrated Action Advantage (ECAA)——按规范动作对rollout分组，对低计数估计进行收缩以校准优势；2) Variance-Gated Credit Weighting (VGCW)——抑制由组内噪声主导的锚点状态。整体为无critic的策略优化算法。

Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上使用Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B进行实验，ECPO持续优于强基线。相比GiGPO，在Qwen2.5-1.5B上ALFWorld提升+5.2个成功点，WebShop提升+7.3个成功点，且优势计算开销仅增加0.1%。

Conclusion: ECPO通过校准步骤级信用实现了更稳定有效的长程LLM智能体训练，验证了在稀疏奖励场景下无critic策略优化的可行性，且计算效率极高。

Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents require reinforcement learning methods that can assign credit to intermediate decisions under sparse and delayed rewards. Recent group-based methods such as GiGPO improve over GRPO by constructing step-level advantages at repeated anchor states. However, we show that such dense credit can be statistically unreliable: under limited rollouts, rare but lucky actions may receive overly large advantages, producing divergent anchor bias and late-stage training oscillation. We propose Evidence-Calibrated Policy Optimization (ECPO), a critic-free policy optimization algorithm that calibrates step-level credit before policy updates. ECPO combines Evidence-Calibrated Action Advantage, which groups rollouts by canonical actions and shrinks low-count estimates, with Variance-Gated Credit Weighting, which suppresses anchor states dominated by within-action noise. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B show that ECPO consistently outperforms strong baselines, improving GiGPO by +5.2/+7.3 success points on ALFWorld/WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B while adding only 0.1% additional advantage-computation overhead.

</details>


### [242] [High-Dimensional Theory of LoRA Fine-Tuning in a Solvable Attention Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05899)
*O. Duranthon,F. Boncoraglio,L. Zdeborová*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了注意力模型中低秩适配（LoRA）的高维统计理论，通过可解框架刻画了预训练与微调之间的相互作用，在单头注意力层上先进行数据丰富的预训练，再通过秩一LoRA更新在有限数据上微调。在高维极限下，两阶段均可用有限序参数集进行尖锐的渐近刻画，得到测试误差和表示对齐的显式预测。分析表明预训练对LoRA的影响可归结为有效噪声项，由此推导出最优预训练策略，并发现了测试误差与表示质量不匹配的区域，以及该理论在主动微调中的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 缺乏对LoRA在注意力模型中预训练与微调交互作用的理论理解，现有理论无法精确刻画高维场景下的行为。

Method: 构建单头注意力层的可解框架，先在大数据上预训练，再通过秩一LoRA在有限数据上微调；利用高维渐近分析，用有限序参数集刻画两阶段行为。

Result: 预训练对LoRA的影响可归结为有效噪声项；推导出最优预训练策略；发现测试误差与表示质量不匹配的区域。

Conclusion: 该理论为LoRA提供了精确的统计刻画，揭示了预训练与微调的本质交互机制，并可用于指导主动微调等实际应用。

Abstract: We develop a high-dimensional statistical theory of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) in attention models, capturing the interplay between pre-training and fine-tuning. We introduce a solvable framework in which a single-head attention layer is first pre-trained on a data-abundant task and subsequently adapted via a rank-one LoRA update on limited data. In the high-dimensional limit, both stages admit a sharp asymptotic characterization in terms of a finite set of order parameters, yielding explicit predictions for test errors and representation alignment. Our analysis shows that the impact of pre-training on LoRA is summarized by an effective noise term, from which we derive prescriptions for the optimal pre-training procedure. We also demonstrate a regime with a mismatch between the value of the test error and representation quality, and propose an application of our theory to active fine-tuning.

</details>


### [243] [Addressing Imbalance in Multi-Label Data via Label-Specific Distance-based Oversampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05927)
*Bin Liu,Jun Wu,Haoyu Peng,Ao Zhou,Jin Wang,QiaoSong Chen,Grigorios Tsoumakas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对多标签分类中标签分布不平衡问题，本文提出了一种基于标签特定距离的过采样方法LSDMLO，通过构建加权相关特征空间来识别标签一致的近邻，从而生成更有效的合成实例，在多个基准分类器上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有过采样方法依赖欧氏距离在整个特征空间检索近邻信息，忽略了不同特征对不同标签的语义相关性差异，导致近邻间标签不一致，进而引入标签混淆和过拟合问题。

Method: 提出LSDMLO方法，通过推导标签特定距离，在加权相关特征空间中识别标签一致的近邻，以此选择能表达边界区域标签相关性的种子实例，生成与原始数据标签分布一致的合成实例。

Result: 综合实验表明，LSDMLO在多种基分类器下均优于当前最先进的多标签采样方法。

Conclusion: LSDMLO通过引入标签特定距离有效解决了多标签过采样中的近邻标签不一致问题，是一种更有效的多标签不平衡处理方法。

Abstract: The complex imbalanced label distribution poses a crucial challenge to multi-label classification, as most classifiers are biased towards the majority class and high-frequent labels. Oversampling is an efficient and flexible solution that augments instances to provide a more balanced training dataset for multi-label classifiers. Most existing oversampling methods create synthetic instances in a heuristic way that essentially relies on neighborhood information retrieved using Euclidean distance within the entire feature space. However, they fail to consider the varying semantic relevance of features to different labels, leading to label inconsistency among proximate neighbors and further introducing label confusion and overfitting to synthetic instances. To overcome the above issue, we propose a novel sampling approach called Label-Specific Distance-based Multi-Label Oversampling (LSDMLO) that creates more useful and well-labeled synthetic instances to address the imbalance in multi-label datasets. LSDMLO derives the label-specific distance to identify label-consistent neighbors based on the weighted pertinent feature space, which facilitates selecting seed instances that express more label correlations in boundary areas and generating synthetic instances aligned with the label distribution of original data. The comprehensive experiments verify that the proposed LSDMLO outperforms the state-of-the-art multi-label sampling approaches under various base classifiers.

</details>


### [244] [Short paper: Models in the dark -- Rectification and erasure under GDPR in ML supply chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05946)
*Henrik Graßhoff,Malte Hansen,Meiko Jensen,Sara Ramezanian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文全面调查了GDPR中更正权和删除权在机器学习模型中的实施挑战，指出许多法律要求在技术上尚无法实现，并引入"黑箱模型"概念分析ML供应链中的透明度与可追溯性问题，旨在弥合法律要求与技术实现之间的鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GDPR规定的更正权和删除权对保护个人隐私至关重要，但在机器学习系统中的有效执行面临挑战。现有研究多从法律或技术单一视角出发，且忽视了模型在涉及多个参与者的复杂供应链中生产的事实，因此需要跨学科的综合研究。

Method: 本文采用跨学科视角，对学术文献和来自数据保护机构的指南进行系统性调查，分析GDPR更正权和删除权在ML模型中的实施挑战，特别关注ML供应链中的问题。

Result: 研究发现许多GDPR要求在技术上尚无法在实践中实现；ML供应链中产生的问题在现有研究中未得到充分解决；下游模型（"黑箱模型"）缺乏足够的透明度和可追溯性，带来了紧迫挑战。

Conclusion: 本文通过引入"黑箱模型"概念并分析其挑战，弥合了法律要求与ML中数据主体权利技术实现之间的鸿沟，为可信人工智能的发展提供支持。

Abstract: The rights to rectification and erasure, as established under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), are central to protecting individuals' privacy. However, their effective enforcement in machine learning (ML) systems remains challenging. Existing work has largely addressed these rights from either a legal or a technical perspective in isolation and disregards the fact that models are produced in complex supply chains involving multiple actors across development, distribution, and deployment. This paper presents a holistic survey of challenges in implementing the rights to rectification and erasure in ML models. Drawing on academic literature and guidance from data protection authorities, we find that many GDPR requirements cannot yet be technically met in practice. Our findings further suggest that issues arising in ML supply chains are insufficiently addressed in research. To tackle this gap, we introduce the notion of models in the dark -- derived models created further downstream in an ML chain without sufficient transparency or traceability -- and analyse the urgent challenges posed by this phenomenon. By adopting an interdisciplinary perspective, this work contributes to bridging the gap between legal requirements and the technical implementation of data subject rights in ML, ultimately supporting the development of trustworthy artificial intelligence.

</details>


### [245] [Dead Directions: Geometric Singular Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05957)
*Tejas Pradeep Shirodkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了奇异学习理论与信息几何之间的桥梁，通过"死亡方向"这一原始概念，将Fisher度量的退化方向与KL散度的消失速率关联起来。核心发现是：Fisher曲率沿奇异方向的衰减率可以恢复Watanabe真实对数规范阈值中的单方向贡献，并将这一方法扩展到多分量交叉、多重性、奇异涨落等情形。进一步，将该速率提升到深度网络中，通过K-FAC分解将Fisher块分解为激活侧和梯度侧速率的乘积，并引入商定理将其推广到梯度流下的规范商空间。最后构建了DDCAdam优化器，使得可以从单个检查点的前向和后向传播中直接读出Watanabe三元组(λ, m, ν)，无需后验采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奇异学习理论在解析坐标下计算贝叶斯不变量，而信息几何在原始坐标下工作但假设非退化性，过参数化模型常常违反这一假设。两者在平行研究中缺少统一框架，本文旨在弥合这一鸿沟。

Method: 定义"死亡方向"作为Fisher度量退化方向与奇异集切线的统一概念，证明其KL阶可从原始坐标中Fisher曲率的方向衰减率恢复；通过K-FAC分解将单层速率扩展到多层网络；引入规范商定理使速率在G-不变度量下传递；设计DDCAdam优化器使轨迹速率可观测。

Result: 建立了Fisher曲率衰减率与Watanabe真实对数规范阈值单方向贡献的对应关系；将速率恢复扩展到多分量交叉、多重性m、奇异涨落ν、先验RLCT偏移和 tempered 后验；在深度网络中实现了Fisher块的激活-梯度双面对偶分解；证明SGD满足而标准Adam不满足商定理条件；构建了DDCAdam优化器。

Conclusion: 本文提供了一个参数坐标下的奇异几何处理工具，支持按架构封闭形式的理论预测，并能从单个检查点的前向和后向传播中获取Watanabe三元组(λ, m, ν)，无需后验采样。

Abstract: Singular learning theory and information geometry have studied the same parameter spaces in mostly separate vocabularies: the former computes Bayesian invariants in resolved coordinates, the latter works in original coordinates under a non-degeneracy assumption that overparameterised models routinely violate. We bridge them through one primitive, the dead direction: a unit vector along which the Fisher metric degenerates, equivalently a tangent to the analytic singular set with a definite KL order, set by how fast the KL divergence vanishes. The two readings name the same vector; our central move shows its KL order is recoverable as the decay rate of the directional Fisher curvature approaching the singularity, in original parameter coordinates and without a Hironaka resolution. A selection rule on smooth fibres translates this rate into Watanabe's single-direction contribution to the real log canonical threshold, and we extend the recovery to multi-component crossings, multiplicity $m$, the singular fluctuation $ν$ (universal in the KL order for 1D directions), prior-RLCT shifts, and tempered posteriors. We then lift this rate to a deep network: a multi-layer K-FAC factorisation writes each Fisher block as a product of activation- and gradient-side rates with a duality between them, instantiated at modern-network primitives (residual streams, layer normalisation, attention). A quotient theorem carries the rate to the gauge quotient $Θ/G$ under gradient flow on a $G$-invariant metric; SGD qualifies, standard Adam does not, and we construct a $G$-equivariant Adam-family preconditioner (DDCAdam) that does. The bridge yields a parameter-coordinate handle on singular geometry, closed-form per-architecture predictions, and a trajectory-rate readout of Watanabe's triple $(λ, m, ν)$ from one checkpoint's forward and backward passes, without posterior sampling.

</details>


### [246] [Steering Vectors are an Adversarial Attack Surface](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05958)
*Abzal Aidakhmetov,Donato Crisostomi,Tommaso Mencattini,Adrian Robert Minut,Iacopo Masi,Emanuele Rodolà*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了一种针对LLM激活引导管道的隐蔽数据投毒攻击：通过替换引导数据集中4-6%的标记，攻击者可以使生成的引导向量与拒绝方向对齐，从而破解目标模型，同时保持对良性提示的预期引导效果。攻击者可以分发包含文本、向量和权重的看似安全的数据包，并附上等价性证书。测试表明，投毒向量在多个模型上达到20-55%的绝对攻击成功率，比干净参考高19-51%。一种拒绝方向正交化防御可以恢复约82%的ASR差距而不损害良性行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活引导作为一种无需微调即可控制LLM行为的流行技术，因其即插即用的特性，用户会共享数据集和预计算向量。这种共享机制引入了安全风险，即恶意攻击者可能通过投毒引导数据集来破坏模型的拒绝机制，从而实现越狱攻击。

Method: 攻击者通过替换引导数据集中4-6%的标记，使生成的引导向量与反拒绝方向对齐。攻击者可以分发包含文本、向量、权重及等价性证书的看似安全的数据包。防御方法采用拒绝方向正交化。

Result: 在两种开源模型家族和八种模型-属性组合上，投毒向量的绝对攻击成功率达到20-55%，比干净参考高19-51%。拒绝方向正交化防御可恢复约82%的ASR差距，且不损害良性行为。

Conclusion: 激活引导管道存在隐蔽的数据投毒攻击风险，但通过拒绝方向正交化可以有效地防御此类攻击，同时保持良性行为不受影响。

Abstract: Activation steering has become a popular way to control Large Language Model (LLM) behavior without fine-tuning. Since the technique is plug-and-play, users share datasets and precomputed vectors to steer model activations. However, we show that a \emph{stealth data poisoning attack} silently compromises this pipeline. By substituting $4{-}6\%$ of tokens in the steering dataset, an attacker can silently align the resulting vector with an anti-refusal direction. This jailbreaks the target model while preserving the intended steering effect on benign prompts. Under this threat model, a malicious actor can distribute an apparently safe bundle containing texts, vectors, and weights, alongside an equivalence certificate that the end-user can verify. We test the attack on two open-weight model families and eight model-attribute combinations, observing that poisoned vectors reach an absolute attack success rate (ASR) of $20{-}55\%$, $+19\%$ to $+51\%$ over a clean reference. Finally, we find that a refusal-direction orthogonalization defense can recover ${\approx}82\%$ of the ASR gap without harming benign behavior.

</details>


### [247] [LLM Explainability with Counterfactual Chains and Causal Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05972)
*Nirit Nussbaum-Hoffer,Nitay Calderon,Liat Ein-Dor,Roi Reichart*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种四阶段方法，利用因果图来建模LLM推理过程，通过发现可解释的概念、映射概念状态、MCMC启发的反事实数据增强以及因果发现，生成可解释的概念级因果图，从而提供LLM推理过程的透明视图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作使用LLM恢复外部世界过程的因果图，但缺乏对LLM自身推理过程的透明理解。本文旨在通过因果图建模LLM推理，使利益相关者能够透明地看到模型如何感知和组织高层概念以产生预测。

Method: 提出四阶段方法：(1) 发现类判别性、人类可解释的概念；(2) 将每个输入映射到LLM感知的概念状态；(3) 引入MCMC启发的反事实增强过程，通过反事实链扩展稀疏观测数据；(4) 使用σ-CG进行稳定的因果发现，生成信息丰富的可解释因果图。

Result: 在三个LLM上应用于疾病诊断、情感分析和LLM-as-a-judge分类任务。评估了学习到的因果图的预测保真度和结构稳定性，以及MCMC启发的增强在收敛性和下游效用方面的表现。结果表明发现的因果图捕捉到了与LLM推理一致的有意义依赖关系。

Conclusion: 本文为LLM的概念级可解释性提供了基础，通过因果图有效揭示了LLM内部推理过程中高层概念间的依赖关系。

Abstract: Causal graphs provide a high-level language for making mechanisms transparent. Recent work uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to recover causal graphs of external-world processes. Instead, in this paper, we use causal graphs to model LLM inference itself, providing stakeholders with a transparent view of how the model perceives and organizes high-level concepts to produce a prediction. We propose a four-phase method for constructing such graphs. Given a target LLM and a set of textual examples, our method discovers class-discriminative, human-interpretable concepts and maps each input to LLM-perceived concept states. We then introduce an MCMC-inspired counterfactual augmentation procedure that expands the sparse observational data through chains of counterfactuals. This enables stable causal discovery with $σ$-CG, yielding informative, interpretable graphs. We apply our method to three LLMs across disease diagnosis, sentiment analysis, and LLM-as-a-judge classification tasks. We evaluate the learned graphs for predictive fidelity and structural stability, and the MCMC-inspired augmentation for convergence and downstream utility. Our results show that the discovered causal graphs capture meaningful dependencies consistent with LLMs' reasoning. Together, this paper provides a foundation for concept-level explainability of LLMs.

</details>


### [248] [Compress-Distill: Reasoning Trace Compression for Efficient Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05988)
*Maxime Griot,Paul Steven Scotti,Tanishq Mathew Abraham*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究对推理模型的长思维链轨迹进行后验压缩，再用于知识蒸馏。实验表明压缩可将训练tokens减少至12-30%，训练速度提升2.0-7.6倍，推理输出长度缩短3-19倍，但原始轨迹在下游准确率上始终最优。压缩轨迹在效率与准确率间提供权衡，而非免费改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理模型产生的长思维链轨迹蒸馏成本高昂，且会鼓励学生模型生成冗长输出，因此需要探索如何在保持性能的前提下压缩这些轨迹以提高训练和推理效率。

Method: 使用两个教师模型（Qwen3.5-397B-A17B和gpt-oss-120B）生成约28.3万条正确轨迹，再用两个指令微调模型将其压缩至原长度的8.6-21.0%。通过48次主网格实验和7次Qwen教师截断消融实验评估压缩效果。

Result: 压缩轨迹将训练tokens降至原始的12-30%，训练速度提升2.0-7.6倍，推理输出缩短3-19倍。但原始轨迹在所有规模和数据下保持最高准确率。模型压缩通常优于或匹配朴素截断，特别是在小规模学生模型上。

Conclusion: 推理轨迹压缩提供了准确率与效率之间的权衡而非免费改进：学生模型可保留原始轨迹96%的准确率，同时获得高达18倍的单token效率提升。在0.8B规模下使用LoRA时，压缩轨迹缩小了与原始轨迹的差距但未超越。

Abstract: Reasoning models produce long chain-of-thought traces that are costly to distill and encourage verbose student outputs. We study post-hoc compression of such traces before knowledge distillation. Two teachers, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and gpt-oss-120B, generate about 283k correct traces each; two instruction-tuned models then compress them to 8.6-21.0% of their original character length. Across a 48-run main grid plus seven Qwen-teacher truncation ablations, compressed traces reduce training tokens to 12-30% of raw, speed up training by 2.0-7.6x, and shorten inference outputs by 3-19x with smaller reductions under the shorter gpt-oss teacher. However, raw traces retain the highest downstream accuracy at every scale and for both teachers. A length-matched raw-trace truncation ablation shows that compression is not merely benefiting from a smaller token budget: model-compressed traces usually beat or match naive truncation, especially for smaller students, while maintaining shorter inference outputs. Overall, reasoning-trace compression offers an accuracy-efficiency trade-off rather than a free improvement: students retain up to 96% of raw-trace accuracy while gaining up to 18x higher per-token efficiency, and at the 0.8B scale under LoRA compressed traces narrow the raw-vs-compressed gap but do not exceed raw.

</details>


### [249] [HoT-SSM:Higher-order Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning with State Space Models for Health Care](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05994)
*Thummaluru Siddartha Reddy,Vempalli Naga Sai Saketh,Yash Punjabi,Mahesh Chandran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HoT-SSM模型，通过超图构建高阶临床概念交互，并利用状态空间模型捕获长程时间依赖，在MIMIC-III/IV数据集上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于医学知识图谱的方法仅能捕获临床概念间的成对关系，无法建模共现或语义相关概念间的高阶交互；同时，大多数表示学习方法要么丢失就诊间的时间信息，要么缺乏显式的长程时间依赖建模机制，限制了在死亡率预测等临床任务上的表现。

Method: 提出HoT-SSM模型：1）对每次就诊，利用领域知识将语义相关的临床概念分组为超边构建超图，保留就诊级临床上下文；2）提出动态超图状态空间模型，显式捕获患者潜在状态随时间演化的过程，同时保留长程信息；3）将学习到的表示用于下游临床预测和推理。

Result: 在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上，HoT-SSM显著优于当前最先进的模型，验证了联合建模高阶临床交互与长程时间依赖的有效性。

Conclusion: HoT-SSM通过超图结构建模高阶临床概念交互，结合状态空间模型捕获长程时间依赖，有效提升了临床预测性能，为解决MKG方法中成对关系限制和时间建模不足的问题提供了新思路。

Abstract: Medical knowledge graphs (MKGs) infused with clinical knowledge have been increasingly used to model electronic health records (EHRs) to support interpretable predictions in healthcare domain. However, existing MKG-based approaches are limited in capturing pairwise relations between clinical concepts (e.g., conditions, procedures, and medications), and restricts their ability to model higher-order interactions among co-occurring or semantically related concepts. In addition, most representation learning methods that leverage MKGs either collapse temporal information across visits or lack an explicit mechanism for modeling long-range temporal dependencies, which is critical for clinical tasks such as mortality prediction. To mitigate these limitations, we propose HoT-SSM, a parameter efficient and higher-order temporal graph reasoning with state space models. For each visit, HoT-SSM constructs hypergraphs by grouping semantically related clinical concepts into hyperedges using domain knowledge, thereby preserving visit-level clinical context. Further, to model the temporal dynamics while learning the representations, we introduce a novel dynamic hypergraph-based state space model that explicitly captures patients latent state evolution over time while preserving long-range information. The learned representations are used for downstream clinical prediction and reasoning. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV datasets shows significant performance improvement over the current state-of-the-art models, demonstrating the effectiveness of jointly modeling higher-order clinical interactions and long-range temporal dependencies.

</details>


### [250] [Diffusion Models for Adaptive Sequential Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06007)
*Haoyang Cao,Minshuo Chen,Yinbin Han,Renyuan Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于顺序前向-反向扩散的框架（Sequential Forward-Backward Diffusion Framework），用于生成适应性的（adapted）时序数据，解决现有扩散模型在时间序列生成中无法捕捉时间依赖和避免未来信息泄露的问题。该方法沿时间序列逐步注入和去除噪声，并基于已生成的历史信息进行条件化建模，同时引入一种新的分数匹配目标以实现高效并行训练。理论上，文章在通用框架下建立了严格的统计保证，并以ReLU网络为例给出了分数近似、分数估计和分布估计的结果。实验在ARMA模型和高斯过程等合成数据上验证了方法有效性，并展示了其在构建均值-方差最优投资组合中的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在静态数据生成中表现优异，但直接扩展到时序数据时往往无法捕捉时间依赖性和信息结构。设计能以适应性（adapted）方式模拟时序数据、避免未来信息前瞻的扩散模型仍是一个开放挑战。

Method: 提出顺序前向-反向扩散框架：沿序列逐步注入和去除噪声，以已生成历史为条件确保适应性。引入新型分数匹配目标实现高效并行训练。理论上建立通用框架下的统计保证，以ReLU网络为具体实例给出分数近似、分数估计和分布估计结果。

Result: 在ARMA模型和高斯过程等合成数据上验证了有效性，并在均值-方差最优投资组合构建中展示了实际应用效果。

Conclusion: 提出的顺序前向-反向扩散框架能够有效生成具有适应性的时序数据，兼顾时间依赖性和信息结构，理论上有严格保证，实证结果验证了方法的有效性。

Abstract: Generating realistic synthetic sequential data is critical in real-world applications across operations research, finance, healthcare, energy systems, and scientific computing, where time-indexed observations are used for prediction, simulation, risk assessment, and data-driven decision-making. While diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generating static data, their direct extensions to sequential settings often fail to capture temporal dependence and information structure. Designing diffusion models that can simulate sequential data in an adapted manner, and hence without anticipation of future information, therefore remains an open challenge.
  In this work, we propose a sequential forward-backward diffusion framework for adapted time series generation. Our approach progressively injects and removes noise along the sequence, conditioning on the previously generated history to ensure adaptiveness. A novel score-matching objective is introduced for efficient parallel training. We derive rigorous statistical guarantees under a generic framework, then establish score approximation, score estimation, and distribution estimation results with ReLU networks serving as a concrete instance. Empirically, we validate our method on synthetic data, including ARMA models and Gaussian processes, and demonstrate its effectiveness in constructing mean-variance optimal portfolios.

</details>


### [251] [Adaptive Oscillatory-State Alignment for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06010)
*Zhangyao Song,Ziqiong Li,Xiangfei Qiu,Chao Zha,Yinfei Xu,Tao Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AOSNET框架，将周期性时间序列预测从固定模板匹配转变为自适应振荡状态对齐，利用希尔伯特变换提取解析信号描述符，通过条件门控实现局部状态自适应校正，在8个基准上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有周期性预测方法依赖预定义周期、全局频谱成分或固定可学习模板，但真实时间序列的振荡行为常伴随幅度调制、相位漂移和局部频率变化，导致固定模板与底层时变状态根本性失配。

Method: AOSNET框架：1) 通过希尔伯特变换从观测序列和可学习的全局振荡先验中提取解析信号描述符（瞬时幅度、相位、频率）；2) 构建描述符条件门控，自适应对齐局部状态，选择性保留可靠观测并软校正失配区域；3) 学习到的先验作为灵活振荡参考而非刚性重复模板。

Result: 在8个基准数据集上达到SOTA或高度竞争性精度且推理速度快；在幅度调制、相位漂移、局部频率变化的受控合成实验中，振荡状态对齐的优势随非平稳性增强而持续增大。

Conclusion: 振荡状态对齐比固定模板匹配更适用于非平稳周期性时间序列预测，希尔伯特变换提供了有效的时变振荡特征描述工具。

Abstract: Long-term time series forecasting benefits from inductive biases that expose recurring temporal structure. Existing periodic forecasting methods typically model recurrence through predefined periods, global spectral components, or fixed learnable templates. However, real-world temporal dynamics are rarely rigidly periodic: oscillatory behavior often evolves through amplitude modulation, phase drift, and local frequency variation. Under these conditions, fixed-template periodic modeling can become fundamentally mismatched to the underlying temporal states. We propose AOSNET, a Hilbert-guided forecasting framework that reformulates periodic forecasting from fixed template matching to adaptive oscillatory-state alignment. AOSNET extracts analytic-signal descriptors from both the observed sequence and a learnable global oscillatory prior, then adaptively aligns local states through a descriptor-conditioned gate that selectively preserves reliable observations while softly correcting mismatched regions. The learned prior serves not as a rigid repeated template but as a flexible oscillatory reference interpreted through local state dynamics. Experiments on eight benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art or highly competitive accuracy with fast inference speed. Controlled synthetic studies isolating amplitude modulation, phase drift, and local frequency variation confirm that the advantage of oscillatory-state alignment consistently increases as non-stationarity intensifies.

</details>


### [252] [OPRD: On-Policy Representation Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06021)
*Shenzhi Yang,Guangcheng Zhu,Bowen Song,Haobo Wang,Mingxuan Xia,Xing Zheng,Yingfan Ma,Zhongqi Chen,Weiqiang Wang,Gang Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出On-Policy Representation Distillation (OPRD)，通过在隐藏状态空间中对齐师生模型表示，替代传统的输出空间知识蒸馏，消除了采样方差，提供了更丰富的逐层结构信息，在AIME 2024/2025和AIMO上缩小了师生差距，并实现1.44倍加速和54%内存节省。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统同策略蒸馏（OPD）仅在输出空间监督学生模型，存在两个局限性：(1) 在大词表（如Qwen的~150k tokens）上Monte Carlo KL估计的采样方差持续存在；(2) 将教师模型视为黑箱，丢弃了LM头之后的所有中间隐藏状态。

Method: OPRD将蒸馏提升到隐藏状态空间，在相同rollout上对齐师生模型选定层的表示，完全绕过LM头部。理论上消除了采样方差，并提供了更丰富的逐层结构信息。

Result: 在AIME 2024/2025和AIMO上，OPRD缩小了师生差距，而输出空间的OPD基线在教师水平以下趋于平稳。OPRD训练速度提升1.44倍，内存使用减少54%。

Conclusion: OPRD通过隐藏状态空间的知识蒸馏有效克服了输出空间蒸馏的采样方差和信息丢失问题，在性能、训练效率和内存使用方面均优于传统OPD方法。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises the student only in output space by matching next-token probabilities. This output-only paradigm has two limits: (1) sampling variance from Monte Carlo KL estimates over large vocabularies (e.g., Qwen's ~150k tokens) persists throughout training, and (2) it treats the teacher as a black-box, discarding all intermediate hidden states after the LM head. We propose On-Policy Representation Distillation (OPRD), which lifts distillation into hidden-state space by aligning student and teacher representations across selected layers on the same rollouts, bypassing the LM head entirely. Theoretically, OPRD eliminates sampling variance and provides richer per-layer structural information. Empirically, OPRD closes the student-teacher gap on AIME 2024/2025 and AIMO, while output-space OPD baselines plateau below the teacher. OPRD also trains 1.44x faster and uses 54% less memory than top-k OPD. Code: https://github.com/ShenzhiYang2000/OPRD.

</details>


### [253] [Catastrophic Forgetting as Accessibility Collapse: A Three-Level Framework for Knowledge Persistence in Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06032)
*Ayushman Trivedi,Bhavika Melwani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过系统性实验证明，灾难性遗忘并非知识的完全擦除，而是知识可访问性的丧失——尽管模型在行为上完全遗忘旧任务（准确率从54.8%降至0%），但线性探测仍保留约76%的表征信息，仅重训最后的分类器即可恢复75.7%的原始性能，表明大量任务相关信息仍嵌入在神经表征中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战"灾难性遗忘=知识不可逆擦除"的传统观点，探究遗忘的本质是否源于信息存储的破坏还是信息访问能力的丧失。

Method: 提出"知识存储-表征-可访问性"三层次框架，在CIFAR-100序列分类任务上基于ResNet-18进行持续学习实验，采用检查点持久性分析、线性探测、表征几何分析、分类器重置恢复和逐层可恢复性实验等多种分析方法。

Result: 行为遗忘中任务准确率从54.8%降至0%，但线性探测保留约76%的表征信息；仅重训分类器即可恢复75.7%的原始性能；早期和中间层保留了高度可恢复的任务信息，而深层退化严重；保留的知识以分布式高维表征形式存在，而非主导子空间。

Conclusion: 灾难性遗忘应被重新定义为可访问性失效而非表征擦除，大量任务相关信息在功能遗忘发生后仍嵌入在神经表征中。

Abstract: Catastrophic forgetting is commonly interpreted as the irreversible erasure of previously acquired knowledge during sequential learning. In this work, we investigate an alternative perspective: that forgetting may arise not from complete destruction of task representations but from a loss of accessibility to preserved information. We introduce a three-level framework separating knowledge storage, representation, and accessibility, and evaluate each component through a series of continual-learning experiments on sequential CIFAR-100 classification using ResNet-18. Our analysis combines checkpoint persistence, linear probing, representation geometry, classifier-reset recovery, and layer-wise recoverability experiments. We observe complete behavioral forgetting of earlier tasks, with task accuracy collapsing from 54.8% to 0%, while linear probe performance retains approximately 76% of the original representational information. Furthermore, retraining only the final classifier restores 75.7% of the original task performance without modifying the backbone network. Layer-wise analysis reveals that early and intermediate layers preserve highly recoverable task information despite severe degradation at later stages. Projection-energy and principal-angle analyses indicate that retained knowledge persists as distributed high-dimensional representations rather than through preservation of a small dominant subspace. These findings suggest that catastrophic forgetting is better characterized as an accessibility failure than complete representational erasure, and that substantial task-relevant information remains embedded within neural representations even after functional forgetting has occurred.

</details>


### [254] [When Good Enough Is Optimal: Multiplication-Only Matrix Inversion Approximation for Quantized Gated DeltaNet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06034)
*Luoming Zhang,Yuwei Ren,Kui Zhang,Tian Liu,Lingjuan Ge,Denghao Li,Matthew Harper Langston,Yin Huang,Weiliang Will Zeng,Liang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对分块并行线性注意力中的矩阵求逆瓶颈，提出基于截断Neumann级数展开的快速MatMul算法，在NPU上实现5倍内核加速和20%解码层开销降低，同时支持低精度推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分块并行线性注意力中矩阵求逆（尤其是下三角矩阵的前向代入法）在NPU上并行度低、硬件利用率差，成为长上下文建模的主要瓶颈。

Method: 利用下三角矩阵逆矩阵的对角集中特性和Neumann级数项的快速衰减，采用截断Neumann展开+结构掩码+并行残差校正消除顺序依赖；针对低比特INT推理，通过抑制矩阵幂运算导致的动态范围扩展进行适配；根据块大小自适应调整近似阶数和残差步长。

Result: 在Qwen3.5系列模型上实现最高5倍内核级加速，解码层开销降低20%，浮点和低精度推理下精度无损。

Conclusion: 提出了一种高效、硬件友好（以MatMul为核心）的线性注意力可扩展解决方案，解决了NPU上长上下文建模的关键效率问题。

Abstract: Matrix inversion in chunk-wise parallel linear attention is a major bottleneck for long-context modeling, particularly on NPUs, where forward-substitution-based methods exhibit limited parallelism and poor hardware utilization. We propose a fast, Matrix Multiplication (MatMul)-based algorithm tailored for strictly lower-triangular matrices arising in chunk-wise linear attention. Motivated by the rapid growth of Neumann-series terms and the diagonal concentration of the inverse matrix, we employ a truncated Neumann expansion with structural masking and parallel residual correction to eliminate sequential dependencies. We further extend our method to low-bits INT by mitigating the dynamic range expansion arising from repeated matrix power operations, and adapt the approximation order and residual step to the chunk size to minimize computational cost while preserving the model's accuracy. Experiments on Qwen3.5-family models demonstrate up to 5$\times$ kernel-level speedup and a 20% reduction in decode-layer overhead, while preserving accuracy under both floating-point and low-precision inference. Our method offers an efficient and hardware-friendly solution for scalable linear attention.

</details>


### [255] [Online KL-Regularized Reinforcement Learning with Function Approximation under Misspecification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06053)
*Haoyang Hong,Zichen Wang,Quanquan Gu,Huazheng Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在模型误设定下，KL正则化上下文赌博机和情节强化学习的理论保证，提出了KL误设定公式并给出了带有显式误设定项的高概率KL遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KL正则化学习算法的理论保证依赖于可实现性假设，无法处理模型误设定情况，而实际场景中模型往往存在误设定，需要建立更鲁棒的理论框架。

Method: 提出了KL误设定公式，用于刻画上下文赌博机和情节强化学习中的模型偏差；采用基于回归的算法结合吉布斯策略更新，从理论上分析其KL遗憾上界。

Result: 建立了高概率KL遗憾界，其中包含显式的误设定项；当误设定为零时，恢复为标准可实现KL正则化设置的结果。

Conclusion: 该工作将KL正则化学习理论推广到了模型误设定场景，为实际应用提供了更坚实的理论基础。

Abstract: We study KL-regularized contextual bandits and episodic reinforcement learning (RL) under general function approximation with model misspecification. Existing guarantees rely on realizability and therefore do not extend to misspecified models, where classical regret bounds may fail. This work introduces KL misspecification formulations for contextual bandits and episodic RL and analyzes regression-based algorithms with Gibbs policy updates. High-probability KL-regret guarantees with explicit misspecification terms are established, recovering the standard realizable KL-regularized setting as a special case.

</details>


### [256] [MDP-GRPO: Stabilized Group Relative Policy Optimization for Multi-Constraint Instruction Following](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06058)
*Mohammad Mahdi Salmani-Zarchi,Zahra Rahimi,Heshaam Faili,Mohammad Javad Dousti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对离散、低离散度奖励下GRPO训练不稳定的问题，提出MDP-GRPO，通过多温度采样、双锚优势、前景理论塑形和非对称KL正则化四项技术，在多项约束跟随任务上提升严格约束满足率最多5.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准GRPO在离散、低离散度奖励下，组内奖励分布常呈同质性，导致z-score组归一化出现低方差放大、均值中心化盲区和零方差坍塌三种病态，训练不稳定。

Method: 提出MDP-GRPO，包含四项改进：(1)多温度采样增加奖励离散度；(2)双锚优势在均匀组中恢复梯度并解决均值中心化盲区；(3)基于Kahneman和Tversky前景理论的塑形函数约束更新并惩罚违规；(4)非对称KL正则化。

Result: 在FollowBench、IFEval和自建多约束数据集上，MDP-GRPO优于标准GRPO，Llama-3.2-3B上严格约束满足率提升最高5.0%；支持小批次稳定收敛，且在MMLU和ARC上保持通用能力。

Conclusion: MDP-GRPO有效解决了离散奖励下GRPO的训练不稳定问题，在多约束指令跟随任务中取得显著提升，同时兼顾了通用能力的保持。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is ideal for multi-constraint instruction following, yet standard group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) becomes unstable under discrete, low-dispersion rewards, where within-group reward distributions are frequently homogeneous. We identify and formalize three pathologies of z-score group normalization in this regime: low-variance amplification, mean-centering blindness, and zero-variance collapse. To address them, we propose MDP-GRPO, which stabilizes learning through (1) multi-temperature sampling to increase reward dispersion, (2) dual-anchor advantages to restore gradients in homogeneous groups and stop mean-centering blindness, (3) prospect-theoretic shaping to bound updates and penalize violations based on Kahneman and Tversky's theory, and (4) asymmetric KL regularization. Evaluated on FollowBench, IFEval, and a curated multi-constraint dataset, MDP-GRPO outperforms standard GRPO, improving strict constraint satisfaction by up to 5.0% on Llama-3.2-3B. Our method also enables stable convergence with small group sizes while preserving general capabilities on MMLU and ARC.

</details>


### [257] [On Advantage Estimates for Max@K Policy Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06080)
*Shota Takashiro,Soichiro Nishimori,Paavo Parmas,Yongmin Kim,Kohsei Matsutani,Gouki Minegishi,Yusuke Iwasawa,Takeshi Kojima,Yutaka Matsuo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究强化学习中推理时目标（如max@K）的策略梯度估计问题，通过基线设计和优势中心化，提出Leave-Two-Out (L2O)基线方法MaxPO，实现无偏且中心化的优势估计，降低梯度方差并提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可验证奖励的强化学习广泛用于推理模型的后训练，但稀疏的结果奖励使得探索困难。虽然可以直接优化推理时目标（如pass@K和max@K），但现有策略梯度估计器使用不同的信号、基线和归一化方法，它们之间的关系不清晰。本文旨在通过基线设计和优势中心化来统一和优化这些估计器。

Method: 从现有领先方法的优势估计器出发，证明其策略梯度无偏但产生非中心化的优势。引入Leave-Two-Out (L2O)基线，在保持策略梯度无偏性的同时，使批次内实现的优势恰好中心化。由此得到MaxPO方法，具有高效的二次时间复杂度实现，可自然融入基于组的RL用于LLM后训练。进一步推导了max@K的规范有限批次优势，提供现有优势估计器的统一视角。

Result: 实证结果表明，L2O基线能够降低梯度方差，并且性能优于非中心化的替代方法。

Conclusion: 通过L2O基线实现优势中心化是提升推理时目标优化效果的有效手段，MaxPO方法兼具理论无偏性和实际方差降低的优势。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is widely used for post-training reasoning models, but sparse outcome rewards make exploration difficult. A complementary approach is to optimize inference-time objectives such as pass@K and max@K directly, yet existing policy-gradient estimators for these objectives use different signals, baselines, and normalizations, making their relationships unclear. We study this issue through baseline design and advantage centering. Starting from the advantage estimator of a leading method in the field, we show that it is policy-gradient unbiased but yields a non-centered advantage. We then introduce a Leave-Two-Out baseline that preserves policy-gradient unbiasedness while making realized batch advantages exactly centered. The resulting method, MaxPO, has an efficient quadratic-time implementation and integrates naturally into group-based RL for LLM post-training. We further derive the canonical finite-batch advantage for max@K, providing a unified view of existing advantage estimators. Empirically, we verify that the L2O baseline reduces gradient variance and outperforms non-centered alternatives.

</details>


### [258] [OrderGrad: Optimizing Beyond the Mean with Order-Statistic Policy Gradient Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06096)
*Paavo Parmas,Yongmin Kim,Kohsei Matsutani,Shota Takashiro,Soichiro Nishimori,Takeshi Kojima,Yusuke Iwasawa,Yutaka Matsuo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OrderGrad 是一种针对顺序统计量目标（如 VaR、CVaR、中位数、Top-K 等）的策略梯度估计方法族，通过简单的奖励变换实现风险规避、鲁棒和探索性学习，在 LLM 数学后训练等任务上优于传统的期望回报优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实应用中许多任务关心回报的分布特性（如尾部风险、异常值鲁棒性、Best-of-K 发现），而传统策略梯度方法仅优化期望回报，与部署目标不匹配。

Method: 提出 OrderGrad，一类基于似然比和重参数化的梯度估计器，用于优化有限样本 L-统计量（加权排序奖励/成本）。通过改变排序权重即可恢复 VaR、CVaR、修剪均值、中位数、Top-M/Best-of-K 等目标，实现为简单的奖励变换，可嵌入标准策略梯度或重参数化更新中。

Result: 对于任意固定样本量和排序权重向量，OrderGrad 能提供对应顺序统计量目标的无偏梯度估计。研究了估计器的方差行为，并在 LLM 数学后训练等任务上验证了有效性。

Conclusion: OrderGrad 提供了一个统一的即插即用方案，用于风险规避、鲁棒和探索性学习，弥补了期望回报优化与部署目标之间的差距。

Abstract: Policy-gradient methods usually optimize expected return, but many real world applications care about distributional properties of returns: tail risk, outlier robustness, or best-of-K discovery. We introduce OrderGrad, a family of likelihood-ratio and reparameterization gradient estimators for order-statistic objectives. OrderGrad optimizes finite-sample L-statistics, i.e., weighted averages of sorted rewards or costs, recovering objectives such as VaR, CVaR, trimmed means, medians, and top-m/best-of-K criteria by changing only the rank weights. For any fixed sample size and rank-weight vector, OrderGrad provides an unbiased gradient estimator for the corresponding order-statistic objective. The method is implemented as a simple reward transformation that can then be used in an otherwise standard policy-gradient or reparameterized update. We study the resulting estimator's variance behavior and evaluate it on tasks where mean optimization is mismatched to the deployment objective, including LLM math post-training and other tasks. OrderGrad provides a unified, plug-and-play route to risk-averse, robust, and exploratory learning.
  Code: https://github.com/paavo5/ordergrad

</details>


### [259] [A Sliced-Wasserstein Framework on Correlation Matrices for EEG Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06104)
*Chen Hu,Rui Wang,Jiale Zhou,Jingjun Yi,Shaocheng Jin,Yidong Song,Yefeng Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于全秩相关矩阵的切比雪夫流形上的Pullback欧几里得度量切片Wasserstein（PEMSW）通用框架，并实例化了两种相关切片Wasserstein（CorSW）散度，用于EEG解码的领域泛化。在三个EEG数据集上验证了其在分布偏移下具有更好的泛化能力，且训练成本低、无额外推理开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG解码中使用的协方差描述子虽对噪声鲁棒，但对通道缩放敏感；全秩相关矩阵作为尺度不变替代方案虽有优势，但缺乏有效的距离度量及领域泛化方法。本文旨在提出适用于相关矩阵流形的分布对齐框架，以提升EEG解码在分布偏移下的泛化性能。

Method: 提出PEMSW通用框架，将切片Wasserstein散度推广到具有Pullback欧几里得度量的流形上；在该框架下，基于Off-Log Metric（OLM）和Log-Scaled Metric（LSM）两种相关矩阵几何，实例化两种CorSW散度，并以此构建EEG解码的领域泛化框架。

Result: 在三个EEG数据集上，所提方法在分布偏移下实现了更好的泛化性能，训练开销低且不增加推理成本。

Conclusion: 基于全秩相关矩阵流形上的切片Wasserstein散度能有效提升EEG解码的领域泛化能力，为相关矩阵几何在EEG领域泛化中的有效应用提供了新思路。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) offers noninvasive, millisecond resolution recordings of neuronal activity and is widely used in neuroscience and healthcare. Many EEG decoding pipelines rely on covariance descriptors for their robustness to noise, but such representations are sensitive to channel-wise scaling. Recent studies have therefore advocated full-rank correlation matrices as a scale-invariant alternative for EEG decoding. In this paper, we propose a general framework for Sliced Wasserstein (SW) discrepancies on manifolds endowed with Pullback Euclidean Metrics (PEMs), termed Pullback Euclidean Metric Sliced Wasserstein (PEMSW). Within this framework, we instantiate two Correlation Sliced-Wasserstein (CorSW) discrepancies on the manifold of full-rank correlation matrices under two recently introduced correlation geometries, \textit{i.e.}, the Off-Log Metric (OLM) and Log-Scaled Metric (LSM). Building on CorSW, we further develop a domain generalization (DG) framework for EEG decoding. Experiments on three EEG datasets demonstrate improved generalization under distribution shifts, with low training overhead and no additional inference cost. The source code is available at https://github.com/ChenHu-ML/CorSW.

</details>


### [260] [Adaptive state-action abstractions via rate-distortion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06123)
*Fernando E. Rosas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在强化学习过程中动态调整抽象粒度（抽象分辨率）的原则：当学习误差变得与抽象误差可比时，就细化抽象。该原则通过性能证书形式化，将值函数误差分解为贝尔曼残差（学习误差界）和双模拟度量（抽象误差界），并利用率-失真原理构建可连续调整分辨率的软状态-动作抽象。在表格型环境中验证了该方法能在高压缩下实现近最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 婴儿学步时先解决粗糙版本问题（保持直立、够到看护人），等到该分辨率下学习不再有效时才细化问题。强化学习虽有多项构建简化任务的技术，但缺乏在动态学习中自适应调整抽象粒度的通用原则。

Method: 提出一个原则：当抽象内部的学误差与抽象本身引入的误差相当时，就应细化抽象。通过性能证书将值误差分解为两项：学习误差界（用贝尔曼残差刻画）和抽象误差界（用双模拟度量刻画）。基于率-失真原理构建软状态-动作抽象，使状态和动作轴的分辨率可连续调整。

Result: 在多种表格型设置中验证了该构建的有效性，表明在状态和动作信息大幅压缩（有损压缩）的情况下，仍能实现近最优性能。

Conclusion: 该原则为强化学习中动态调整抽象粒度提供了理论依据和实用方法，平衡了学习误差与抽象误差，实现了高效学习。

Abstract: When learning to walk, infants seem to address a coarse version of the problem first - stay upright, reach the caregiver - and refine it only when further practice at that resolution stops paying off. Reinforcement learning offers multiple techniques for building simple versions of complex tasks, but lacks general principles for how to dynamically adjust the granularity of these abstractions during learning. This paper proposes one such principle: refine the abstraction as soon as the learning error within it becomes comparable to the error induced by the abstraction itself. Here, we investigate one way of formalising this principle via a performance certificate that decomposes value error into two terms: a learning error bound captured by a Bellman residual, and an abstraction error bound given by a bisimulation metric. The resulting switching strategy is implemented by soft state-action abstractions built from rate-distortion principles, whose resolution along state and action axes can be continuously adjusted. We validate this construction in a range of tabular settings, showing that near-optimal performance can be achieved under substantial lossy compression of state and action information.

</details>


### [261] [Tight list replicability bounds via a novel sphere covering theorem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06148)
*Ari Blondal,Hamed Hatami,Pooya Hatami,Chavdar Lalov,Sivan Tretiak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过证明一个基于Borsuk-Ulam定理的拓扑球面覆盖定理，得到了VC类假设下列表可复现性中列表大小与精度之间的尖锐边界，并分析了不同裕度下大间隔半空间的最优列表大小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 列表可复现性（list replicability）是近期提出的用于形式化学习理论中可复现性的框架。核心问题在于所需的列表大小如何与精度参数以及假设类的自然复杂度度量相关联。现有研究需要得到更精确的边界刻画。

Method: 本文证明了一个新颖的拓扑球面覆盖定理：如果d维球面被开集覆盖，且每个开集都位于一个开半球内，则这些集合中必有d+1个存在公共交集。该定理源于Borsuk-Ulam定理。基于此结果，推导了VC类假设的列表大小与精度之间的sharp bounds，并分析了不同裕度参数下大间隔半空间的最优列表大小。

Result: 对于VC类假设，得到了列表大小与精度之间的尖锐边界关系；对于大间隔半空间，当裕度不太大时，最优列表大小等于环境维度d；当裕度非常大时，存在可复现算法实现最小列表大小⌈d/2⌉+1。

Conclusion: 拓扑球面覆盖定理是推导列表可复现性紧边界的有效工具，不同裕度条件下半空间的最优列表大小存在显著差异，体现了问题结构与复现性需求之间的深层联系。

Abstract: In recent years, list replicability has emerged as a framework for formalizing reproducibility in learning theory. A central question is how the required list size relates to the accuracy parameter and natural complexity measures of the hypothesis class.
  To achieve sharp bounds on list replicability, we prove a novel topological sphere covering theorem, derived from the Borsuk-Ulam theorem. Specifically, if the $d$-sphere is covered by open sets, each of which lies in an open hemisphere, then $d+1$ of these sets must have a common intersection. Using this result, we obtain a sharp bound on the relationship between list size and accuracy for VC classes. We also show that for large-margin half-spaces, provided the margin is not too large, the optimal list size equals the ambient dimension. However, when the margin is taken to be very large, we devise a replicable algorithm achieving the minimal list size of $\lceil d/2 \rceil + 1$.

</details>


### [262] [Trust-Aware Predictive Emissions Monitoring for Gas Turbine Fleets with Limited Labelled Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06156)
*Rebecca Potts,Aiden Durrant,Rick Hackney,Georgios Leontidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种信任感知的概率框架，用于在仅有少量资产有排放标签的情况下，实现燃气轮机机队级别的NOx预测。该框架结合多头循环预测模型、置信度估计、集成不确定性量化、辅助特征预测、特征空间距离分析和运行范围诊断，生成可解释的逐样本信任分数，为无标签涡轮机的预测提供可靠性指示。置信度过滤可将最高置信度10%预测的MAE从0.202降至0.070。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于机器学习的预测性排放监测系统是直接排放测量的实用替代方案，但在仅有少量资产有排放标签的情况下，跨燃气轮机机队部署面临挑战。

Method: 提出信任感知概率框架，结合多头循环预测模型、学习置信度估计、集成不确定性量化、辅助特征预测、特征空间距离分析和运行范围诊断，在标注数据上校准生成可解释的逐样本信任分数。

Result: 置信度过滤将MAE从全覆盖时的0.202降至最高置信度10%预测的0.070；无标签和分布外样本表现出更高的不确定性和更低的置信度。

Conclusion: 该信任框架为无标签涡轮机的排放预测提供了可操作的可靠性信息，支持PEMS在工业机队中更透明、更可信的部署。

Abstract: Machine learning-based predictive emissions monitoring systems offer a practical alternative to direct emissions measurement, but their deployment across gas turbine fleets is challenging when emissions labels are available for only a small subset of assets. In this work, a trust-aware probabilistic framework is proposed for fleet-level gas turbine NOx prediction under limited labelled supervision. The framework combines a multi-head recurrent prediction model with learned confidence estimation, ensemble-based uncertainty quantification, auxiliary feature prediction, feature-space distance analysis, and operating-range diagnostics. These signals are calibrated on labelled data to produce interpretable per-sample trust scores, providing indicators of prediction reliability on unlabelled turbines, supporting the identification of predictions that should be treated with greater caution during fleet-level deployment. Confidence-based filtering reduces MAE from 0.202 at full coverage to 0.070 for the highest-confidence 10\% of predictions, demonstrating that confidence estimates are meaningfully related to prediction error. Unlabelled and out-of-distribution samples exhibit increased uncertainty and reduced confidence, indicating that the framework responds appropriately to distributional shift. The results show that the proposed trust framework provides actionable reliability information for emissions prediction on unlabelled turbines, supporting more transparent and trustworthy deployment of PEMS across industrial fleets.

</details>


### [263] [On the training of physics-informed neural operators for solving parametric partial differential equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06164)
*Nanxi Chen,Chuanjie Cui,Airong Chen,Sifan Wang,Rujin Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了物理信息神经算子（PINO）训练中的关键组件，发现CViT架构表现最优，PINO训练中存在与PINN类似的优化病态，且物理信息训练在某些情况下可媲美甚至超越纯数据驱动方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINO虽然结合了神经算子的跨实例泛化能力和物理信息学习的数据效率，但其高效稳健的训练方法尚不明确，现有研究对数据驱动神经算子和PINN的关注较多，但对PINO训练管道的理解存在空白。

Method: 系统比较三种算子骨干网络（DeepONet、FNO、CViT）在五个参数化PDE系统上的表现，分析架构设计、优化器选择、损失平衡和配点采样策略，并对比物理信息训练与纯数据驱动训练在不同数据规模下的效果。

Result: CViT在所有基准测试中表现一致且稳定；PINO训练中存在梯度冲突和因果违反等优化病态，且PINN中开发的缓解算法在PINO中依然有效；精心设计的物理信息训练管道可在某些场景下匹配甚至超越纯数据驱动方法。

Conclusion: 该研究为PINO训练中的优化挑战提供了系统性的实证理解，并为高效稳健的物理信息算子学习建立了实用管道。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural operators (PINOs) aim to learn solution operators for partial differential equations by using the governing physics as supervision, rather than relying solely on paired input-output simulation data. By incorporating physical constraints into the training objective, PINOs combine the cross-instance generalization of neural operators with the data efficiency of physics-informed learning. Despite this promise, how to train PINOs efficiently and robustly remains less well-understood than the training of either data-driven neural operators or physics-informed neural networks (PINNs). To bridge this gap, we examine key components of the PINO training pipeline, including architecture design, optimizer choice, loss balancing, and collocation-point sampling strategy. We study three representative operator backbones, Deep Operator Network (DeepONet), Fourier Neural Operator (FNO), and Continuous Vision Transformer (CViT), across five diverse parametric PDE systems. Our results show that CViT provides consistently strong and stable performance across the considered benchmarks. Beyond architecture, we find that several optimization pathologies previously identified in PINN training naturally arise in PINOs, including gradient conflicts and causal violation. We also find that mitigation algorithms developed for PINNs remain effective in the PINO setting. We further compare physics-informed and data-driven training under different data regimes, revealing that a carefully designed physics-informed training pipeline can match, and in some cases, outperform purely data-driven neural operators. Taken together, these findings provide a systematic empirical understanding of the optimization challenges in PINO training and inform a practical pipeline for efficient and robust physics-informed operator learning. Code and data are available at https://github.com/NanxiiChen/PI-CViT.

</details>


### [264] [Learning to model pediatric asthma exacerbation from multiple risk factors: a case study in coastal Virginia](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06174)
*Jonathan Colen,Eric Werner,Maryam Golbazi,Heather Richter,Diana McSpadden,Amy Quinn,Jocel Santos,Mary Jane Darling,Mary Margaret Gleason*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文比较了广义线性模型、神经网络和稀疏字典学习三种方法，用于预测弗吉尼亚州汉普顿路地区儿童哮喘急性加重，发现各方法在风险估计上具有一致性，并识别出影响哮喘加重的协同交互因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿童哮喘加重受到空气污染、气象条件和社区社会经济因素的多重影响，在大规模时空数据中分离这些因素的各自贡献是一个挑战，需要既能保持预测能力又具备可解释性的建模方法。

Method: 收集了2018-2023年弗吉尼亚州汉普顿路地区（7个城市、150万人口）的空气污染测量数据、气象数据和社区机会指标，以邮政编码级别建模儿童哮喘急性加重就诊数据。比较了三种方法：（1）广义线性模型（GLM）作为基线；（2）神经网络（NN）作为最大预测性能目标；（3）基于稀疏字典学习的框架用于识别和解释简洁的非线性交互方程。

Result: 比较了各模型的预测性能，估算了不同输入暴露变量导致哮喘急性加重的相对风险，发现不同框架之间对风险估计具有一致性。

Conclusion: 本研究将统计模型与可解释机器学习模型联系起来，揭示了可能影响哮喘急性加重的协同交互作用，为未来指导弗吉尼亚州沿海地区公共卫生干预措施提供了基础。

Abstract: Childhood asthma is a common illness exacerbated by air pollution as well as meteorological and neighborhood-level socioeconomic factors. Modeling asthma exacerbation (AE) in large spatiotemporal datasets requires disentangling impacts from multiple contributors. In this case study, we compared three techniques that balance predictive power with interpretability to predict AE in Hampton Roads, a coastal Virginia region comprising 7 cities and over 1.5 million people. After collating ambient air pollution measurements, weather data, and measures of neighborhood opportunity, we modeled zip code-level acute AE visits to a regional children's hospital and affiliated providers from 2018-2023. Generalized linear models (GLM) provided a baseline while neural networks (NN) served as a maximally predictive target. To bridge between statistical models and deep learning, we developed a framework based on sparse dictionary learning to identify and interpret parsimonious nonlinear interacting equations. After comparing each model's predictive performance, we estimated relative risks for AE due to input exposure variables and found consensus across frameworks. Our work links statistical and interpretable machine learning models to highlight possible synergistic interactions influencing AE, and may enable future studies to guide public health interventions in coastal Virginia.

</details>


### [265] [Learning to Route LLMs from Implicit Cost-Performance Preferences via Meta-Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06178)
*Jiahao Zeng,Ming Tang,Ningning Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MetaRouter框架，通过元学习实现个性化LLM路由，在少量交互中学习用户隐式偏好，以在性能和成本之间进行优化权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM路由方法无法适应不同用户对成本-性能的个性化偏好，缺乏用户感知的定制化优化方案。

Method: 将用户偏好建模为上下文多臂赌博机中的不同任务，提出基于元学习的MetaRouter框架，通过少量交互高效学习用户隐式偏好，实现偏好感知的LLM路由。

Result: 在分布内和分布外任务上均优于强基线方法，在用户偏好学习效率、可路由LLM变化的鲁棒性以及多模型路由扩展性方面表现优异。

Conclusion: MetaRouter通过元学习框架实现了高效、鲁棒且可扩展的个性化LLM路由，能根据用户不同偏好动态优化成本-性能权衡。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) present a trade-off between performance and cost, where more powerful models incur greater expense. LLM routing aims to mitigate expenses while maintaining performance by sending queries to the most suitable model. However, existing methods cannot perform well for different user cost-performance preferences. To address this gap, we introduce a novel perceptive LLM routing paradigm for personalized and user-centric cost-performance optimization, which efficiently learns users' implicit preferences through little interaction. To handle the challenge of heterogeneous user needs, we formulate preference profiles as a set of distinct tasks in contextual bandit and propose MetaRouter, a meta-learning framework designed for preference-aware LLM routing. Experimental results show that MetaRouter outperforms strong baselines on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks. Furthermore, it exhibits high efficiency in learning user preferences, robustness to changes in the routable LLMs, and scalability to multi-model routing.

</details>


### [266] [A Machine Learning-Based Framework for Discovering Huntington's Disease Stages: Integrating Graph Representation Learning and clustering to Uncover Progression Dynamics in Longitudinal Enroll-HD Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06196)
*Lubna M. Abu Zohair,Marta Vallejo,MD Azher Uddin,John R. Woodward,Hind Zantout*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于动态图表示学习的无监督机器学习框架，用于从纵向临床测量数据中识别亨廷顿舞蹈症(HD)的自然疾病分期。该方法在302名Enroll-HD队列参与者（1477次就诊）中应用，通过四维潜在空间和K-means++聚类，识别出四个统计显著的疾病阶段，相比传统临床分期方法具有更清晰的边界和更少的阶段间重叠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的HD临床分期框架依赖预设的临床测量阈值和专家判断，这些离散截断值可能掩盖有意义的阶段内变异性，且容易受评估者间差异影响，尤其在运动和功能评估中。因此，需要一种数据驱动的、客观的疾病分期方法来弥补这些局限。

Method: 开发了一个基于动态图表示学习的无监督框架：首先利用动态图表示学习捕获患者内部及患者之间的纵向时间关系；然后使用K-means++聚类识别分离良好的分组；通过迭代增加聚类数量（k）并利用稳定性分析评估聚类鲁棒性，发现初始最优解之外的有意义聚类。数据来源为Enroll-HD队列的302名参与者（1477次就诊，每次44个临床变量），潜在空间维度设为四维。

Result: 尽管队列规模有限，该框架在四维潜在空间中实现了稳健的聚类性能，通过聚类稳定性分析识别出四个有意义且统计显著的疾病阶段。每个阶段对应清晰的临床测量边界，与已有临床分期方法相比，阶段间重叠最小。

Conclusion: 本研究表明，数据驱动的无监督学习方法能够从纵向临床数据中自然地揭示HD的疾病进展阶段，提供了比传统专家定义分期方法更客观、更精细的分期方案，有望改善疾病管理、患者分组和个性化治疗决策。

Abstract: Huntington's disease (HD) is a progressive brain disorder that gradually affects movement, cognitive function, and behavior. Identifying the stage of the disease accurately and consistently is important for understanding its course, grouping patients, personalized care, and discovering treatment. Existing clinical staging frameworks rely primarily on predefined clinical measurement thresholds and clinical expert decisions, yet these discrete cut-offs may obscure meaningful intra-stage variability and remain vulnerable to inter-rater differences, especially in motor and functional assessments. To address these limitations, we developed an unsupervised machine learning framework based on dynamic graph representation learning to capture temporal relationships within and across patients from longitudinal clinical measurements. Using the learned representations, we applied K-means++ clustering to identify well-separated groups. We then iteratively increased the number of clusters (k), using stability analysis to assess robustness and reveal additional meaningful clusters beyond the initial optimal solution. We applied the framework to 302 individuals from the Enroll-HD cohort (1,477 visits, 44 clinical variables per visit; 80% manifest participants), enabling data-driven discovery of HD stages reflecting natural clinical progression. Despite the limited cohort size, the proposed framework achieved robust clustering performance using a four-dimensional latent space, identifying four meaningful and statistically distinct disease stages through clustering stability analysis. Each stage corresponded to well-defined clinical measurement boundaries, with minimal overlap compared to previously established clinical staging methods.

</details>


### [267] [Non-Negative Matrix Factorization for Event Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06205)
*Raphaël Romero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EventNMF，一种直接在连续时间事件数据上进行非负矩阵分解的方法，避免了传统分箱或平滑预处理的信息损失，并通过泊松过程与B样条基函数实现可解释的时域模板分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统NMF应用于连续时间事件数据时，必须先对实体级计数测度进行分箱或平滑预处理，这一过程会抹去实体层面的异质性和细粒度时间特征，导致信息损失。

Method: 将每个实体的事件建模为泊松过程，其强度通过非负B样条基函数进行因式分解，从而恢复出跨实体共享的可解释时间模板，并提出简单高效的估计过程。

Result: 标准分箱计数方法可视为零次B样条的特殊情况；通过合成潜在因子模型探讨了偏差-方差权衡；在多个真实数据集上验证了有效性。

Conclusion: EventNMF是一种数学上严谨、易于实现且计算高效的方法，能够直接对连续时间事件数据进行非负矩阵分解，避免了预处理阶段的信息损失。

Abstract: Continuous-time event data, in which entities emit instantaneous events over time, arises naturally across many domains such as neuroscience, seismology, and social networks. Non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) is a natural tool to uncover interpretable structure in such data, but it has so far only been applied after binning or smoothing the entity-level counting measures. This preprocessing step comes with the risk of erasing entity-level heterogeneities and fine-grained temporal features. In this paper, we introduce EventNMF, a continuous-time non-negative factorization model that operates directly on event times: each entity's events are modeled as a Poisson process whose intensity factorizes through a non-negative B-spline basis, and a simple estimation procedure recovers interpretable temporal templates shared across entities. The resulting method is mathematically principled, easy to implement, and computationally efficient. We further show that standard binned-count approaches arise as the special case of degree-zero splines, explore bias-variance tradeoffs and compare against existing methods on a synthetic latent factor model, and demonstrate the effectiveness of EventNMF on several real-world applications.

</details>


### [268] [Design a Reliable LLM-Integrated Interface for Mortality Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06235)
*Thi Kim Ngan Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种集成大语言模型（LLM）的死亡率预测接口，通过将自然语言输入转化为结构化配置，在保持统计严谨性的同时提升了非专家用户的可访问性。系统采用三阶段方法：基于CoMoMo包建立基线预测流水线、滚动起点评估生成多步预测、以及本地LLM驱动的原型界面。实验表明，LLM能在不牺牲可重复性、透明性和精算有效性的前提下，增强高 stakes 分析工作流的可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 死亡率预测在精算和政策决策中至关重要，但其技术复杂性使得非专家用户难以使用。现有工具缺乏友好的用户交互方式，限制了其在实践中的广泛应用。

Method: 采用三阶段方法论：1) 使用CoMoMo包构建基线预测流水线，复现已有死亡率预测结果；2) 扩展流水线，通过滚动起点评估和均方误差（MSE）生成多步预测；3) 设计原型界面，利用本地LLM将用户的自然语言请求转化为结构化配置，驱动确定性预测流水线。

Result: 成功构建了LLM集成的死亡率预测接口原型，证明了LLM能够在不损害可重复性、透明性和精算有效性的前提下，显著提升高精度分析工作流的可访问性。

Conclusion: LLM作为受约束的编排层可以有效桥接专业预测系统与非专家用户之间的鸿沟，为高风险精算决策领域的人机协作提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Mortality forecasting plays an important role in actuarial and policy decision-making, but its implementation remains technically complex and inaccessible to non-expert users. This project proposes a reliable large language model (LLM)-integrated interface that improves usability while maintaining statistical power. The LLM is designed as a constrained orchestration layer that translates natural-language inputs into structured configurations for a deterministic forecasting pipeline. A three-phase methodology is employed to ensure accuracy, usability, and transparency. First, a baseline pipeline is implemented using the CoMoMo package, reproducing established mortality forecasting results. Second, the pipeline is extended to generate multi-step forecasts using rolling-origin evaluation and mean squared error (MSE). Third, a prototype interface uses a local LLM to handle users' forecasting requests in plain language. The system demonstrates that LLMs can enhance accessibility without compromising reproducibility, transparency, or actuarial validity in high-stakes analytical workflows.

</details>


### [269] [Tracing the Oracle: Improving Diffusion Timestep Scheduling for 3D CT Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06236)
*Yujia Wu,Zhaoqiang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TrO框架，通过动态规划优化扩散模型的采样时间步调度，在极少的采样步数（≤10步）下显著提升3D CT重建的保真度和计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在解决3D CT逆问题时推理计算开销大，且均匀时间步调度无法捕捉逆向条件扩散SDE的非均匀演化，导致较大截断误差。

Method: 提出TrO框架：在少量样本上密集采样数值积分轨迹作为参考oracle，利用动态规划全局最小化少步近似与oracle之间的累积误差，从而提取最优时间步调度，将有限采样步精确分配到对截断误差敏感的关键演化阶段。

Result: 在AAPM数据集上的多项3D CT重建任务中，结合SOTA方法DDS，TrO优化的时间步在≤10步的严格预算下显著提升了重建保真度和计算效率。

Conclusion: TrO是一种即插即用的时间步调度优化框架，有效克服了均匀调度的局限性，在极低采样步数下实现高效高保真的3D CT重建。

Abstract: Pretrained diffusion models demonstrate impressive potential in solving highly ill-posed 3D computed tomography (CT) inverse problems, while the inference process suffers from significant computational overhead. Furthermore, existing uniform timestep schedules fail to capture the non-uniform evolution of the reverse conditional diffusion stochastic differential equation, thereby introducing substantial truncation errors. To overcome this limitation, we propose Tracing the Oracle (TrO), a plug-and-play framework for improved timestep scheduling. Specifically, we treat densely sampled numerical integration trajectories on a few samples as the reference oracle. The optimized schedule is extracted by leveraging dynamic programming to globally minimize the cumulative error between the few-step approximation and the oracle. This mechanism precisely allocates the limited sampling steps to critical evolution stages that are highly susceptible to truncation errors. Our extensive experiments on the AAPM dataset across multiple 3D CT reconstruction tasks demonstrate that, when combined with the state-of-the-art 3D CT reconstruction method DDS, our optimized timesteps significantly improve reconstruction fidelity and computational efficiency compared to existing heuristic schedules, especially under a strict budget of no more than 10 sampling steps.

</details>


### [270] [Generative Criticality in Large Language Model Temperature Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06238)
*Huajian Ruan,Jinyang Li,Xingyu Guo,Lingxiao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统计场框架，将LLM生成的token嵌入视为一维链上的连续自旋变量，通过定义磁化率、序参量和改变softmax温度T，观察到类似连续相变的临界现象（磁化率尖峰、序参量突变、语义方向坍缩），且内在维度在Tc处最小。该现象在多种模型规模（Qwen3: 0.6B-32B）和提示类别下具有鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM文本生成分析多从语言学或概率角度出发，缺乏从统计物理视角理解生成文本集体统计结构的定量框架。作者希望借鉴统计场论中的相变理论，探索LLM生成过程中是否存在类似临界现象的结构性转变。

Method: 将LLM的token嵌入视为一维链上的连续自旋变量；定义基于连接两点关联函数的磁化率(susceptibility)和基于系综平均嵌入场的序参量(order parameter)；改变softmax温度T，观察磁化率尖峰、序参量变化和语义方向坍缩；使用最近邻(TwoNN)方法独立估计内在维度。

Result: 在特征温度Tc附近观察到：(1) 磁化率呈现尖锐峰值且具有幂律标度行为；(2) 序参量发生快速变化；(3) Tc以下语义坍缩到单一方向；(4) 内在维度在Tc附近达到最小值。这些结果在Qwen3模型(0.6B-32B)和多种提示类别中保持鲁棒。

Conclusion: 该统计场框架为探测LLM输出的集体统计结构提供了定量工具，揭示了解码策略与临界现象之间的潜在联系。但需注意自回归生成的非平衡特性，因此需要进一步研究以确认是否真正对应连续相变。

Abstract: We propose a statistical-field framework for text generated by large language models (LLMs), treating token embeddings as continuous spin variables on a one-dimensional chain. Defining a susceptibility from the connected two-point correlator and an order parameter from the ensemble-averaged embedding field, we vary the \texttt{softmax} temperature $T$ and observe a sharp susceptibility peak near a characteristic $T_c$ with power-law-like scaling, a concurrent rapid change in the order parameter, and a collapse onto a single semantic direction below $T_c$. The intrinsic dimension estimated by the two nearest neighbor (TwoNN) method independently corroborates these findings, reaching a minimum near $T_c$. Results are robust across model scales (Qwen3: 0.6B--32B) and prompt categories. While the phenomenology closely resembles a continuous phase transition, the non-equilibrium nature of autoregressive generation warrants further investigation. Our framework provides quantitative tools for probing the collective statistical structure of LLM outputs and suggests connections between decoding strategies and critical phenomena.

</details>


### [271] [Your GFlowNet Secretly Learns an Optimal Transport Plan](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06272)
*Ian Maksimov,Nikita Morozov,Denis Belomestny,Sergey Samsonov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了非有向无环GFlowNet与最优传输（OT）之间的理论联系，证明了最小流GFlowNet的目标函数可简化为图诱导最短路径代价下的Kantorovich OT问题，其最优策略编码了最优传输计划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将GFlowNet与最优传输理论建立联系，拓展GFlowNet的应用范围，为大规模图上的最优传输问题提供新的求解框架。

Method: 通过固定最小流GFlowNet中的初始流分布，将其目标函数转化为Kantorovich OT问题；利用边流和神经参数化在大型图上学习最优传输计划。

Result: 实验验证了该方法与精确OT求解器的一致性，并证明GFlowNet能够学习高质量的传输计划。

Conclusion: GFlowNet学习框架可有效应用于大规模图上的最优传输问题，编码最优传输计划，且在实验中表现良好。

Abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) are a framework for sampling structured objects via stochastic trajectories in a directed graph. In this work, we establish a theoretical connection between non-acyclic GFlowNets and optimal transport (OT). We show that fixing the initial flow distribution in a minimum-flow GFlowNet reduces its objective to a Kantorovich OT problem with graph-induced shortest path costs. At the optimum, the learned GFlowNet policy therefore encodes an optimal transport plan from the source distribution to the target distribution: we show that sampling trajectories from the minimum-flow GFlowNet recovers the corresponding optimal coupling. Our formulation enables applying the GFlowNet learning framework to OT problems on large graphs via edge flows and neural parameterization. Experiments confirm agreement with exact OT solvers and demonstrate that GFlowNets can learn high-quality transport plans.

</details>


### [272] [PAC-Bayesian Adversarially Robust Generalization for Message Passing Graph Neural Networks: A Sensitivity Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06293)
*Ziling Liang,Xinping Yi,Qingsong Wen,Shi Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对消息传递图神经网络（MPGNNs）的对抗鲁棒泛化问题，扩展了敏感性感知的PAC-Bayesian框架，通过分析参数块对输出的Jacobian矩阵（秩不超过类别数K），构造Jacobian对齐的敏感性矩阵并使用各向异性高斯后验优化KL散度上界，将主导维度因子从隐藏层宽度降低为类别数K，显著收紧对抗设置下的鲁棒泛化界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图神经网络易受对抗攻击，但对抗设置下的鲁棒泛化行为理解仍是一个根本性挑战。现有PAC-Bayesian鲁棒分析依赖各向同性高斯后验并在全参数空间控制权重扰动，无法捕捉异构参数敏感性，且受隐藏宽度依赖的复杂度项制约，导致泛化界不够紧致。

Method: 1) 将深度神经网络的敏感性感知PAC-Bayesian框架扩展到MPGNNs；2) 通过推导输出关于权重参数的Jacobian矩阵，量化不同参数块对网络输出的敏感性；3) 利用K类图分类中Jacobian矩阵秩最多为K的性质，构造Jacobian对齐的敏感性矩阵；4) 使用优化协方差的各向异性高斯后验来紧致上界KL散度。

Result: 推导出对抗设置下更紧致的MPGNNs鲁棒泛化界，将主导维度因子从隐藏宽度相关项降低到类别数K，显著提升了泛化保证的紧致性。

Conclusion: 本文分析为MPGNNs提供了更紧致的鲁棒泛化保证，可指导设计以增强对抗鲁棒性。

Abstract: Whilst the vulnerability of graph neural networks (GNNs) to adversarial attacks poses a critical threat to graph representation learning, the understanding of the robust generalization behavior remains a fundamental challenge in the adversarial setting. Recently, PAC-Bayesian margin-based generalization analysis substantially advances this line of research by providing a flexible and data-dependent analytical framework. However, existing robust analyses often rely on isotropic Gaussian posteriors and control weight perturbations in the full parameter space, which limits the ability to capture heterogeneous parameter sensitivity yet hinges on hidden-width-dependent complexity terms, resulting in not-tight-enough generalization bounds. In this paper, we extend a recently proposed sensitivity-aware PAC-Bayesian framework from deep neural networks to message passing GNNs (MPGNNs) and derive a tighter robust generalization bound in the adversarial setting. Specifically, we first quantify how sensitive the perturbations across different parameter blocks are to the network outputs by deriving the output Jacobians with respect to the weight parameters.
