<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态因果模型大多假设因果网络先验已知，而真实场景中因果结构常存在不确定性、演化性或仅能间接观测，限制了动态因果推断在科学领域的应用。

Method: 两阶段框架：阶段一用神经自回归因果发现模型从多变量时间序列中学习稀疏有向因果网络；阶段二将学习到的结构作为时变神经网络自回归的结构先验，实现无需预设网络结构的动态因果影响估计。

Result: 在多国面板时间序列数据上，DCNAR比基于系数或无结构的替代方法产生更稳定且行为上有意义的动态因果推断，即使预测性能相当。

Conclusion: DCNAR可作为在结构不确定条件下利用AI进行动态因果推理的科学工具通用框架。

Abstract: Time-varying causal models provide a powerful framework for studying dynamic scientific systems, yet most existing approaches assume that the underlying causal network is known a priori - an assumption rarely satisfied in real-world domains where causal structure is uncertain, evolving, or only indirectly observable. This limits the applicability of dynamic causal inference in many scientific settings. We propose Dynamic Causal Network Autoregression (DCNAR), a two-stage neural causal modeling framework that integrates data-driven causal discovery with time-varying causal inference. In the first stage, a neural autoregressive causal discovery model learns a sparse directed causal network from multivariate time series. In the second stage, this learned structure is used as a structural prior for a time-varying neural network autoregression, enabling dynamic estimation of causal influence without requiring pre-specified network structure. We evaluate the scientific validity of DCNAR using behavioral diagnostics that assess causal necessity, temporal stability, and sensitivity to structural change, rather than predictive accuracy alone. Experiments on multi-country panel time-series data demonstrate that learned causal networks yield more stable and behaviorally meaningful dynamic causal inferences than coefficient-based or structure-free alternatives, even when forecasting performance is comparable. These results position DCNAR as a general framework for using AI as a scientific instrument for dynamic causal reasoning under structural uncertainty.

</details>


### [350] [Neural Collapse Dynamics: Depth, Activation, Regularisation, and Feature Norm Threshold](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.00230)
*Anamika Paul Rupa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现神经坍缩（NC）的发生存在一个关键的特征范数阈值fn*，该值在（模型，数据集）对内高度稳定（CV<8%），训练动态主要影响特征范数趋近fn*的速率而非其最终值。通过完整网格实验揭示了非加性的架构-数据集交互效应，并总结出四种结构正则性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经坍缩在平衡态已被充分理解，但其onset（发生）动力学特征尚不明确，缺乏预测NC发生时间的实用诊断工具。

Method: 通过大量实验测量特征范数均值的临界值fn*，分析其在不同模型、数据集、训练条件下的稳定性；进行直接干预实验验证fn*是梯度流的稳定吸引子；完成(架构)×(数据集)完整网格实验分析交互效应。

Result: fn*在（模型，数据集）对内变异系数<8%；特征范数低于fn*后平均提前62个epoch预测NC onset；fn*是梯度流的稳定吸引子；网格效应非加性（ResNet-20在MNIST上fn*=5.867，架构效应+458% vs CIFAR-10上仅+68%）；四种结构正则性：深度非单调、激活函数联合影响、权重衰减三阶段相图、宽度单调加速但fn*变化<13%。

Conclusion: 特征范数动力学可作为预测NC timing的实用诊断工具，范数阈值行为可能是深层网络中延迟表征重组的通用机制。

Abstract: Neural collapse (NC) -- the convergence of penultimate-layer features to a simplex equiangular tight frame -- is well understood at equilibrium, but the dynamics governing its onset remain poorly characterised. We identify a simple and predictive regularity: NC occurs when the mean feature norm reaches a model-dataset-specific critical value, fn*, that is largely invariant to training conditions. This value concentrates tightly within each (model, dataset) pair (CV < 8%); training dynamics primarily affect the rate at which fn approaches fn*, rather than the value itself. In standard training trajectories, the crossing of fn below fn* consistently precedes NC onset, providing a practical predictor with a mean lead time of 62 epochs (MAE 24 epochs). A direct intervention experiment confirms fn* is a stable attractor of the gradient flow -- perturbations to feature scale are self-corrected during training, with convergence to the same value regardless of direction (p>0.2). Completing the (architecture)x(dataset) grid reveals the paper's strongest result: ResNet-20 on MNIST gives fn* = 5.867 -- a +458% architecture effect versus only +68% on CIFAR-10. The grid is strongly non-additive; fn* cannot be decomposed into independent architecture and dataset contributions. Four structural regularities emerge: (1) depth has a non-monotonic effect on collapse speed; (2) activation jointly determines both collapse speed and fn*; (3) weight decay defines a three-regime phase diagram -- too little slows, an optimal range is fastest, and too much prevents collapse; (4) width monotonically accelerates collapse while shifting fn* by at most 13%. These results establish feature-norm dynamics as an actionable diagnostic for predicting NC timing, suggesting that norm-threshold behaviour is a general mechanism underlying delayed representational reorganisation in deep networks.

</details>


### [351] [PI-JEPA: Label-Free Surrogate Pretraining for Coupled Multiphysics Simulation via Operator-Split Latent Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.01349)
*Brandon Yee,Pairie Koh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PI-JEPA框架，一种无需完整PDE求解即可预训练的神经代理模型。利用未标记参数场的掩码潜在预测和每个子算子的PDE残差正则化，与Lie-Trotter算子分裂分解对齐，仅需少量（100个）标记模拟轨迹即可微调，在达西流场景中分别比FNO和DeepONet降低1.9倍和2.4倍误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 油藏模拟工作流中存在根本性数据不对称：输入参数场（渗透率、孔隙度）可任意大量生成，但现有神经算子代理需要大量昂贵的标记模拟轨迹，无法利用这些未标记的结构信息。

Method: 提出PI-JEPA（物理信息联合嵌入预测架构），在无任何完整PDE求解的情况下进行预训练，核心包括：(1) 对未标记参数场进行掩码潜在预测；(2) 采用每个子算子的PDE残差正则化；(3) 预测器库与Lie-Trotter算子分裂分解结构对齐，为每个子过程（压力、饱和度输运、反应）分配独立的物理约束潜在模块。

Result: 在单相达西流中，使用100个标记样本时，PI-JEPA误差比FNO低1.9倍，比DeepONet低2.4倍；使用500个标记样本时，比纯监督训练改进24%。

Conclusion: 无标签代理预训练可大幅降低多物理场代理部署所需的模拟预算，少量标记数据即可实现高精度。

Abstract: Reservoir simulation workflows face a fundamental data asymmetry: input parameter fields (geostatistical permeability realizations, porosity distributions) are free to generate in arbitrary quantities, yet existing neural operator surrogates require large corpora of expensive labeled simulation trajectories and cannot exploit this unlabeled structure. We introduce \textbf{PI-JEPA} (Physics-Informed Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture), a surrogate pretraining framework that trains \emph{without any completed PDE solves}, using masked latent prediction on unlabeled parameter fields under per-sub-operator PDE residual regularization. The predictor bank is structurally aligned with the Lie--Trotter operator-splitting decomposition of the governing equations, dedicating a separate physics-constrained latent module to each sub-process (pressure, saturation transport, reaction), enabling fine-tuning with as few as 100 labeled simulation runs. On single-phase Darcy flow, PI-JEPA achieves $1.9\times$ lower error than FNO and $2.4\times$ lower error than DeepONet at $N_\ell{=}100$, with 24\% improvement over supervised-only training at $N_\ell{=}500$, demonstrating that label-free surrogate pretraining substantially reduces the simulation budget required for multiphysics surrogate deployment.

</details>


### [352] [CuTeGen: An LLM-Based Agentic Framework for Generation and Optimization of High-Performance GPU Kernels using CuTe](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.01489)
*Tara Saba,Zhiyang Chen,Jikai Jason Li,Anne Ouyang,Xujie Si,Fan Long*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CuTeGen是一个基于CuTe抽象层的智能体GPU内核合成框架，采用结构化"生成-测试-精炼"工作流，在KernelBench Level-1和Level-2的209个任务上平均比PyTorch加速1.71倍，优于先前基线CudaForge（0.89倍）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高性能GPU内核对现代机器学习系统至关重要，但目前开发过程依赖人工专家经验。尽管已有研究利用LLM自动化内核生成，但生成的代码在标准化基准测试中仍落后于精心调优的参考实现。

Method: CuTeGen采用智能体化框架，将内核开发视为结构化的"生成-测试-精炼"工作流。两个关键设计：1）以CuTe（而非原始CUDA）为目标，暴露平铺和数据移动等性能关键结构，同时保持稳定性以支持迭代精炼；2）采用延迟性能剖析调度，在内核高层结构稳定后再引入底层性能反馈。

Result: 在KernelBench Level-1和Level-2的209个任务上，CuTeGen平均加速比PyTorch达1.71倍，优于先前智能体基线CudaForge（0.89倍），且每任务生成成本相当。

Conclusion: 通过选择CuTe抽象层和延迟剖析策略，CuTeGen有效提升了LLM生成GPU内核的性能，为自动化内核优化提供了新的范式。

Abstract: High-performance GPU kernels are critical to modern machine learning systems, yet developing them remains a manual, expert-driven process. Recent work has explored using LLMs to automate kernel generation, but generated kernels still fall short of carefully tuned references on standardized benchmarks. We present CuTeGen, an agentic GPU kernel synthesis framework that treats kernel development as a structured generate-test-refine workflow over the CuTe abstraction layer. Two design choices distinguish CuTeGen from prior work: targeting CuTe rather than raw CUDA, which exposes performance-critical structures such as tiling and data movement while remaining stable enough for iterative refinement, and a delayed profiling schedule that withholds low-level performance feedback until the kernel's high-level structure has stabilized. On the 209 tasks of KernelBench Level-1 and Level-2, CuTeGen achieves an average speedup of 1.71$\times$ over PyTorch and outperforms the prior agentic baseline CudaForge (0.89$\times$) at comparable per-task generation cost. Code available at https://github.com/taratt/cutegen.git

</details>


### [353] [Algebraic Diversity: Group-Theoretic Spectral Estimation from Single Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03634)
*Mitchell A. Thornton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明时间平均是多快照协方差估计的退化情形，提出群平均估计器可在单快照下实现等效子空间分解，统一了DFT、DCT、KLT变换，并通过蒙特卡洛实验验证了广义代数平均定理。该框架利用数据的表示论对称性（信息结构）而非内容，补充了香农理论，并在单快照MUSIC、大规模MIMO、波形分类、图信号处理和Transformer LLM分析中得到应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将时间平均（多快照）方法推广到更一般的代数群作用框架，揭示群平均与协方差估计之间的深层数学联系，并利用数据的对称性结构而非统计内容来提升估计效率。

Method: 通过群表示论建立单快照群平均估计与多快照协方差估计的等价性；提出平凡群嵌入定理将样本协方差表示为平凡群估计的累积；通过蒙特卡洛实验验证广义代数平均定理。

Result: 群平均处理增益为10log₁₀(M) dB，等价于经典波束形成增益，表明该增益是群阶数的属性而非传感器数量；DFT/DCT/KLT被统一为群匹配特例；前四阶样本矩的蒙特卡洛实验在五种群类型上达到四位精度验证。

Conclusion: 群平均框架利用数据的表示论对称性（信息结构），拓展了经典信号处理理论，为单快照处理、大规模MIMO、图信号处理及大模型分析提供了统一视角和实用工具。

Abstract: We establish that temporal averaging over multiple observations is the degenerate case of algebraic group action with the trivial group $G=\{e\}$. A General Replacement Theorem proves that a group-averaged estimator from one snapshot achieves equivalent subspace decomposition to multi-snapshot covariance estimation. The Trivial Group Embedding Theorem proves that the sample covariance is the accumulation of trivial-group estimates, with variance governed by a $(G,L)$ continuum as $1/(|G|\cdot L)$. The processing gain $10\log_{10}(M)$ dB equals the classical beamforming gain, establishing that this gain is a property of group order, not sensor count. The DFT, DCT, and KLT are unified as group-matched special cases. We conjecture a General Algebraic Averaging Theorem extending these results to arbitrary statistics, with variance governed by the effective group order $d_{\mathrm{eff}}$. Monte Carlo experiments on the first four sample moments across five group types confirm the conjecture to four-digit precision. The framework exploits the $structure$ of information (representation-theoretic symmetry of the data object) rather than the content, complementing Shannon's theory. Five applications are demonstrated: single-snapshot MUSIC, massive MIMO, single-pulse waveform classification, graph signal processing, and analysis of transformer LLMs. Techniques for blind group matching are described.

</details>


### [354] [Stochastic-Dimension Frozen Sampled Neural Network for High-Dimensional Gross-Pitaevskii Equations on Unbounded Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09361)
*Zhangyong Liang,Tingfeng Wang,Xiaofei Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出随机维度冻结采样神经网络(SD-FSNN)，通过高斯包络编码远场衰减、冻结单隐藏层神经网络进行空间近似、随机维度采样器降低计算成本，以及离散守恒律保证长期稳定性，成功在高达1000维的Gross-Pitaevskii方程求解中超越了PINN、随机特征方法和张量网络方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统离散方法在高维问题上受维数灾难困扰，而基于梯度的神经网络求解器存在计算瓶颈。需要一种能有效缓解Kolmogorov n-宽度障碍、避免梯度计算瓶颈、并能在无界域上高效求解高维GPE的新框架。

Method: (1) 预设高斯包络编码波函数的远场衰减，实现时空分离；(2) 冻结单隐藏层神经网络搭配数据驱动采样特征进行空间近似，梯度无关地预计算空间导数，时间演化通过降阶ODE进行；(3) 随机维度采样器在每个时间步仅评估少量空间维度，提供空间算子的条件无偏估计；(4) 强制执行离散守恒律保证长期稳定性。

Result: 在高达1000维的GPE数值实验中，SD-FSNN在精度和效率上显著超越PINN、随机特征方法和张量网络方法，有效缓解了冻结基模型在结构化解流形上的Kolmogorov n-宽度障碍。

Conclusion: SD-FSNN通过协同组合多种技术，成功克服了高维GPE求解中的维数灾难和梯度计算瓶颈，为高维非线性偏微分方程求解提供了一种高效、可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: This paper introduces the Stochastic-Dimension Frozen Sampled Neural Network (SD-FSNN), a novel computational framework for solving high-dimensional Gross-Pitaevskii equation (GPE) on unbounded domain. The proposed method circumvents the curse-of-dimensionality that plagues traditional discretizations and the computational bottlenecks of gradient-based neural network solvers through a synergistic combination of techniques. First, a prescribed Gaussian envelope encodes the far-field decay of the wavefunction, enabling a space-time separation where the spatial approximation is handled by a frozen, single-hidden-layer neural network with data-driven sampled features. This yields a gradient-free formalism where spatial derivatives are analytically precomputed and time-dependence is evolved via reduced ODEs. Second, a stochastic-dimension sampler provides a conditionally unbiased estimate of the spatial operator by evaluating only a small subset of spatial dimensions at each time step, essentially reducing computational and memory costs. Discrete conservation laws are also enforced, ensuring long-term stability. Extensive numerical experiments on GPE in up to 1000 dimensions demonstrate that SD-FSNN achieves significantly higher accuracy and efficiency compared to state-of-the-art methods, including PINNs, randomized feature methods, and tensor-network approaches. The results confirm that SD-FSNN effectively mitigates the Kolmogorov $n$-width barrier for frozen-basis models on structured solution manifolds.

</details>


### [355] [SOLARIS: Speculative Offloading of Latent-bAsed Representation for Inference Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12110)
*Zikun Liu,Liang Luo,Qianru Li,Zhengyu Zhang,Wei Ling,Jingyi Shen,Zeliang Chen,Yaning Huang,Jingxian Huang,Abdallah Aboelela,Chonglin Sun,Feifan Gu,Fenggang Wu,Hang Qu,Huayu Li,Jill Pan,Kaidi Pei,Laming Chen,Longhao Jin,Qin Huang,Tongyi Tang,Varna Puvvada,Wenlin Chen,Xiaohan Wei,Xu Cao,Yantao Yao,Yuan Jin,Yunchen Pu,Yuxin Chen,Zijian Shen,Zhengkai Zhang,Jing Zhu,Dong Liang,Ellie Wen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SOLARIS是一个受推测性解码启发的框架，通过预测未来请求中可能出现的用户-物品对，并异步预计算其基础模型嵌入，将昂贵的基础模型推理从延迟关键的服务路径中解耦，实现大规模实时知识蒸馏。在Meta广告系统部署后，核心指标提升0.67%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推荐基础模型计算成本过高，无法用于实时服务，而知识蒸馏虽能提升效率但会牺牲服务质量。迫切需要一种既能利用大模型强大表示能力，又能满足实时推理延迟要求的方案。

Method: 提出SOLARIS框架，核心思想是推测式卸载：提前预测哪些用户-物品对可能出现在未来请求中，异步预计算其基础模型表示（嵌入），从而将昂贵推理与在线服务路径解耦。

Result: 在Meta数十亿日活请求的广告系统中部署，Revenue-driving top-line metrics提升0.67%。

Conclusion: SOLARIS证明了推测式预计算可以有效克服推荐基础模型服务于实时场景的计算瓶颈，使之前被认为过于昂贵的模型能够投入在线使用，并带来显著业务收益。

Abstract: Recent advances in recommendation scaling laws have led to foundation models of unprecedented complexity. While these models offer superior performance, their computational demands make real-time serving impractical, often forcing practitioners to rely on knowledge distillation-compromising serving quality for efficiency. To address this challenge, we present SOLARIS (Speculative Offloading of Latent-bAsed Representation for Inference Scaling), a novel framework inspired by speculative decoding. SOLARIS proactively precomputes user-item interaction embeddings by predicting which user-item pairs are likely to appear in future requests, and asynchronously generating their foundation model representations ahead of time. This approach decouples the costly foundation model inference from the latency-critical serving path, enabling real-time knowledge transfer from models previously considered too expensive for online use. Deployed across Meta's advertising system serving billions of daily requests, SOLARIS achieves 0.67% revenue-driving top-line metrics gain, demonstrating its effectiveness at scale.

</details>


### [356] [The Topological Trouble With Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17121)
*Michael C. Mozer,Shoaib Ahmed Siddiqui,Rosanne Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出Transformer的纯前馈架构在动态状态跟踪（state tracking）方面存在根本性局限，提出通过循环架构将显式思维轨迹转为隐式激活动力学，并给出了按循环轴（深度/步长）和输入令牌与循环步比率分类的循环Transformer分类法，最后展望了增强状态空间模型和粗粒度循环等方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer的前馈结构天然难以维护迭代更新的潜在状态变量，因为状态跟踪涉及固有的顺序依赖关系，前馈网络每步将状态表示推入更深层，导致浅层信息不可及并最终耗尽模型深度。现有解决方案（动态深度模型、显式/隐式思维）计算和内存效率低下，因此需要更高效的状态跟踪机制。

Method: 提出了一种面向循环和连续思维Transformer架构的分类法，按循环轴（深度循环 vs. 步长循环）以及输入令牌与循环步的比例进行归类，系统梳理了不同循环变体的设计空间。

Result: 明确了前馈Transformer在状态跟踪上的根本缺陷，给出了系统化的循环Transformer分类体系，并指出了增强状态空间模型和粗粒度循环等有前景的研究方向。

Conclusion: 时间延展认知需要从显式思维轨迹转向通过循环架构实现的隐式激活动力学，未来的基础模型应更好地集成状态跟踪能力，提升计算和内存效率。

Abstract: Transformers encode structure in sequences via an expanding contextual history. However, their purely feedforward architecture fundamentally limits dynamic state tracking. State tracking -- the iterative updating of latent variables reflecting an evolving environment -- involves inherently sequential dependencies that feedforward networks struggle to maintain. Consequently, feedforward models push evolving state representations deeper into their layer stack with each new input step, rendering information inaccessible in shallow layers and ultimately exhausting the model's depth. While this depth limit can be bypassed by dynamic depth models and by explicit or latent thinking that externalizes state representations, these solutions are computationally and memory inefficient. In this article, we argue that temporally extended cognition requires refocusing from explicit thought traces to implicit activation dynamics via recurrent architectures. We introduce a taxonomy of recurrent and continuous-thought transformer architectures, categorizing them by their recurrence axis (depth versus step) and their ratio of input tokens to recurrence steps. Finally, we outline promising research directions, including enhanced state-space models and coarse-grained recurrence, to better integrate state tracking into modern foundation models.

</details>


### [357] [Adaptive Head Budgeting for Efficient Multi-Head Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.22583)
*Bilal Faye,Abdoulaye Mbaye,Hanane Azzag,Mustapha Lebbah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BudgetFormer提出了一种动态分配注意力头的Transformer架构，根据输入复杂度自适应选择注意力头，在文本分类任务中减少计算量和内存使用，同时保持或提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Transformer对所有输入都激活全部注意力头，即使对于粗粒度任务（如文本分类）只需全局信息，这种固定分配方式引入了不必要的计算开销。

Method: 提出BudgetFormer架构，学习每个输入的头预算和相关性分布来选择最具信息量的注意力头，并引入平衡探索与利用的训练策略来支持有效的头选择。

Result: 在文本分类任务上，BudgetFormer减少了FLOPs和内存使用，同时匹配或超越了标准多头注意力的性能。

Conclusion: 自适应头分配是提高Transformer效率和性能的有效方法。

Abstract: Multi-head attention enables Transformers to capture diverse representations, but all attention heads are typically activated for every input, regardless of task complexity. For coarse-grained tasks such as text classification, where relevant information is often global, this fixed allocation can introduce unnecessary computation. We propose BudgetFormer, a Transformer architecture that dynamically allocates attention heads on a per-input basis. The model learns both a head budget and a relevance distribution to select the most informative heads. To support effective head selection, we introduce a training strategy that balances exploration and exploitation. Experiments on text classification tasks show that BudgetFormer reduces FLOPs and memory usage while matching or surpassing the performance of standard multi-head attention. These results highlight adaptive head allocation as an effective approach to improving Transformer efficiency and performance.

</details>


### [358] [Evaluating CUDA Tile for AI Workloads on Hopper and Blackwell GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23466)
*Divakar Kumar Yadav,Tian Zhao,Deepak Kumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次独立评估了NVIDIA的CuTile跨架构（Hopper到Blackwell）在AI负载上的表现：CuTile在B200上融合注意力达1007 TFLOP/s（比FlashAttention-2快2.5倍，仅60行Python），GEMM达cuBLAS的52-79%（22行代码）；但在RTX PRO 6000上注意力仅FlashAttention-2的53%，暴露跨架构优化差距。Triton则在所有平台上保持62-101%的cuBLAS性能，可移植性更强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CuTile旨在通过Python平铺抽象简化GPU内核开发，同时保留Tensor Core和TMA的效率。现有工作缺乏对CuTile在跨架构（Hopper到Blackwell）上的独立、系统性评估，尤其是在与cuBLAS、Triton、WMMA等方法的对比上。

Method: 在H100 NVL、B200、RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition三款GPU上，对GEMM、融合多头注意力、端到端LLM推理等代表性AI负载进行BF16/FP16精度下的基准测试，对比CuTile与cuBLAS、Triton、WMMA、原始SIMT的性能和代码量。

Result: 1) B200上融合注意力：CuTile达1007 TFLOP/s，超FlashAttention-2达2.5倍（60行代码）；2) GEMM：CuTile达cuBLAS的52-79%（22行代码 vs WMMA的123行）；3) RTX PRO 6000上相同注意力内核仅FlashAttention-2的53%；4) Triton跨平台保持62-101% cuBLAS性能，无需架构调优。

Conclusion: CuTile在特定负载和架构上表现突出（如B200融合注意力），代码量显著减少，但跨架构可移植性不足；Triton在可移植性上更优。CuTile尚不能完全替代厂商优化库（如cuBLAS），但可作为手写CUDA内核的实用替代。

Abstract: NVIDIA's CUDA Tile (CuTile) introduces a Python-based, tile-centric abstraction for GPU kernel development that aims to simplify programming while retaining Tensor Core and Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) efficiency on modern GPUs. We present the first independent, cross-architecture evaluation of CuTile against established approaches such as cuBLAS, Triton, WMMA, and raw SIMT on three NVIDIA GPUs spanning Hopper and Blackwell: H100 NVL, B200, and RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition. We benchmark representative AI workloads, including GEMM, fused multi-head attention, and end-to-end LLM inference in BF16/FP16 precision, to assess both performance and portability.
  Our results show that CuTile effectiveness is strongly workload- and architecture-dependent. On datacenter-class Blackwell (B200), CuTile achieves up to 1007 TFLOP/s for fused attention, outperforming FlashAttention-2 by 2.5x while requiring only 60 lines of Python kernel code. For GEMM, CuTile reaches 52-79% of cuBLAS performance in 22 lines of code (versus 123 for WMMA), making it a practical replacement for hand-written CUDA kernels but not yet for vendor-optimized libraries. However, the same CuTile attention kernel achieves only 53% of FlashAttention-2 throughput on RTX PRO 6000 (sm_120), exposing significant cross-architecture optimization gaps. In contrast, Triton sustains 62-101% of cuBLAS performance across all tested platforms without architecture-specific tuning, demonstrating substantially stronger portability.

</details>


### [359] [Electricity price forecasting across Norway's five bidding zones in the post-crisis era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26634)
*My Thi Diem Phan,Trung Tuyen Truong,Hoai Phuong Ha,Dat Thanh Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文评估了挪威五个电力竞价区的日前电价预测模型，发现LightGBM在所有区域表现最优（MAE 1.60-5.58欧元/MWh），仅依赖滞后价格和日历变量的简化模型即可达到接近全模态模型的精度，但外部特征（如水库水位、天然气价格）在压力市场状态下仍至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2021-2022年能源危机及与欧洲大陆的深度融合从根本上改变了挪威水电主导的电力市场价格形成机制，导致基于历史数据的预测模型可靠性下降，而现有研究缺乏一个统一的基准来评估各结构差异显著的竞价区中不同特征的贡献。

Method: 构建了2019-2025年多模态小时级数据集，在挪威全部五个竞价区上评估了LightGBM、ARX及多种深度学习架构等八类模型；采用严格因果测试集、滚动起点回测、留一组特征消融和条件机制分析。

Result: LightGBM在所有区域均取得最优性能（MAE 1.60-5.58欧元/MWh）；ARX在北部区域仍具竞争力；仅依赖滞后价格和日历变量的模型可达到与全模态模型相近的精度；外部特征在压力市场状态下显著影响预测误差。

Conclusion: 模型可解释性和机制感知对于面临结构性市场变化的决策者具有重要实践价值，应关注不同市场状态下特征贡献的异质性。

Abstract: Norway's electricity market is heavily dominated by hydropower, but the 2021-2022 energy crisis and stronger integration with Continental Europe have fundamentally altered price formation, reducing the reliability of forecasting models calibrated on historical data. Despite the critical need for updated models, a unified benchmark evaluating feature contributions across all structurally diverse Norwegian bidding zones remains lacking. Here we present a comprehensive evaluation of one-step-ahead forecasting of the Nord Pool market across all five Norwegian bidding zones. We constructed a multimodal hourly dataset spanning 2019-2025 and evaluated eight forecasting model families, including Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM), autoregressive models with exogenous variables, and advanced deep learning architectures, using a strictly causal test set. We implemented robust rolling-origin backtesting, leave-one-group-out feature ablation, and conditional regime analysis to dissect model performance and feature utility. Our results show that LightGBM achieves the best performance in every zone, with mean absolute error ranging from 1.60 to 5.58 euros per megawatt-hour, while a ridge-regularized autoregressive model with exogenous variables remains a highly competitive linear benchmark in northern zones. Feature ablation reveals that models relying solely on lagged prices and calendar variables achieve high accuracy and often match or closely approach the performance of the full multimodal model. However, conditional regime analysis demonstrates that external features like reservoir levels and gas prices remain crucial to stratify forecast errors, which consistently increase under stressed market regimes. This highlights the practical value of model interpretability and regime awareness for decision makers facing structural changes in market dynamics.

</details>


### [360] [Learning to Theorize the World from Observation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.03413)
*Doojin Baek,Gyubin Lee,Junyeob Baek,Hosung Lee,Sungjin Ahn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Learning-to-Theorize学习范式及神经理论化器NEO，通过从原始非文本观测中归纳显式解释性理论（可执行组合程序）来理解世界，而非仅预测未来状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当代世界模型通常将理解等同于准确预测，而发展认知科学表明人类理解源于构建关于世界如何运作的内在理论。作者受此启发，探索如何让机器从原始观测中学习显式的解释性理论，而非仅做预测。

Method: 提出Learning-to-Theorize范式，并实例化为Neural Theorizer (NEO)。NEO是一种概率神经模型，将理论表示为可执行的组合程序，通过学习得到的"思维语言"原语，并通过共享的转移模型执行这些程序。

Result: 实验表明该公式能够实现基于解释的泛化，使观测结果可根据生成它们的程序来理解。

Conclusion: NEO通过组合式程序表示理论，能够系统性地重组已学习的原语来解释新现象，为机器构建类人理解能力提供了新路径。

Abstract: What does it mean to understand the world? Contemporary world models often operationalize understanding as accurate future prediction in latent or observation space. Developmental cognitive science, however, suggests a different view: human understanding emerges through the construction of internal theories of how the world works, even before mature language is acquired. Inspired by this theory-building view of cognition, we introduce Learning-to-Theorize, a learning paradigm for inferring explicit explanatory theories of the world from raw, non-textual observations. We instantiate this paradigm with the Neural Theorizer (NEO), a probabilistic neural model that induces latent programs as a learned Language of Thought and executes them through a shared transition model. In NEO, a theory is represented as an executable, compositional program whose learned primitives can be systematically recombined to explain novel phenomena. Experiments show that this formulation enables explanation-driven generalization, allowing observations to be understood in terms of the programs that generate them.

</details>


### [361] [Query-efficient model evaluation using cached responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07096)
*Hayden Helm,Ben Johnson,Carey Priebe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于数据核视角空间（DKPS）的方法，利用已缓存模型响应来预测新模型的基准性能，显著降低查询成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代评估框架中，对每个查询都生成和评估响应的成本过高，而已有模型的缓存响应未被充分利用，因此需要一种查询高效的方法来预测新模型性能。

Method: 基于数据核视角空间（DKPS）量化黑盒设置下模型间关系，利用缓存模型响应预测新模型性能；提出离线查询选择方法以最大化参考模型的拟合优度。

Result: DKPS方法在理论上满足特定条件下的查询高效性；实验表明其在与基线方法达到相同平均绝对误差的情况下，显著减少了查询预算。

Conclusion: DKPS方法能有效利用缓存响应降低评估成本，且离线查询选择策略相比随机选择能进一步提升预测精度。

Abstract: Evaluating a new model on an existing benchmark is often necessary to understand its behavior before deployment. For modern evaluation frameworks, generating and evaluating a response for all queries can be prohibitively expensive. In practice, responses from previously-evaluated models are often cached -- creating a potential opportunity to use this additional information to decrease the number of queries required to accurately evaluate a new model. In this paper, we introduce an approach for predicting benchmark performance that leverages cached model responses based on the Data Kernel Perspective Space (DKPS), a method for quantifying the relationship between models in the black-box setting. Theoretically, we show that DKPS-based methods are query-efficient under certain conditions. Empirically, we demonstrate that DKPS-based methods achieve the same mean absolute error as baselines with a substantially decreased query budget. We conclude by proposing an offline method for selecting a set of queries that maximizes the goodness-of-fit on reference models, improving prediction accuracy over random query selection.

</details>


### [362] [SHRED: Retain-Set-Free Unlearning via Self-Distillation with Logit Demotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07482)
*Zizhao Hu,Ameya Godbole,Johnny Tian-Zheng Wei,Mohammad Rostami,Jesse Thomason,Robin Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SHRED方法，一种无需保留集的大语言模型机器遗忘方法，通过识别高信息量token进行选择性遗忘，在遗忘效果和模型效用之间实现帕累托最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM机器遗忘方法大多需要保留集（retain set）来防止模型效用灾难性下降，这增加了数据依赖和部署复杂性。需要一种无需保留集、同时能兼顾遗忘效果和模型效用的方法。

Method: 两阶段方法：(1) 选择阶段：对遗忘集实例进行前向传播，收集逐token自回归概率，选取概率最低（信息量最高）的token作为遗忘位置，其余位置作为良性锚点；(2) 训练阶段：构建修改后的KL目标，在遗忘位置降低记忆token的logit，在良性位置保留原始分布，通过单一顶层KL自蒸馏目标同时驱动遗忘和效用保持。

Result: 在四个标准遗忘基准上，SHRED实现了遗忘效果与模型效用之间的帕累托最优，超越了依赖保留集的方法；对重新学习攻击和成员推断攻击具有鲁棒性；即使在多次连续遗忘后也能保持稳定的模型效用。

Conclusion: SHRED通过识别高信息token实现无需保留集的LLM遗忘，验证了并非遗忘集实例中所有token都同等携带记忆信息的核心洞见，建立了一个更实用且鲁棒的机器遗忘新范式。

Abstract: Machine unlearning for large language models (LLMs) aims to selectively remove memorized content such as private data, copyrighted text, or hazardous knowledge, without costly full retraining. Most existing methods require a retain set of curated examples to prevent catastrophic degradation of general model utility, creating an extra data dependency that complicates deployment. We propose SHRED (Self-distillation via High-surprisal-only Retain-set-free Entropy Demotion), a retain-set-free unlearning method built on a key insight: not all tokens within a forget set instance carry memorized information equally. High-information tokens concentrate the model's memorized knowledge, while low-information tokens reflect general language competence. SHRED operates in two stages. (1) Selection: We perform a forward pass on a forget set instance, collect per-token autoregressive probabilities, and select the bottom (lowest probability, highest Shannon information) as forget positions; the remaining positions are retained as benign anchors. (2) Training: We construct modified KL targets that demote the memorized token's logit at forget positions while preserving the original distribution at benign positions. The model is then trained via a single top KL self-distillation objective that simultaneously drives forgetting and utility preservation. We evaluate SHRED across four standard unlearning benchmarks and demonstrate that it establishes a new Pareto-optimal trade-off between forget efficacy and model utility, outperforming retain-set-dependent methods. Our analysis shows that SHRED is robust against relearning attacks and membership-inference attacks, and it maintains stable utility even after many sequential unlearning runs.

</details>


### [363] [Path-Coupled Bellman Flows for Distributional Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08253)
*Boyang Xu,Qing Zou,Siqin Yang,Hao Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出路径耦合贝尔曼流（PCBF），一种通过源一致贝尔曼耦合路径学习回报分布的连续时间分布强化学习方法，在保持理论合理性的同时解决边界不匹配和高方差问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分布强化学习方法存在投影误差（有限支撑/分位数方法）或边界不匹配与高方差自助法问题（流式方法），亟需一种既能保持分布保真度又具有训练稳定性的连续时间DRL方法。

Method: PCBF通过源一致贝尔曼耦合路径实现流匹配：当前路径从先验基分布出发（t=0），在t=1达到贝尔曼目标，中间时刻与后继流保持路径仿射关系；通过共享基噪声耦合当前与后继回报流，并引入λ参数化控制变量目标（λ=0无偏，λ>0以可控偏差换取方差降低）。

Result: 在解析可解MRP、OGBench和D4RL基准上的实验表明，PCBF在分布保真度和训练稳定性上优于基线，并取得了有竞争力的离线强化学习性能。

Conclusion: PCBF有效地解决了流式DRL方法中的边界不匹配和高方差问题，为连续时间分布强化学习提供了一种新的有效范式。

Abstract: Distributional reinforcement learning (DRL) models the full return distribution, but existing finite-support or quantile-based methods rely on projections, while recent flow-based approaches can suffer from \emph{boundary mismatch} at the flow source or from \emph{high-variance} bootstrapping when current and successor noises are independent. We propose Path-Coupled Bellman Flows (PCBF), a continuous-time DRL method that learns return distributions with flow matching using \textbf{source-consistent Bellman-coupled paths}: the current path starts from the required base prior at $t{=}0$, reaches the Bellman target at $t{=}1$, and maintains a pathwise affine relation to the successor flow at intermediate times (without requiring time-$t$ marginals to satisfy a distributional Bellman fixed point for all $t$). PCBF couples current and successor return flows through shared base noise and uses a $λ$-parameterized control-variate target: $λ{=}0$ recovers an unbiased sample Bellman target, while $λ{>}0$ trades controlled bias for variance reduction. Experiments on analytically tractable MRPs, OGBench, and D4RL show improved distributional fidelity and training stability, and competitive offline RL performance.

</details>


### [364] [When Attention Beats Fourier: Multi-Scale Transformers for PDE Solving on Irregular Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08318)
*Brandon Yee,Pairie Koh,Jack Rodriguez,Mihir Tekal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出多尺度注意力变换器（MSAT）用于求解偏微分方程，在复杂几何问题上以极短推理时间（34秒）实现SOTA性能，并通过理论边界和消融实验揭示了物理先验的归纳偏差权衡，为深度学习架构选择提供了原则性规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究深度学习求解PDE时的架构选择问题，明确基于注意力的Transformer架构与傅里叶域神经算子之间的性能差异及其适用条件。

Method: 提出MSAT架构，将时空解历史编码为token序列，通过复合监督目标（含可选的物理信息正则化项）进行端到端训练。在5个基准问题上与9种基线方法进行公平对比，并进行了消融实验和理论误差界推导。

Result: MSAT在复杂几何问题Heat2D-CG上达到L²_rel=0.0101，相比FNO提升3.7倍；推理时间34秒，而Mamba-NO需120,812秒。物理先验在扩散主导问题上降低测试误差，但在混沌和回流问题中损害泛化能力。

Conclusion: 基于域边界复杂度κ的近似误差界为架构选择提供了理论依据，物理先验存在精确的误设定边界，应根据问题特性选择架构和正则化策略。

Abstract: We study the problem of \emph{architecture selection} for deep learning models trained to solve partial differential equations (PDEs), asking when transformer-based architectures with learned attention outperform Fourier-domain neural operators. We introduce the \textbf{Multi-Scale Attention Transformer} (\msat{}), a deep learning architecture that encodes spatiotemporal solution histories as token sequences and trains end-to-end via a composite supervised objective with optional physics-informed regularization terms. We conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation against nine baselines -- including physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), neural operators (FNO, DeepONet, GNOT), and state-space models (Mamba-NO) -- across five benchmark problems from the PINNacle suite, using identical train/test splits and reference data for all methods. \msat{} achieves state-of-the-art generalization on complex geometry problems ($L^2_\mathrm{rel} = 0.0101$ on Heat2D-CG, a $3.7\times$ improvement over FNO) at $34\,\mathrm{s}$ total inference vs.\ $120{,}812\,\mathrm{s}$ for Mamba-NO. Ablation studies over the physics regularization component reveal a precise inductive bias tradeoff: physics priors reduce test error on diffusion-dominated problems but degrade generalization on chaotic and recirculating-flow regimes, directly characterizing the prior misspecification boundary. Approximation error bounds as a function of domain boundary complexity $κ$ provide a theoretical basis for these empirical findings and a principled rule for architecture selection.

</details>


### [365] [Surrogate Neural Architecture Codesign Package (SNAC-Pack)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16138)
*Jason Weitz,Dmitri Demler,Benjamin Hawks,Aaron Wang,Nhan Tran,Javier Duarte*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SNAC-Pack是一个开源AutoML框架，用于硬件感知的神经架构协同设计和FPGA端到端部署。它通过多目标全局搜索（Optuna+NSGA-II）、硬件代理模型、联合压缩循环（QAT+剪枝）和hls4ml综合，自动发现高精度、低资源消耗的FPGA架构，在高能物理喷注分类和超导量子比特读出任任务上将数月的设计空间探索缩短至数小时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有NAS方法要么只优化精度，要么依赖与硬件成本相关性差的代理指标（如BOPs），这在FPGA部署场景下尤为突出。FPGA成本由LUT、DSP、触发器、BRAM和延迟等多维资源预算共同决定，需要硬件感知的协同设计方法。

Method: 提出SNAC-Pack框架：1）使用Optuna和NSGA-II进行多目标全局搜索，通过共享SQLite存储支持多节点并行；2）硬件代理模型预测每次试验的资源与延迟，避免昂贵的综合开销；3）局部搜索阶段采用量化感知训练（QAT）与迭代幅度剪枝的联合压缩循环；4）通过hls4ml将最终模型综合为FPGA固件；5）支持YAML配置和可选的智能体前端。

Result: 在大型强子对撞机喷注分类和超导量子比特读出任任务上，发现紧凑架构在匹配或超过强基线任务指标的同时降低了FPGA资源利用率；在量子比特读出任上，将设计空间探索从数月人工调优缩短至数小时自动化搜索。

Conclusion: SNAC-Pack证明了硬件感知的多目标NAS与代理建模相结合能够高效发现满足精度-资源权衡的FPGA部署架构，显著缩短设计周期，为自动化硬件-软件协同设计提供了实用工具。

Abstract: Neural architecture search (NAS) is a powerful approach for automating model design, but existing methods often optimize for accuracy alone or rely on proxy metrics such as bit operations (BOPs) that correlate poorly with hardware cost. This gap is particularly large for FPGA deployment, where cost is dominated by a multi-dimensional budget of lookup tables, DSPs, flip-flops, BRAM, and latency. We present the Surrogate Neural Architecture Codesign Package (SNAC-Pack), an open-source AutoML framework for hardware-aware neural architecture codesign and end-to-end FPGA deployment. SNAC-Pack runs a multi-objective global search with Optuna and NSGA-II, loading trials to a shared SQLite store that enables parallel workers across compute nodes. A hardware surrogate model outputs per-trial resource and latency estimates, avoiding the synthesis cost that would otherwise dominate the search loop. A local search stage then applies quantization-aware training (QAT) together with iterative magnitude pruning in a combined compression loop, after which the final model is synthesized to FPGA firmware via the hls4ml Python library. A YAML configuration and an optional agentic frontend let users run the pipeline on new datasets without modifying the framework. We demonstrate SNAC-Pack on jet classification at the Large Hadron Collider and superconducting qubit readout, discovering compact architectures that match or exceed strong baselines on the task metric while reducing FPGA resource utilization and, in the qubit readout case, reducing the design space exploration process from months of manual fine-tuning to hours of automated search.

</details>


### [366] [Exact Linear Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18848)
*Weinuo Ou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Exact Linear Attention (ELA) 机制，通过核函数的精确分解实现线性计算复杂度，消除了近似误差。同时引入核函数约束解决梯度爆炸和注意力稀释问题，并提出 Hyper-Link、Memory Lobe 和 MoE 路由偏置三项工程创新。实验显示解码速度提升6倍，KV缓存减少75%，并成功拓展到视觉模型 YOLO-LAT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有线性注意力方法存在近似误差，且面临梯度爆炸和token注意力稀释两大局限性，限制了其在长序列任务中的实际应用效果。

Method: (1) 利用核函数的精确分解实现线性复杂度注意力；(2) 施加核约束确保非负性、可区分性和几何可解释性；(3) 提出三种核函数：Hadamard Exp Kernel、Summation Squared Euclidean Distance Kernel、Subtraction Squared Euclidean Distance Kernel；(4) Hyper-Link 替代残差连接；(5) Memory Lobe 模块基于双向线性注意力捕获跨层"变换流"；(6) 基于路由分数的 MoE 偏置机制。

Result: 解码速度提升6倍，KV缓存内存减少75%；训练性能相当或更优；内存模块加速收敛并提升泛化能力；YOLO-LAT 实现4.3倍GPU推理加速、7.9倍参数量减少，检测精度具有竞争力。

Conclusion: Exact Linear Attention 在长序列和高效视觉任务中具有广泛适用性，为缩放 Transformer 模型提供了有效方案。

Abstract: This paper introduces Exact Linear Attention (ELA), a mechanism that achieves linear computational complexity for Transformer attention by exploiting the exact decomposition property of kernel functions, thereby eliminating approximation error. We identify and address two key limitations of prior linear attention -- gradient explosion and token attention dilution -- by imposing kernel constraints that ensure non-negativity, discriminability, and geometric interpretability. Several kernel functions are proposed, including the Hadamard Exp Kernel, Summation Squared Euclidean Distance Kernel, and Subtraction Squared Euclidean Distance Kernel, each tailored for specific attention behaviors.
  Beyond the core attention formulation, the paper presents three engineering innovations: (1) a Hyper-Link structure that replaces traditional residual connections to mitigate gradient degradation; (2) a Memory Lobe module based on bidirectional linear attention, which captures "transformation flow" across layers to implement qualitative memory and an implicit reinforcement learning paradigm; and (3) a routing-score-based bias mechanism for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) to improve interpretability and semantic alignment.
  Experimental results demonstrate that ELA achieves up to 6x faster decoding speed and 75% reduction in KV cache memory usage compared to full attention, while maintaining comparable or superior training performance. The proposed memory module accelerates convergence and enhances generalization. Furthermore, we extend the linear attention principle to vision models, yielding YOLO-LAT, which attains up to 4.3x GPU inference speedup and 7.9x parameter reduction with competitive detection accuracy. These results underline the broad applicability of exact linear attention for scaling Transformer models to ultra-long sequences and efficient visual tasks.

</details>


### [367] [Toto 2.0: Time Series Forecasting Enters the Scaling Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20119)
*Emaad Khwaja,Chris Lettieri,Gerald Woo,Eden Belouadah,Marc Cenac,Guillaume Jarry,Enguerrand Paquin,Xunyi Zhao,Viktoriya Zhukov,Othmane Abou-Amal,Chenghao Liu,Ameet Talwalkar,David Asker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文展示了时序基础模型的扩展规律：从4M到2.5B参数规模，单一训练配方即可带来可靠的预测质量提升。发布了Toto 2.0系列五个开源权重预测模型，在BOOM、GIFT-Eval和TIME三个基准测试上达到了新SOTA。报告详述了架构、训练配方、数据及u-muP超参数迁移管线等设计决策，所有模型以Apache 2.0许可证发布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证时序基础模型是否具有扩展性（scaling property），即随着参数量增大能否持续提升预测性能，并开源高质量的预训练模型以推动该领域发展。

Method: 采用统一的训练配方，从4M到2.5B参数进行多规模训练；提出u-muP超参数迁移管线实现跨规模超参数转移；设计了架构、训练数据和训练配方的整体方案。

Result: Toto 2.0系列在BOOM、GIFT-Eval和TIME三个时序预测基准上均取得最高分数，建立了新的SOTA。

Conclusion: 时序基础模型具备可靠的扩展性，通过统一的训练配方和合理的架构设计，可以持续提升预测性能。开源模型有助于社区进一步研究和应用。

Abstract: We show that time series foundation models scale: a single training recipe produces reliable forecast-quality improvements from 4M to 2.5B parameters. We release Toto 2.0, a family of five open-weights forecasting models trained under this recipe. The Toto 2.0 family sets a new state of the art on three forecasting benchmarks: BOOM, our observability benchmark; GIFT-Eval, the standard general-purpose benchmark; and the recent contamination-resistant TIME benchmark. This report describes our experimental results and details the design decisions behind Toto 2.0: its architecture and training recipe, training data, and the u-muP hyperparameter transfer pipeline. All five base checkpoints are released under Apache 2.0.

</details>


### [368] [Reflex: Reinforcement Learning with Reflection Symmetry Exploitation in State-Based Continuous Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23415)
*Shuai Zhen,Yifan Zhang,Yuling Wang,Yanhua Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对基于状态的连续控制任务，提出Reflex框架，利用反射对称性（轴向反射和双边反射）通过原则性的对称正则化机制提升强化学习的样本效率，在PPO和SAC上验证了优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习长期受困于样本效率低下；现有利用群不变MDP的研究主要聚焦于图像RL和旋转对称，基于状态的RL和反射对称性尚未被充分探索。

Method: 形式化定义了两种反射对称类型（轴向反射和双边反射）及其变换；基于对称性保持的最优值函数和策略的理论分析，提出Reflex框架，通过原则性的对称正则化机制将反射对称性融入策略学习，可无缝集成到on-policy和off-policy RL算法中。

Result: 在OpenAI Gym和DeepMind Control基准测试上，集成了Reflex的PPO和SAC相比标准基线展现出更优的性能和样本效率。

Conclusion: 反射对称性可以有效提升基于状态的连续控制任务的样本效率，Reflex框架通过对称正则化机制实现了这一目标，且具有良好的算法兼容性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has long struggled with poor sample efficiency. One promising approach to mitigate this problem is leveraging group-invariant Markov Decision Processes ($G$-invariant MDPs). Existing works in this direction have primarily focused on image-based RL and rotational symmetry such as $\mathrm{SO(2)}$, leaving state-based RL and reflection symmetry largely underexplored. In this work, we focus on state-based continuous control tasks and exploit reflection symmetry by introducing Reflex, a paradigm that seamlessly integrates with both on-policy and off-policy RL algorithms. We formalize two types of reflection-axial reflection and bilateral reflection, and characterize their corresponding transformations. Building on a theoretical analysis of symmetry-preserving optimal value functions and policies, Reflex integrates reflection symmetry into policy learning through principled symmetry regularization mechanisms. We integrate Reflex with PPO and SAC, and evaluate it on a suite of OpenAI Gym and DeepMind Control benchmarks, demonstrating superior performance over standard baselines while improving sample efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/TonyStark042/Reflex.

</details>


### [369] [Class-Dependent Hybrid Data Augmentation for Multiclass Migraine Classification under Severe Class Imbalance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23453)
*Elvin Somón,Miguel A. Gutiérrez-Naranjo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对偏头痛分类研究中的复现性问题，通过纠正数据泄露和度量偏差重新评估了先前方法，并提出了一种包含临床驱动的亚型聚合、类别依赖的混合增强策略以及保真度不对称性概念的新型分类框架。实验结果显示，该方法在七个偏头痛亚型、400名患者的数据集上，以宏观平均F1为主要指标，将基线性能从0.71提升至0.862（跨分类器平均），峰值达到0.914（FT-Transformer+比例增强），同时揭示了问题重构（临床亚型聚合）比数据增强贡献更大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前偏头痛分类研究存在数据泄露和度量偏差等方法论缺陷，导致性能估计虚高；同时，不同偏头痛亚型的样本不平衡问题亟待解决。

Method: (i) 根据ICHD-3 §1.2.3对两种偏瘫型偏头痛进行临床驱动的亚型聚合；(ii) 基于每类样本量分配生成方法的类别依赖混合增强策略；(iii) 提出保真度不对称性概念，从而引入比例约束增长替代完全类别平衡。采用两阶段协议，在七亚型400患者数据集上进行分层5折交叉验证，以宏观平均F1为主要指标。

Result: 纠正方法论缺陷后，校正基线宏F1为0.71。所提框架跨八个分类器平均宏F1达0.862，优于高斯Copula(0.836)、CTGAN(0.815)及无增强基线(0.801)；FT-Transformer在比例增强下达到峰值0.914。无增强FT-Transformer基线(0.896)表明，临床驱动的类别聚合贡献了大部分绝对提升。

Conclusion: 框架的主要可测量贡献在于提升跨分类器的平均鲁棒性，问题重构（临床亚型聚合）在性能提升中起主导作用，而数据增强带来的边际收益相对有限。

Abstract: We conducted a reproducibility-oriented re-evaluation of prior migraine classification studies, correcting for data leakage and metric bias. We then introduced (i) a clinically motivated aggregation of two hemiplegic subtypes following ICHD-3 §1.2.3, (ii) a class-dependent hybrid augmentation strategy that assigns generation methods based on per-class sample size, and (iii) the concept of fidelity asymmetry, motivating proportionally constrained growth as an alternative to full class balance. Experiments were performed on a dataset of 400 patients across seven migraine subtypes under a two-stage protocol, including the six-class configuration described above. Models were evaluated using stratified 5-fold cross-validation with macro-averaged F1 as the primary metric.
  Correcting methodological flaws reduces previously inflated performance estimates, with the corrected macro-F1 baseline standing at 0.71. The proposed framework consistently outperformed individual augmenters in macro-F1 averaged across the eight evaluated classifiers (0.862 vs. 0.836 for Gaussian Copula, 0.815 for CTGAN, and 0.801 for the no-augmentation baseline), and achieved its peak result of 0.914 with FT-Transformer under proportional augmentation. The no-augmentation FT-Transformer baseline (0.896) shows that, at the per-classifier ceiling, clinically motivated class aggregation accounts for most of the absolute improvement; the framework's principal measurable contribution is the gain in average robustness across classifiers, highlighting the dominant role of problem formulation.

</details>


### [370] [Spectral Probe-Circuits: A Three-Step Recipe for Identifying Attention-Head Circuits in Pretrained Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24059)
*Yongzhong Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种三步法识别预训练Transformer中注意力头电路：谱信号排序→任务模式筛选→分组消融验证。跨8倍参数范围、两种架构、四个预训练流程验证，发现2-6个头的归纳电路是因果必需的，消融后性能下降94-100%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖标签或归因梯度来识别注意力头电路，缺乏无监督、跨模型通用的电路发现方法。需要一种不依赖标签、可迁移的电路识别流程。

Method: 三步法：(1) 每个注意力头的谱信号（时间积分的参与比）排序，无标签识别持续执行内容相关计算的头部；(2) 任务模式筛选，将通用指标转为任务特定候选电路；(3) 分组消融与匹配随机对照完成因果验证。

Result: 跨51M-1B激活/7B总参、密集/MoE两种架构、四个预训练流程验证。2-6个头的归纳电路因果必需，消融后top-1下降94-100%。谱信号可预测且无需监督；51M探针模型6个随机种子均能识别种子特定电路。专门化计算头部比例在Pythia家族（124M-410M）中守恒为17-19%，归纳电路规模为3-11个头（次线性于总头数）。

Conclusion: 提出了一套无需标签、跨模型通用的注意力头电路识别方法论，验证了归纳电路在不同规模模型中的因果必要性，发现头数增长时专门化电路规模呈次线性扩展。该方法可作为三篇论文系列的方法论锚点。

Abstract: We present a three-step recipe for identifying attention-head circuits in pretrained transformers. A per-head spectral signal -- the time-integrated participation ratio of each head's attention output -- ranks heads doing sustained content-dependent computation without labels or attribution gradients. A task-pattern screen filters this general indicator into a task-specific candidate circuit, and group ablation against a matched-random control completes the causal claim. We validate across an 8x parameter range (51M to 1B-active / 7B-total), two architecture families (dense, mixture-of-experts), and four pretraining pipelines. The recipe ports: a 2-6 head induction circuit is causally necessary in every model tested, with a 94-100% drop in synthetic-induction top-1 after ablation. The spectral signal is predictive without supervision: on six independent seeds of a 51M-parameter probe model, the same computation identifies the seed-specific circuit on each seed. The fraction of heads doing identifiable specialized computation is conserved at 17-19% across the Pythia family (124M to 410M), while specific induction circuits stay 3-11 heads -- sublinear in total head count. This paper is the methodology anchor of a three-paper program; companion papers extend the recipe to developmental trajectories during pretraining and to composed-task circuits where pattern selectivity decouples from task-causal structure.

</details>


### [371] [Extreme Region Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25582)
*Changyu Chen,Xiting Wang,Rui Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出极端区域策略蒸馏（ERPD），通过两阶段框架解耦样本效率与KL效率：第一阶段在固定数据上执行弱约束的离策略优化以充分提取训练信号，第二阶段将这些信号蒸馏回基策略并施加信任域约束，在保留有用信号的同时过滤有害漂移。实验表明ERPD在数学推理任务上优于严格在策略方法，且能兼容弱教师模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型强化学习中，严格在策略方法样本效率低（轨迹单次使用后丢弃），而离策略复用引入分布不匹配。现有信任域方法主要通过保守优化缓解此问题，但往往未能充分利用丰富的训练信号。作者希望解耦样本效率与KL效率，在充分提取训练信号的同时避免策略退化。

Method: 两阶段框架ERPD：阶段一在固定数据上执行弱约束的离策略优化（多步更新），最大化提取训练信号；阶段二将阶段一得到的策略提供的token级监督信号蒸馏回基策略，在信任域约束下过滤有害漂移，保留有益信号。该方法同时支持强教师和弱教师（当激进优化未产生更强策略时，通过替代信号构建策略仍可提供有效监督）。

Result: 在数学推理任务上，对于强基模型（在策略训练已停滞时）仍有增益；弱教师也能带来可靠改进。蒸馏后的策略在KL散度显著更小的情况下达到可比或更好的性能，表明第一阶段的大量KL散度浪费在非必要的漂移而非真正改进上。

Conclusion: ERPD有效解耦了样本效率与KL效率，通过两阶段蒸馏框架在充分利用训练信号的同时保持策略稳定性，且对教师模型质量具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning for large language models faces a fundamental trade-off between sample efficiency and asymptotic performance: strictly on-policy methods discard trajectories after a single update, while off-policy reuse introduces distribution mismatch that existing trust-region techniques mitigate primarily by enforcing conservative optimization, often leaving rich training signals underutilized. To investigate this, we perform extensive off-policy updates on fixed data. Our experiments reveal that aggressive multi-step optimization brings rapid initial gains, but excessive updates cause trajectory probabilities to deviate and entropy to collapse, with performance plateauing early. Tightening KL constraints merely lowers the ceiling without resolving the degradation. This motivates Extreme Region Policy Distillation (ERPD), a two-stage framework that decouples sample efficiency from KL efficiency. The first stage performs weakly constrained off-policy optimization on fixed data to maximally extract training signals. The resulting policy provides token-level supervision. In the second stage, we distill these signals into the base policy under trust-region constraints, filtering harmful drift while preserving useful signals. The distilled policy achieves comparable or better performance with substantially smaller KL divergence, indicating that much of the first-stage divergence was spent on unnecessary drift rather than genuine improvement. Crucially, ERPD accommodates both strong and weak teachers: when aggressive optimization yields no stronger policy, even degenerate teachers provide effective supervision via alternative signal construction strategies. We validate ERPD on mathematical reasoning, showing gains for strong base models where on-policy training plateaus, and reliable improvements with weak teachers.

</details>


### [372] [Detectability in Diversity: Improved Canary Crafting for Privacy Auditing in One Run](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27292)
*Mathieu Dagréou,Aurélien Bellet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对单次运行隐私审计中"金丝雀"样本的构造问题，提出结合影响函数的贪心初始化和双层优化方法，使金丝雀兼具高可检测性和低干扰性，实验表明该方法能以更低计算成本获得更强的隐私泄露估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单次运行隐私审计方法中，金丝雀间的相互干扰导致隐私泄露估计弱于多次运行方法；需要更高效的金丝雀构造策略来提升单次审计的效用。

Method: 结合基于影响函数的贪心初始化与双层优化流程：贪心初始化筛选高影响力样本，双层优化在最大化可区分性的同时促进嵌入空间的多样性，从而降低金丝雀间的干扰。

Result: 实验表明该方法比现有金丝雀构造方法获得更强的隐私泄露估计，且计算成本更低。

Conclusion: 通过优化金丝雀的可检测性与抗干扰性，单次运行隐私审计可在较低计算开销下达到与多次运行方法更接近的隐私估计效果。

Abstract: Privacy auditing aims to empirically assess privacy leakage in machine learning models using membership inference attacks (MIAs), and to derive lower bounds on differential privacy (DP) parameters. Recent one-run auditing methods address the high cost of standard approaches by relying on a single training run with multiple "canary" points whose inclusion or exclusion must be detected by the auditor. In this work, we study the problem of efficiently crafting canaries for one-run privacy auditing. Motivated by recent theoretical insights suggesting that interference between canaries contributes to weaker leakage estimates compared to multi-run methods, we propose to optimize canaries to be both highly detectable and minimally interfering. Our approach combines a greedy initialization based on influence functions with a bilevel optimization procedure that maximizes distinguishability while promoting diversity in embedding space, enabling the use of computationally efficient bilevel algorithms. Experiments show that our method achieves stronger privacy leakage estimates at a lower computational cost than existing canary crafting approaches.

</details>


### [373] [Filter, Then Reweight: Rethinking Optimization Granularity in On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02684)
*Yuying Li,Leqi Zheng,Yongzi Yu,Wenrui Zhou,Xuchang Zhong,Xing Hu,Jing Jin,Hangjie Yuan,Tao Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FiRe-OPD提出了一种联合轨迹级和token级的过滤与软重加权方法，用于大语言模型的策略蒸馏（OPD），在强到弱、单教师和多教师设置下均优于现有token级OPD方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OPD方法越来越关注如何选择更有价值的轨迹、token和监督信号，但缺乏在轨迹和token两级同时进行精细优化的工作。作者希望在保留更多信息的同时提升优化稳定性，实现更细粒度的OPD优化。

Method: FiRe-OPD包含两个步骤：(1) 轨迹级过滤：去除低质量rollout样本；(2) token级软重加权：在保留的轨迹中对信息量大的token赋予更高权重。采用软加权而非硬选择，以减少信息损失并提升优化稳定性。

Result: 在强到弱设置下AIME 2024提升6.25，在多教师设置下Miner提升18.81，优于近期token级OPD方法。

Conclusion: 联合轨迹级过滤与token级软重加权的细粒度优化策略能有效提升OPD性能，验证了在不同蒸馏设置下的优越性和泛化能力。

Abstract: On-Policy distillation (OPD) in large language models is shifting from full-trace KL supervision toward more selective training paradigms. Recent OPD methods increasingly focus on selecting which trajectories to learn from, which tokens are most informative, and which supervision signals are most reliable. Motivated by this trend, we rethink optimization granularity of OPD and propose \fireicon\ FiRe-OPD (Filter, then Reweight), which jointly adjusts supervision signals at both trajectory and token levels. In details, FiRe-OPD first filters trajectories to remove low-quality rollout samples, and then applies soft reweighting within the retained trajectories to emphasize informative tokens. Compared with hard token selection, FiRe-OPD leverages a soft-weighting mechanism to effectively mitigate information loss and enhance optimization stability, thereby achieving finer-grained OPD optimization. We validate the effectiveness of FiRe-OPD across strong-to-weak, single-teacher, and multi-teacher settings, and demonstrate its superiority over recent token-level OPD methods ( (e.g., +6.25 on AIME 2024 in strong-to-weak, +18.81 on Miner in multi-teacher). Our code is available at https://github.com/YuYingLi0/FiRe-OPD.

</details>


### [374] [ASymPO: Asymmetric-Scale Policy Optimization for Asynchronous LLM Post-Training Without Behavior Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03070)
*Zehua Liu,Yuxuan Yao,Xiaojin Fu,Tao Zhong,Mingxuan Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ASymPO算法，仅使用当前策略概率即可稳定异步组相对RL训练，通过正则化每个响应的token损失来解决尺度不平衡问题，无需行为策略概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步强化学习在语言模型后训练中通过解耦响应生成与策略优化提升吞吐量，但陈旧响应会导致分布漂移。现有行为校正方法需要行为策略概率，在token对齐、版本控制和数值一致性方面存在工程挑战。作者希望探索是否仅用当前策略概率就能稳定异步组相对RL。

Method: 识别出尺度不平衡故障模式：陈旧响应在当前策略下评估时，正负损失项出现在不同的负对数概率尺度上，导致零和优势不再意味着平衡的损失贡献。提出ASymPO，将每个响应的token损失除以其当前平均token负对数概率进行归一化，恢复响应级零和平衡并保留非零学习信号。同时提出SPO作为固定负缩放的基线方法。

Result: 在异步数学推理后训练任务上，仅使用当前策略概率的目标函数（ASymPO和SPO）能够有效工作，ASymPO无需行为策略概率即可稳定训练。

Conclusion: ASymPO通过简单的归一化机制解决了异步RL中因陈旧响应导致的尺度不平衡问题，消除了对行为策略概率的依赖，为异步语言模型后训练提供了更简洁有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning can improve language-model post-training throughput by decoupling response generation from policy optimization, but stale responses introduce distribution drift. Standard behavior-corrected methods control this drift with behavior-policy probabilities, importance ratios, or clipping, which requires token-aligned, versioned, and numerically consistent behavior log-probabilities across rollout and learner systems. We ask whether asynchronous group-relative RL can instead be stabilized using only current-policy probabilities. We identify a scale-imbalance failure mode: when stale responses are evaluated under the current policy, positive and negative loss terms can appear at different negative log-probability scales, so zero-sum advantages no longer imply balanced loss contributions. We propose Asymmetric-Scale Policy Optimization (ASymPO), which normalizes each response's token loss by its current average token negative log-probability. ASymPO requires no behavior-policy probabilities, restores response-level zero-sum balance, and preserves a nonzero learning signal. We also introduce Scaled Policy Optimization (SPO), a fixed negative-scaling baseline, and evaluate both current-policy-only objectives in asynchronous mathematical reasoning post-training.

</details>


### [375] [Do Transformers Need Three Projections? Systematic Study of QKV Variants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04032)
*Ali Kayyam,Anusha Madan Gopal,M Anthony Lewis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了Transformer中QKV投影共享的三种变体（Q-K=V、Q=K-V、Q=K=V），发现Q-K=V在多项任务上表现与标准QKV相当或更优，在语言建模中可减少50% KV缓存且仅导致3.1%困惑度下降，与GQA/MQA结合可实现高达96.9%的缓存缩减，有利于边缘设备部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer中QKV注意力机制的三类投影各自贡献不明确，省略某些投影的影响尚不清楚，本文旨在系统评估投影共享约束的效果。

Method: 提出三种投影共享约束：a) Q-K=V（共享键值投影），b) Q=K-V（共享查询键投影），c) Q=K=V（单投影）。对对称注意力变体引入2D位置编码实现非对称注意力。实验涵盖合成任务、视觉任务（MNIST、CIFAR、TinyImageNet、异常检测）及语言建模（300M/1.2B参数模型在10B tokens上训练）。

Result: Q-K=V变体在多数任务上与标准QKV表现相当或更优；语言建模中实现50% KV缓存缩减，仅3.1%困惑度退化；与GQA-4结合达87.5%缓存缩减，与MQA结合达96.9%。Q=K-V变体会破坏注意力方向性导致性能下降。

Conclusion: 投影共享是一种被忽视的注意力权重绑定方法，Q-K=V因键值可共享相似表征空间且注意力呈低秩特性而保持质量，具有显著的推理内存优势，尤其适合边缘部署。

Abstract: Transformers have become the standard solution for various AI tasks, with the query, key, and value (QKV) attention formulation playing a central role. However, the individual contribution of these three projections and the impact of omitting some remain poorly understood. We systematically evaluate three projection sharing constraints: a) Q-K=V (shared key-value), b) Q=K-V (shared query-key), and c) Q=K=V (single projection). The last two variants produce symmetric attention maps; to address this, we also explore asymmetric attention via 2D positional encodings. Through experiments spanning synthetic tasks, vision (MNIST, CIFAR, TinyImageNet, anomaly), and language modeling (300M and 1.2B parameter models on 10B tokens), we discovered that our transformers perform on par or occasionally better than the QKV transformer. In language modeling, Q-K=V projection sharing achieves 50% KV cache reduction with only 3.1% perplexity degradation. Crucially, projection sharing is complementary to head sharing (GQA/MQA): combining Q-K=V with GQA-4 yields 87.5% cache reduction, while Q-K=V + MQA achieves 96.9%, enabling practical on-device inference. We show that Q-K=V preserves quality because keys and values can occupy similar representational spaces and attention operates in a low-rank regime, whereas Q=K-V breaks attention directionality. Our results systematically characterize projection sharing as an underexplored instance of weight tying in attention, with direct, quantifiable inference memory benefits, particularly valuable for edge deployment. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Brainchip-Inc/Do-Transformers-Need-3-Projections

</details>


### [376] [Policy Gradient for Continuous-Time Robust Markov Decision Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04335)
*Tanya Veeravalli,David M. Bossens,Atsushi Nitanda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次在连续时间鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程（RMDP）框架下研究策略梯度算法，推导了路径依赖和伴随方法下的策略梯度与对抗梯度公式，提出了双循环优化器（线性收敛）和均值场优化器（分布式优化），并给出了相应的样本复杂度分析，在神经常微分方程动力学上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统RMDP局限于离散时间动力学，而许多实际控制问题本质上是连续时间的。本文旨在将RMDP框架拓展至连续时间，并设计高效的策略梯度算法。

Method: 1) 利用路径依赖和伴随方法推导连续时间RMDP的策略梯度与对抗梯度公式；2) 提出双循环优化器实现oracle设置下的线性收敛；3) 提出均值场优化器作为分布式优化器，并给出N粒子近似下的样本复杂度分析；4) 推导了无折扣总成本MDP的新分析工具。

Result: 双循环优化器在oracle设置下达到线性收敛，样本设置下达到Õ(1/ε²)样本复杂度；均值场优化器在oracle设置下达到Õ(1/K)收敛速率，N粒子近似下达到Õ(N²/ε)样本复杂度。

Conclusion: 连续时间策略梯度算法在连续时间RMDP上有效，为处理连续时间鲁棒控制问题提供了理论保证和实用算法。

Abstract: The framework of robust Markov decision processes (RMDPs) allows the design of reinforcement learning agents that satisfy performance guarantees under worst-case transition dynamics. Traditional RMDPs consider discrete-time dynamics and recently, sample-efficient policy gradient algorithms have been considered in this context. This paper investigates policy gradient algorithms within a continuous-time RMDP framework. Policy gradients and adversarial gradients are derived using pathwise and adjoint-based formulas for stochastic and ordinary differential equations. We propose double-loop optimisers to obtain linear convergence in the oracle-based setting and an $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{1}{ε^2})$ sample complexity in the sample-based setting in an analysis which also derives novel tools for the framework of undiscounted total cost MDPs. Additionally, we propose mean-field optimisers as distributional optimisers with an $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{1}{K})$ oracle-based convergence rate and an $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{N^2}ε)$ sample complexity under $N$-particle approximation. The effectiveness of continuous-time policy gradient algorithms is confirmed for both optimisers on continuous-time RMDPs with neural ordinary differential equation dynamics.

</details>


### [377] [LimiX-2M: Mitigating Low-Rank Collapse and Attention Bottlenecks in Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04485)
*Yuanrui Wang,Xingxuan Zhang,Han Yu,Mingchao Hao,Gang Ren,Hao Yuan,Li Mao,Yunjia Zhang,Chun Yuan,Peng Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RaBEL（通过RBF扩展标量特征）+ 重新排序的双向块S->N->F（先聚合跨样本上下文再特征混合）的tokenize-and-route框架，构建2M参数模型LimiX-2M，在表格基准上超越更大的TabPFN-v2和TabICL，同时降低训练推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型（TFMs）虽能媲美树集成模型，但计算效率低下：标准仿射标量token化仅通过一维通道注入特征值变化，特征ID/位置信号无法增加值自由度，导致早期层值敏感性弱和隐藏状态冗余。

Method: 1) RaBEL：将每个标量扩展为紧凑的局部RBF特征（可选指数门控），改善条件化和浅层有效秩；2) 重排序双向块S->N->F：先聚合跨样本上下文再特征混合，并使用注意力池化，使计算与读出对齐。

Result: LimiX-2M（2M参数）在广泛使用的表格基准上超越更大的TabPFN-v2和TabICL，同时降低训练和推理成本。

Conclusion: 值感知的token化与读出对齐的路由是改善TFMs准确率-效率权衡的关键杠杆。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) increasingly rival tree ensembles, but their performance is often compute-inefficient: with standard affine scalar tokenization, each feature injects value variation through an essentially one-dimensional channel, and feature IDs/positional signals cannot increase within-feature value degrees of freedom, yielding weak early-layer value sensitivity and redundant hidden states. We present a unified tokenize-and-route framework for strong TFMs: RaBEL expands each scalar into compact localized RBF features (optionally exponent-gated) to improve conditioning and shallow-layer effective rank, while a reordered bidirectional block S->N->F aligns computation with the readout by aggregating cross-sample context before feature mixing and using attention pooling. Together, these changes yield LimiX-2M, a 2M-parameter model that outperforms larger TabPFN-v2 and TabICL baselines on widely used tabular benchmarks while reducing training and inference costs. These results highlight value-aware tokenization and readout-aligned routing as key levers for improving the accuracy--efficiency trade-off in TFMs. Model checkpoints and inference code are available at https://github.com/limix-ldm-ai/LimiX.

</details>


### [378] [Rollout-Level Advantage-Prioritized Experience Replay for GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04560)
*Gyeongtae Yoo,Sanghyeok Park,Soohyuk Jang,Ik-hwan Kim,Sungroh Yoon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对GRPO在推理LLM后训练中样本效率低下的问题，提出了一种基于轨迹级重放缓冲区的改进方法，通过时效驱逐、新鲜锚定组合和优势优先级采样，显著提升了训练效率和模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准GRPO方法样本效率低，每次 rollout 仅用于一次梯度更新即被丢弃。简单重放不适用，因为LLM策略每步梯度漂移大，存储的rollout迅速过时，会 destabilize 训练。

Method: 提出轨迹级重放缓冲区：1) 按年龄驱逐（超过τ_max步的rollout被移除）；2) 新鲜锚定组合（每个batch保留当前新鲜on-policy rollout，再拼接从缓冲区采样的重放rollout）；3) 按每个rollout的优势幅度进行优先级采样，回收优势大的rollout。

Result: 在Qwen3-Base三种规模、五个数学基准上，该方法优于GRPO和朴素重放基线。增益随模型规模增长，4B模型上五基准平均增益+4.35pp，AES（精度+token效率联合指标）提升+0.579。

Conclusion: 提出的轨迹级重放缓冲区有效解决了GRPO样本效率低和策略漂移导致的过时问题，在不同规模模型上均带来一致提升，且增益随模型规模扩大而增大。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards with GRPO is a standard approach for post-training reasoning LLMs. It remains sample inefficient. Each rollout is used for a single gradient update and then discarded. Naive replay is not well suited in this setting because LLM policies drift quickly per gradient step. Stored rollouts therefore become stale and can destabilize training. We propose a rollout-level replay buffer for GRPO that stores and samples individual rollouts rather than whole groups. The buffer bounds staleness through age eviction. Any rollout older than tau_max training steps is removed. The buffer also preserves on-policy data via fresh-anchored composition. Each batch keeps its fresh on-policy rollouts and then concatenates replay rollouts drawn separately from the buffer. We prioritize replay by per-rollout advantage magnitude and recycle individual rollouts whose advantages are large. Across three Qwen3-Base scales on five math benchmarks, our method outperforms GRPO and naive replay baselines. Gains are positive at every scale and grow with model size. The largest gain is +4.35 pp on the five-benchmark average at 4B. Under an AES metric that jointly measures accuracy and token efficiency, the efficiency margin over GRPO is again largest at 4B, at +0.579.

</details>


### [379] [Learning Long Range Spatio-Temporal Representations over Continuous Time Dynamic Graphs with State Space Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04672)
*Ayushman Raghuvanshi,Thummaluru Siddartha Reddy,Sundeep Prabhakar Chepuri,Mahesh Chandran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CTDG-SSM，一种基于状态空间模型的连续时间动态图表示学习方法。通过引入CTT-HiPPO算子，将HiPPO与拉普拉斯矩阵多项式结合，实现拓扑感知的长期记忆更新，有效捕获长时域和多跳结构信息。在动态链路预测、节点分类和序列分类任务上达到SOTA，尤其擅长长程时空推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续时间动态图方法仅能捕获一跳或局部时间邻域信息，无法处理多跳（全局）结构模式和长程时间依赖，亟需一种能同时在时间和空间维度上进行长期信息传播的建模框架。

Method: (1) 提出CTT-HiPPO算子，通过拉普拉斯矩阵多项式投影经典HiPPO的解，实现拓扑感知的记忆更新；(2) 将CTT-HiPPO等价转化为状态空间模型CTDG-SSM；(3) 采用零阶保持法得到计算高效的离散形式。

Result: 在动态链路预测、动态节点分类和序列分类基准上达到SOTA性能，在需要长程时空推理的数据集上取得显著性能提升。

Conclusion: CTDG-SSM通过状态空间模型框架结合拓扑感知的高阶多项式投影，有效解决了连续时间动态图中的长程信息传播问题，验证了SSM在动态图学习中的潜力。

Abstract: Continuous-time dynamic graphs (CTDGs) provide a richer framework to capture fine-grained temporal patterns in evolving relational data. Long-range information propagation is a key challenge while learning representations, wherein it is important to retain and update information over long temporal horizons. Existing approaches restrict models to capture one-hop or local temporal neighborhoods and fail to capture multi-hop or global structural patterns. To mitigate this, we derive a parameter-efficient state-space modeling framework for continuous-time dynamic graphs (CTDG-SSM) from first principles. We first introduce continuous-time Topology-Aware higher order polynomial projection operator (CTT-HiPPO), a novel memory-based reformulation of HiPPO to jointly encode temporal dynamics and graph structure. The solution from CTT-HiPPO is obtained by projecting the classical HiPPO solution through a polynomial of the Laplacian matrix, yielding topology-aware memory updates that admit an equivalent state-space formulation for CTDGs (CTDG-SSM). Then a computationally efficient discrete formulation is obtained using the zero-order hold approach for model implementation.
  Across benchmarks on dynamic link prediction, dynamic node classification, and sequence classification, CTDG-SSM achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, it achieves large performance gains on datasets that require long range temporal (LRT) and spatial reasoning.

</details>


### [380] [UniFair: A unified fair clustering approach based on separation and compactness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04777)
*Antonia Karra,Vasiliki Papanikou,Georgios Vardakas,Evaggelia Pitoura,Aristidis Likas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出UniFair统一框架，联合优化分离公平性（使受保护群体远离决策边界）和社会公平性（减少组间聚类成本差异），通过梯度优化实现k-means及深度聚类的公平聚类，在表格和图像数据集上以小幅聚类损失提升显著降低两类群体差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公平聚类方法通常只优化单一公平性概念，忽略了聚类成本与决策边界几何特性之间的相互作用。

Method: 提出UniFair统一框架，联合优化分离公平性和社会公平性；开发基于梯度的优化过程用于分离公平和统一的k-means目标，并扩展至深度聚类（在自编码器潜空间强制执行相同准则）。

Result: 在表格和图像数据集上，UniFair在仅小幅增加聚类损失的情况下，显著降低了边界相关和成本相关的群体差异。

Conclusion: UniFair能够同时处理两种不同的公平性度量，实现更全面的公平聚类。

Abstract: Clustering is increasingly used to support high-impact decisions, yet standard objectives such as k-means can produce clusterings that treat demographic groups unequally. Existing fair clustering methods typically optimize a single notion of fairness and often overlook how clustering costs interact with the geometry of the induced decision boundaries. We propose UniFair, a unified framework that jointly optimizes separation fairness and social fairness. Separation fairness encourages protected groups to lie farther from the induced decision boundaries, while social fairness reduces disparities in within-cluster distortion by penalizing group-wise clustering costs. We develop gradient-based optimization procedures for separation-fair and unified k-means objectives, and extend them to deep clustering by enforcing the same criteria in the latent space of an autoencoder. Experiments on tabular and image datasets show that UniFair reduces both boundary-related and cost-based group disparities with only a modest increase in clustering loss.

</details>


### [381] [The Right Measure for Physics-Constrained Generation: A Co-Area Correction for Posterior-Consistent PDE Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04804)
*Jian Xu,Delu Zeng,John Paisley,Qibin Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明，现有的通过硬约束（投影或引导）将生成模型（扩散/流匹配）用于PDE逆问题的方法，由于忽略了Borel-Kolmogorov悖论和Fixman Jacobian因子，采样的是错误的后验分布；作者提出CoCoS方法，通过考虑测度感知的约束采样，正确匹配了金标准后验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法广泛采用硬约束（投影/引导）来确保生成样本满足PDE物理规律，并声称结果可视为贝叶斯后验以实现不确定性量化。但作者怀疑这种常见做法存在根本性的数学错误——在测度零流形上施加条件会导致歧义性（Borel-Kolmogorov悖论），且物理正确的极限处理方式需要包含一个被忽视的co-area（Fixman）Jacobian因子。

Method: 作者首先从数学上精确刻画了硬约束条件采样导致的偏差，指出忽略的Jacobian因子为[det(JJ^T)]^{-1/2}，其偏差随约束敏感性的异质性增长。随后在受控问题上与i.i.d.金标准进行对比验证。最后提出CoCoS（Co-area Constrained Sampler），一种测度感知的约束采样方法，旨在修正被忽略的Jacobian因子，从而正确采样co-area后验分布。

Result: 实验表明：1) 忽略Jacobian因子会使后验误差放大到采样噪声本底的20倍；2) 最小位移投影（如PCFM）仍有9倍本底的偏差；3) 简单的标量重加权无法修复该偏差；4) CoCoS方法能够将后验误差降低到与采样噪声相当的水平，完美匹配金标准后验。

Conclusion: "满足物理约束"并不等同于"采样正确的后验分布"。作者为不确定性感知的科学推理提供了一种原则性的修正方法，揭示了当前广泛使用的硬约束条件生成模型在贝叶斯逆问题中的根本性缺陷，并给出了可操作的解决方案。

Abstract: Generative models -- diffusion and flow matching -- are increasingly used to solve partial differential equation (PDE) inverse problems, enforcing the governing physics as a \emph{hard constraint} (via projection or guidance) and reporting the resulting samples as a Bayesian posterior with calibrated uncertainty. We show that this widely adopted recipe samples the wrong distribution. Conditioning a generative prior on a hard PDE constraint is conditioning on a measure-zero manifold -- an operation that is intrinsically ambiguous (the Borel--Kolmogorov paradox) and whose physically correct resolution, the small-residual-noise limit, carries a co-area (Fixman) Jacobian factor $[det(JJ^{\top})]^{-1/2}$ that projection- and guidance-based methods silently omit. We make the bias precise, show that it grows with the heterogeneity of the constraint sensitivity, and validate it on controlled problems against an \emph{i.i.d.} ground-truth arbiter. The omitted factor is not a second-order detail: removing it inflates the posterior error to $20\times$ the sampling-noise floor; minimal-displacement projection (as in PCFM) is biased at $9\times$ the floor; and a naive scalar reweighting does not fix it. We introduce \textbf{CoCoS}, a measure-aware constrained sampler that targets the correct co-area posterior, and show that it matches the gold-standard posterior to within sampling noise. Our results imply that ``satisfying the physics'' is not the same as ``sampling the posterior,'' and give a principled correction for uncertainty-aware scientific inference.

</details>


<div id='cs.SI'></div>

# cs.SI [[Back]](#toc)

### [382] [Annotation of Positive vs Negative User Interactions for Social Sign Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06425)
*Biancamaria Bombino,Chiara Boldrini,Andrea Passarella,Marco Conti*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出利用大语言模型在零样本设置下，通过识别交互层面的人际关系信号（个人表扬和个人攻击）来推断社交关系的正负符号，解决了传统情感分析方法混淆内容情感与关系本质的问题。实验表明零样本LLM在攻击检测上稳健，而表扬检测更具主观性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖情感分析标记个体交互的正负性，但情感分析捕捉的是讨论内容的效价，而非关系交换本身的性质，这种混淆可能导致系统性误分类。

Method: 利用大语言模型在零样本设置下识别交互层面的人际关系信号（个人表扬和个人攻击），作为正负社交关系的更直接指标。使用Qwen2.5:7b、Gemma2:9b、GPT-4o、GPT-5.4-mini四种模型，三种提示设计复杂度，在两个人工标注数据集上评估。

Result: 零样本LLM在两项任务上均达到良好分类性能，无需任务特定训练数据。攻击检测对提示设计和模型选择鲁棒，表扬检测则对二者更敏感，反映正向关系姿态的更大主观性。

Conclusion: 研究为将基于LLM的关系标注整合到符号预测流程奠定了基础，建立了关系标注的实用基线。

Abstract: Inferring the sign of social relationships from online interactions is a fundamental challenge in social network analysis. Existing approaches typically rely on sentiment analysis to label individual interactions as positive or negative, then aggregate these labels to assign a sign to the relationship. However, sentiment analysis captures the valence of the content being discussed rather than the nature of the relational exchange itself, a conflation that can lead to systematic misclassification. In this paper, we propose a methodology that addresses this limitation by leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) in a zero-shot setting to identify interaction-level relational signals (specifically, personal praise and personal attacks directed at the interlocutor) as more direct indicators of positive and negative social ties. We evaluate four models spanning open-weight and proprietary architectures (Qwen2.5:7b, Gemma2:9b, GPT-4o, GPT-5.4-mini) across three prompt designs of increasing complexity, on two human-annotated datasets of approximately 298 and 340 texts respectively. Results show that zero-shot LLMs achieve good classification performance on both tasks without any task-specific training data, establishing a practical baseline for relational annotation. Performance differs across tasks: attack detection is robust to prompt design and model choice, while praise detection is more sensitive to both, reflecting the greater subjectivity of positive relational gestures. These findings lay the groundwork for integrating LLM-based relational annotation into sign prediction pipelines.

</details>


### [383] [Federating Governance: How Community Rules Scale with Mastodon Instances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05069)
*Rasika Muralidharan,Yong-Yeol Ahn,Bao Tran Truong*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本研究通过分析Mastodon实例的社区规则，发现去中心化社交媒体的治理随规模增长呈现与中心化平台相似的规律：社区规模强烈预测规则发展，大型实例拥有更广泛、主题更多样但可读性和语言多样性更低的规则；内部规模压力比外部联邦交互对治理的影响更为显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化社交媒体平台（如Mastodon、Bluesky）面临自治理和内容审核的规模化挑战，但社区规则和审核实践如何随规模增长而演变缺乏正式指导。本研究旨在揭示治理随规模扩展的规律。

Method: 分析不同规模Mastodon实例的社区规则，对规则进行分类以识别关键治理优先级，并考察规则的形式化程度、可读性、语言多样性及联邦交互的影响。

Result: 1) 各规模实例的治理优先级高度一致，均以处理骚扰、仇恨言论、非法内容等有害内容为核心；2) 小型社区关注范围较窄，大型服务器覆盖更平衡的主题范围；3) 社区规模是规则发展的强预测因子，大型实例规则更广泛、主题更多样，但可读性和语言多样性更低；4) 外部联邦交互影响有限，主要与规则范围扩大相关，对多样性和形式化影响不显著。

Conclusion: 内部规模压力比网络级动态（联邦交互）对去中心化社交媒体治理的影响更大；Mastodon的规模模式与Reddit等中心化平台相似，表明社区规模对自治理施加了超越平台架构的根本性约束。

Abstract: The rise of decentralized social media platforms like Mastodon and Bluesky highlights the challenge of scaling self-governance and moderation. As communities grow, they face new issues that demand increasingly complex governance structures. However, as moderation is mainly volunteer-driven, there is limited formal guidance on how community rules and moderation practices should evolve with growth. This study investigates how moderation scale with Mastodon instances by analyzing community rules across servers of varying sizes. We categorize these rules to identify key governance priorities and find that these priorities are remarkably consistent across instance sizes: rules addressing problematic content, such as harassment, hate speech, and illegal content, dominate regardless of scale. While smaller communities focus on narrower sets of topics, larger servers maintain a more balanced coverage of a broad range of topics. Our analysis of rule formalization reveals that community size strongly predicts rule development. As instances grow, their rules become more extensive and topically diverse, but also exhibit lower readability and linguistic diversity. In contrast, external federation interactions have a limited role, mainly associated with a broader scope of rules without substantially affecting their diversity or form. These findings highlight the relative influence of internal versus external factors, suggesting that local scaling pressures outweigh network-level dynamics in decentralized social media governance. The scaling pattern observed on Mastodon resemble those previously identified on centralized platforms such as Reddit, suggesting that community size imposes fundamental constraints on self-governance that transcend platform architectures

</details>


<div id='cs.CY'></div>

# cs.CY [[Back]](#toc)

### [384] [Drishti AI-Event Guardian: An Intelligent Real-Time Crowd Monitoring and Emergency Response System for Mass Gathering Events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05185)
*Ritabrata Roy Choudhury,Arkajyoti Karmakar,Rudra Pratap Mitra*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出Drishti AI-Event Guardian框架，融合YOLOv8密度估计、时空异常检测、梯度提升回归预测、人脸识别、医疗应急报告、AI聊天机器人与智能警卫调度四大模块，在Kumbh Mela与RCB Victory Parade两个场景中验证，密度估计MAE为3.2人/m²，异常检测F1为0.91，人脸识别精度0.93，预警中位延迟111ms，预测MAPE为8.3%，实现了从被动监控到主动人群智能的范式转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统人群监控系统缺乏智能分析能力，导致威胁识别延迟、资源部署不当、对弱势群体支持不足，亟需一种能够实时、主动进行人群管理与应急响应的智能框架。

Method: 基于深度学习与Google Vertex AI基础设施，融合CCTV与无人机多模态数据；核心方法包括YOLOv8实时密度估计、时空异常检测、梯度提升回归进行人群流动预测；集成四大模块：人脸识别寻人、医疗应急自动调度、对话式AI聊天机器人、基于密度变化的智能警卫动态重分配引擎。

Result: Kumbh Mela与RCB Victory Parade场景中，密度估计MAE 3.2人/m²，异常检测F1 0.91，人脸识别精度0.93，中位预警延迟111ms；5分钟预测MAPE 8.3%；聊天机器人解决89%事件申报；警卫调度降低34%部署延迟。

Conclusion: 该系统实现了从被动监控到主动人群智能的转变，为从小型聚会到大型节日提供了可扩展的基础设施，显著提升了公共安全应急响应效率。

Abstract: Mass gathering events are associated with critical safety incidents caused by insufficient crowd monitoring and inadequate emergency response coordination. Traditional surveillance systems lack intelligent analytics, resulting in delayed threat identification, poor resource deployment, and weak support for vulnerable individuals during dense public assemblies. This paper presents Drishti AI-Event Guardian, an intelligent crowd management framework using deep learning for public safety enhancement. The architecture combines multimodal data from CCTV networks and UAV platforms, processed by models on Google Vertex AI infrastructure. Core methods include real-time crowd density estimation using YOLOv8, spatiotemporal anomaly detection, and predictive crowd-flow modeling through gradient-boosted regression.
