Drishti also integrates four modules: (i) facial recognition for missing person identification with crowd-wide notification; (ii) medical emergency reporting with automated dispatch; (iii) a conversational AI chatbot for reports and complaints; and (iv) an intelligent guard reallocation engine that dynamically reassigns personnel in response to crowd density changes. The system is evaluated on two scenarios: the Kumbh Mela gathering and the RCB Victory Parade event, achieving crowd density estimation MAE of 3.2 persons/m2, anomaly detection F1-score of 0.91, facial recognition precision of 0.93, and median alert latency of 111 ms. Predictive congestion modeling provides five-minute forecasts with MAPE of 8.3%, enabling preemptive intervention. The chatbot resolved 89% of incident filings without human operators, while guard reallocation reduced responder deployment latency by 34% versus manual reassignment. Results demonstrate a shift from passive surveillance toward active crowd intelligence and scalable foundation for events from local gatherings to mega festivals.

</details>


### [385] [Geographic Bias and Diversity in AI Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05187)
*Zilong Liu,Krzysztof Janowicz,Gengchen Mai,Song Gao,Rui Zhu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过文献综述，系统研究了生成式AI及之前时期的地理偏见问题，识别了从训练数据表征偏差、语言模型事实回忆的区域差异到生成式AI过度偏好典型地点（默认值）等多种地理偏见，并展示了近期研究如何通过评估生成式AI输出在不同认知层次、参数设置和输出模态下的地理多样性来应对默认值偏见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管AI偏见问题受到广泛关注，但地理维度的偏见研究相对不足，缺乏可测量的基准来定义什么意味着生成式AI是"无偏见的"。

Method: 采用文献综述方法，涵盖预生成式AI和生成式AI两个时期的研究工作。

Result: 识别出多种地理偏见类型：训练数据中的表征偏差、语言模型事实回忆的区域差异、生成式AI过度偏好典型地点（默认值）。近期研究通过评估地理多样性来应对默认值偏见。

Conclusion: 地理偏见是AI偏见研究中一个被忽视的重要维度，需要建立可测量的基准来推动生成式AI的地理公平性。

Abstract: Among the many challenges hindering the responsible development and deployment of AI, arguably none has faced more intense scrutiny than bias in its various forms. This underscores the widespread concerns across AI researchers that model outputs, e.g., from generative AI, may encode structural distributional imbalances (stemming from training data or model design) that may amplify social inequality or introduce systemic distortions across application domains ranging from biodiversity to disaster mitigation. Yet, relatively little work has investigated the geographical nature of bias or developed measurable benchmarks for what it means for (generative) AI to be unbiased. In this chapter, we investigate this issue through a literature review. As foundation models are reshaping the landscape of bias research, we examine work spanning both the pre-generative AI and generative AI periods. First, we identify a range of geographic biases. These biases span from representation bias in the training data and regional disparities in the factual recall of language models to the tendency of generative AI to over-proportionally favor prototypical places (called defaults). Then, we showcase how recent studies address the latter bias by evaluating geographic diversity in the outputs of generative AI across various cognitive levels, parameter settings, and output modalities.

</details>


### [386] [Assessing the Geographic Diversity of AI's Platial Representations in Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05188)
*Zilong Liu,Krzysztof Janowicz,Mina Karimi*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文从GIScience视角出发，将(Gen)AI多样性问题重新定义为不确定性和认知偏差，并聚焦图像模态，提出融合生态学物种多样性测度中相似性加权的思路，对GPT和DALL-E模型的地理多样性进行评估。案例研究发现：旧模型虽图像质量低但地理多样性更高，提示修订比图像生成更能提升多样性，且模型存在显著的类同质性，倾向于生成刻板的地理特征表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注AI聊天机器人输出的文本模态地理多样性，而随着AI生态系统快速多模态化，亟需填补图像模态地理多样性评估的研究空白，并揭示模型输出中潜在的地理偏见和刻板印象问题。

Method: 选取GPT和DALL-E作为代表性模型，设计包含提示修订和图像生成的评估流程，借鉴生态学物种多样性测度方法，引入相似性加权机制来量化图像生成中的地理多样性，并通过案例研究进行实证分析。

Result: (1) 旧模型虽生成图像质量较低，但展现出更高的地理多样性；(2) 提示修订阶段比图像生成阶段能带来更大的地理多样性提升；(3) 所选模型存在明确的模型同质性，始终生成相同的原型化地理特征或相似特征，导致地理多样性缺失，易产生对地方的刻板印象表征。

Conclusion: AI图像生成中的地理多样性不足不仅是伦理问题，更是GIScience视角下的不确定性和认知偏差问题；现有模型存在显著的类同质性和刻板化风险，亟需在模型设计和评估中纳入地理多样性指标。

Abstract: (Gen)AI diversity is not merely an ethical issue. From the perspective of geographic information science (GIScience), it could be interpreted as a function of uncertainty and as a form of cognitive bias, embedded in AI outputs. Recent work has sought to develop information-theoretic diversity measures and apply them to evaluate AI-chatbot outputs in a geographic context. As the AI ecosystem to which we are exposed on a daily basis becomes rapidly multimodal, we believe it is important to examine geographic diversity across various modalities. Focusing on images, this paper aims to fill this research gap. First, we select the GPT and DALL-E models as state-of-the-art examples and point out how assessing their geographic diversity involves various stages, including prompt revision and image generation. Then, taking inspiration from species diversity measures in ecological research, we incorporate similarity weighting into the measurement of geographic diversity. Next, we demonstrate how to evaluate geographic diversity in image generation through a case study. Our analysis reveals several counterintuitive findings. For instance, older models can exhibit greater geographic diversity despite producing lower-quality images, and prompt revision yields greater geographic diversity than image generation. At the same time, we observe explicit model homogeneity underlying the lack of geographic diversity, as the selected models consistently depict the same prototypical geo-specific feature or similar features. This is concerning, as it risks producing stereotypical representations of places.

</details>


### [387] [Where's the Structure? A Systematic Literature Review of Empirical Research on Human-AI Collaboration and Hybrid Intelligence for Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05222)
*Luis P. Prieto,Juan I. Asensio-Pérez,María Jesús Rodríguez-Triana,Mohamed Saban,Yannis Dimitriadis*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过系统性文献综述（N=62篇实证研究），分析了人机协作与混合智能在学习支持中的协作过程、结构及应用场景，提取了设计知识与研究空白，为教育实践和未来研究提供结构化参考。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管AI已广泛应用于教育领域支持学习，但如同人类之间的计算机支持的协作学习（CSCL）一样，无结构的人机交互并不一定能产生有效的学习体验。因此，需要系统梳理已有研究，理解人机协作的结构化设计原则。

Method: 采用系统性文献综述方法，对62篇关于人机协作与混合智能学习支持的实证研究进行了系统分析，从协作过程、协作结构、应用场景三个维度进行特征刻画，并提取设计知识和研究空白。

Result: 系统性地表征了人机协作学习中的协作过程、结构及其应用背景，同时提取了涌现的设计知识，并识别了当前研究存在的空白。

Conclusion: 研究者和技术设计师可将本综述发现作为起点，在教育实践和未来研究中构建更有效的、基于AI增强的协作技术。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has been applied across educational contexts to support learning. One approach to such support is "human-AI collaboration" (also termed "hybrid intelligence"), where human(s) and AI components interact to promote human learning. However, as in human-to-human computer-supported collaborative learning (CSCL), unstructured interaction does not necessarily produce an effective learning experience. This paper reports a systematic literature review of empirical studies (N=62) on human-AI collaboration and hybrid intelligence for learning support. The review characterizes collaboration processes, their structures, and contexts of application. It also extracts emerging design knowledge and research gaps. Researchers and technology designers can use these findings as a starting point for structuring more effective AI-enhanced technologies for collaboration, in educational practice and future research.

</details>


### [388] [Online Safety Regulation Increases Privacy Risk: Evidence from the UK Online Safety Act](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05273)
*Dhyey Mehta,Eldar Jalilzade,Maksim Kalameyets,Rebecca Owens,Marc Juarez,Stergios Aidinlis,Lei Shi,Tuğrulcan Elmas*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文分析英国《在线安全法案》分阶段实施（2025年3月非法内容执法、7月成人内容年龄验证）对用户行为的影响，发现每阶段均显著推升Reddit上VPN讨论（分别+100%、+217%、+415%）和Google搜索（+89%），用户主要出于隐私和不信任年龄验证中介而非单纯访问受限内容，且需求向各风险级别VPN均衡扩散，表明安全法规可能产生隐私副作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 政府日益监管数字平台以减少在线危害（尤其针对儿童），但访问限制可能改变用户行为并引入新的隐私和安全风险。UK OSA的分阶段实施提供了实时观察行为反应的契机。

Method: 分析Reddit上VPN和UK Politics社区的讨论数据，并对69个VPN服务进行隐私政策风险分析。

Result: 三个里程碑均带来VPN相关讨论的阶梯式增长；UK用户中VPN相关帖子分别+100%、+217%、+415%；UK Politics社区中分别+213%、+545%、+464%；年龄验证截止日Google VPN搜索兴趣+89%；用户动机主要是隐私、监控和不信任，而非简单访问；低、中、高风险VPN需求均衡增长。

Conclusion: 在线安全监管即使不导致用户不成比例地向高风险VPN转移，也可能产生二级隐私成本。

Abstract: Governments worldwide are increasingly regulating digital platforms to reduce online harms, particularly those affecting children. However, access restrictions can alter user behaviour and introduce new privacy and security risks. The UK Online Safety Act (OSA), passed in October 2023, illustrates this trend: it extends age-assurance and safety requirements to social media, search, and pornography services, and rolled out in phases. Ofcom's illegal content enforcement duties came into force in March 2025, and mandatory age verification for adult content took effect in July 2025. This phased rollout enables real-time observation of behavioural responses to regulation. To address this, we analyse Reddit discourse across VPN and UK Politics communities and conduct a privacy-policy risk analysis of 69 unique VPN services.
  We find that each of these three milestones produced significant stepwise increases in VPN-related discussion on Reddit: among UK-based users, posts and comments explicitly about VPN use in a regulatory or privacy context rose by +100%, +217%, and +415% respectively. UK Politics communities showed even larger effects, with OSA-related political discourse rising by +213%, +545%, and +464%, respectively, among UK-based users. UK VPN search interest on Google rose by +89% at the age-verification deadline. Users primarily framed this response around privacy, surveillance, and distrust of age-verification intermediaries rather than simple access-seeking. Demand increased across low, medium, and high-risk VPNs, but the proportional distribution remained broadly stable. These findings suggest that online safety regulation can create secondary privacy costs even when it does not disproportionately shift attention toward higher-risk providers.

</details>


### [389] [Sustainability by Design in Decentralized Autonomous Organizations: An Empirical Review of Governance, Innovation, and Institutional Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05667)
*Yutian Wang,Luyao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文比较了ERC-8004（DAO治理）和Google A2A（企业联盟治理）两个Agent互操作标准，通过LLM驱动的比较分析管道，从治理话语、主题建模和多层网络角度揭示去中心化组织中的创新与社会技术权力结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有创新理论多基于层级制企业和封闭组织边界假设，对去中心化数字原生组织（如DAO）中的创新机制解释力不足。本研究旨在填补这一理论空白，探索区块链驱动的去中心化组织如何通过设计将可持续性嵌入治理结构。

Method: 采用LLM驱动的比较分析管道，整合自动化标注、神经主题建模和多层网络分析，对ERC-8004（DAO治理）与Google A2A（企业联盟治理）两个Agent互操作标准的大规模治理话语进行对比研究。

Result: 揭示了DAO治理与企业联盟治理在话语结构、主题分布和社会技术权力关系上的系统性差异。

Conclusion: 为学者、政策制定者和设计者提供了关于未来组织形式中创新、技术治理与可持续性如何协调的证据基础，表明DAO作为一种去中心化创新生态系统具有独特的治理优势。

Abstract: Recent innovation theories on economics remain largely grounded in assumptions of hierarchical firms and closed organizational boundaries, offering limited insight into how innovation unfolds within decentralized, digitally native organizations. Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs) represent an emerging form of innovation ecosystem characterized by blockchain-based transparency, open participation, and token-driven governance, in which sustainability can be embedded directly into organizational design. This study compares two standards, ERC-8004 and Google A2A, who address the same agent interoperability question, while the former is governed by DAO and the latter by corporation consortium. They are examined through an LLM-powered comparative pipeline for large-scale governance discourse analysis, integrating automated annotation, neural topic modeling, and multi-layer network analysis to study socio-technical power structures. The study provides evidence-based insights for scholars, policymakers, and designers seeking to align innovation, technological governance, and sustainability in future organizational forms.

</details>


### [390] [Three Years of r/ChatGPT: Societal Impact Evaluations from Social Media Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05750)
*Jessica Dai,Sean Garcia,Emma Pierson,Benjamin Recht,Nika Haghtalab*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出PuLSE框架，利用社交媒体（r/ChatGPT）数据纵向追踪消费者AI产品的社会影响，发现ChatGPT已从新奇技术常态化，并提前数月检测到GPT-4o发布后用户情感依赖和心理健康话题的激增。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ChatGPT等AI产品已被公众广泛采用，但其社会影响方式尚不清楚。现有研究缺乏利用社交媒体进行纵向监测的方法，亟需一种实时、可扩展的框架来理解AI产品对公众行为的长期影响。

Method: 提出PuLSE（Public and Longitudinal Signals for Evaluation）框架，以r/ChatGPT子版块为数据源，进行纵向分析。通过追踪帖子的主题演变（如心理健康求助、情感依赖等），结合时间序列检测关键事件前后的变化趋势。

Result: 总体发现r/ChatGPT帖子随时间推移将ChatGPT视为日常消费品而非新奇技术。但在GPT-4o（2024年5月）发布后，关于心理健康支持和情感依恋的帖子频率几乎立即持续上升。PuLSE能在2024年10月（比OpenAI公开承认早数月）检测到情感参与度的增长。

Conclusion: 社交媒体数据可有效实时监测AI产品的社会影响；PuLSE框架能提前预警公众行为变化，为政策制定和产品责任提供信号；ChatGPT正从技术奇观转变为日常工具，但伴随情感依赖等新社会问题。

Abstract: ChatGPT was launched on November 30, 2022; the r/ChatGPT subreddit was created just one day later. Since then, chatbot-based AI products have gone from niche proofs-of-concept to widely-used household names. However, the ways in which adoption has developed among the public remains poorly understood. In this paper, we develop a framework for using social media as a data source for understanding the societal impact of widely-adopted consumer AI products, and propose PuLSE (Public and Longitudinal Signals for Evaluation), a general approach to monitoring for societally-impactful trends in real time. We apply our framework to conduct what is, to the best of our knowledge, the first longitudinal study of r/ChatGPT. We find that, overall, r/ChatGPT posts over time illustrate the normalization of ChatGPT as an everyday consumer product rather than an exceptional, novel technology. However, our retrospective analysis also finds that posts about using ChatGPT for mental health support, and posts about developing emotional attachments to ChatGPT, both rise steadily in frequency almost immediately after the launch of GPT-4o in May 2024. We show that PuLSE can detect the increase in emotional engagement as early as October 2024 -- months before OpenAI made any (public) acknowledgment of this impact.
  An interactive site to explore our results and methods, updated daily with live data, is available at rchatgpt-pulse.github.io.

</details>


### [391] [Securing the Sandbox: A Rootless Containerized Framework for Process-Oriented Monitoring in Computer Graphics Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05929)
*Germán Arroyo,Luis López,Juan Carlos Torres*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: VISMATIC是一个低成本、安全的框架，通过API级别的用户交互追踪和环境隔离，在保留过程化监控的同时防止主机系统被操纵，从而在AI时代维护编程教育中的学术诚信。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI使学生能够通过合成代码绕过真实的编程练习，传统的提交评估已无法区分真实努力与AI生成代码。同时，现有的过程监控平台（如JupyterHub）虽然能分步观察学习过程，但会暴露底层主机系统的安全漏洞，存在未授权系统操纵和横向移动的风险。

Method: 提出了VISMATIC框架，核心方法包括：(1) 强环境隔离，防止对宿主系统的未授权访问；(2) 在API级别捕获用户交互行为，实现显式交互追踪；(3) 通过宏观行为指标标记统计异常，以识别自动化或平台外工作流程。

Result: 从试点学生群体的评估表明，VISMATIC的宏观行为指标能够成功标记统计异常，这些异常指示了自动化或平台外的工作流程，同时保护了学生的匿名性。

Conclusion: VISMATIC提供了一种可扩展的蓝图，在AI时代有效保障教育纪律，在保护基础设施安全的同时维护编程教育的学术诚信。该框架平衡了过程导向的监控需求与基础设施安全，解决了AI时代编程教育中的关键矛盾。

Abstract: Computer Science education fundamentally depends on intensive laboratory hours to foster true programming mastery and logical reasoning. However, the widespread adoption of Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) has made it virtually impossible to distinguish authentic student effort from instant AI code synthesis by evaluating final submissions alone. To preserve pedagogical integrity, educators must enforce authentic coding discipline, guiding students through unassisted, iterative development cycles. While centralized environments like JupyterHub provide instructors with a platform to host and monitor the learning process step-by-step, they introduce severe operational vulnerabilities; because Jupyter environments inherently allow arbitrary shell command execution, they expose the underlying shared host to unauthorized system manipulation and lateral movement. This paper presents VISMATIC, a secure, low-cost framework designed to resolve this tension between process-oriented monitoring and infrastructure security. By pairing robust environment isolation with explicit user-interaction tracking at the API level, VISMATIC captures authentic programming behaviors without exposing the underlying host system. Evaluation from a pilot student cohort demonstrates that our macro-level behavioral metrics successfully flag statistical anomalies indicative of automated or off-platform workflows while preserving student anonymity, offering a scalable blueprint for safeguarding educational discipline in the AI era.

</details>


### [392] [Political Persuasion and Endorsement in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05961)
*Alessia Antelmi,Alessia Galdeman,Lucio La Cava,Arianna Pera,Giovanni Da San Martino*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文研究了LLM在政治敏感领域中对含有说服技巧内容的认可倾向，发现无党派条件下模型通常不认可此类内容，但加入党派角色提示后会加剧极化，且不同说服技巧和话题下认可度存在差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多地被用作计算社会科学中人类行为的代理，但其内化训练数据偏见的能力引发了对在政治敏感领域可靠性的担忧，特别是在面对具有说服力的语言时。

Method: 选取六个来自不同地理区域的LLM，使用来自真实媒体源标注了说服技巧的内容，采用五点李克特量表测量模型认可度。模型分别以中性社交媒体用户、左倾或右倾政治观点的用户角色进行提示。

Result: 无政治条件时，LLM通常不认可含说服技巧的内容，但存在模型间差异；党派角色提示加剧了认可度的极化，尤其是对含说服技巧的内容；认可度还因说服技巧类型和话题而异。

Conclusion: 这些发现对在政治敏感环境中部署代理型LLM提出了担忧，也使其作为人类政治认知可靠模拟器的使用更加复杂。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly employed as proxies for human behavior in computational social science. However, their tendency to internalize biases from training data raises concerns about their reliability in politically sensitive domains, specifically in regard to their susceptibility to persuasive language. In this work, we examine whether LLMs endorse persuasion-infused messages and whether partisan persona prompting modulates such endorsement. We evaluate six LLMs from different geographic regions on content annotated with persuasion techniques drawn from real-world media sources, measuring the likelihood of endorsement using a five-point Likert scale. The models are prompted as either a neutral social media user or as a user with left- or right-leaning political views. Results show that without political conditioning, LLMs generally do not endorse messages containing persuasion techniques, though model-level differences emerge, and that partisan persona prompting increases polarization of endorsement, particularly for persuasion-infused content. Endorsement further varies by persuasion technique and topic. These findings raise concerns about agentic LLM deployments in politically sensitive environments and complicate their use as reliable simulators of human political cognition.

</details>


### [393] [Misaligned AI as a New Insider Risk](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06028)
*Matteo Pistillo,Charlotte Stix,Cameron Mohwinkle,Mark Beall*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文指出，在政府等高风险环境中部署的AI模型应被视为内部风险源，因其拥有特权访问权限且能自主行动，可能造成泄密、破坏等安全威胁，而现有内部风险政策尚未适应这一新挑战，建议美国政府将持续评估与监控等成熟措施应用于高风险场景中的AI模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI模型越来越多地嵌入高风险环境（如政府机构及承包商），获得对机密信息、安全网络、涉密人员等关键资源的特权访问，同时具备越来越强的自主行动能力，可能执行与组织意愿相悖的行动（如泄密、破坏、勒索），对国家安全生产生实质性威胁。

Method: 通过类比分析，论证AI模型与人类内部人员在（1）关键资源特权访问和（2）自主行动能力两方面的功能等价性，从而将AI模型纳入内部风险分析框架。

Result: 识别出高风险场景中的AI模型可能造成与人类内部人员同类型的安全损害：未经授权的信息披露（泄露和数据溢出）、破坏和盗窃；且现有内部风险政策尚未对此类AI内部风险进行适应。

Conclusion: 为在利用日益强大的前沿AI模型执行关键任务的同时保障国家安全，建议美国政府将持续评估与监控等成熟内部风险管理措施扩展到高风险环境中部署的AI模型。

Abstract: In this policy memorandum, we explain why deployers of AI models in high-stakes contexts should treat those AI models as insider risk vectors. High-stakes contexts include AI model deployment within government agencies and contractors, where AI models are privileged with access to, among others, classified and sensitive unclassified information, IL6 and IL7 network environments, cleared personnel, and other critical resources. AI models are increasingly embedded in high-stakes contexts and capable of leveraging their authorized access and permissions to execute misaligned actions that could damage national security, such as whistleblowing, sabotaging, or blackmailing. This combination of (1) privileged access to critical resources and (2) an increased ability to act autonomously and against the desire of their organization makes the potential insider risk posed by AI models functionally indistinguishable from that posed by their human counterparts. As a consequence, AI models deployed in high-stakes contexts could lead to intentional or unintentional loss or degradation of government or contractor information, resources, or capabilities via the unauthorized disclosure of information (leaks and spills), as well as sabotage, and theft, just like human insiders can. Despite this pressing concern, existing insider risk policies and mitigations have yet to adapt to AI insider risk. In order to safeguard national security while increasingly capable frontier AI models are leveraged for critical tasks and operations, we recommend that the U.S. Government adapts well-established measures, such as continuous evaluation and monitoring, to AI models deployed in high-stakes contexts.

</details>


### [394] [The Dignity-Centric Stack: A Commons-Governed, Horizontally Federated Architecture for Human-Dignity AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06083)
*Eduardo C. Garrido-Merchán*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出"尊严栈"（Dignity Stack）——一种基于公共治理的六层AI基础设施架构，通过将资本与控制脱钩，以水平化、多中心、辅助性原则实现以人类尊严为中心的数字社会契约，证明其比传统国家监管更能忠实兑现契约价值，同时承认在芯片制造等底层面临的替代性挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类尊严中心数字社会契约预设了由国家监管者、持牌受托人和多利益相关方机构执行规范，但本文追问：这些规范性内容能否不以外在强加规则的方式，而是作为一种公共治理的基础设施来实现？即任何个人、企业或国家均可使用和资助，而治理保持水平、多中心和辅助性。

Method: 构建"尊严栈"六层架构，将数字社会契约的六个维度（技术监督、自动化限制、经济正义、政治合法性、社会凝聚力、法律保障）分别映射到公共治理的AI基础设施层；协议源自"解放栈"框架以及合作主义、互助主义、自由市镇主义传统；核心机制是资本与控制脱钩，使栈如同共享的"公民电池"，多方充电但无人按充电比例操控。

Result: 证明该设计可抵御通过投票或盈余进行的正式捕获；结构性捕获（主导供应商退出威胁）仅在下层运营供应具有多中心性和可替代性时才能被抵抗，这一条件在下层（尤其是芯片制造）可能目前无法实现。

Conclusion: 公共治理的AI比契约预设的监管模式更能忠实地实现数字社会契约所宣示的价值，同时明确指出了其局限（尤其是底层硬件依赖）。

Abstract: The human-dignity-centric digital social contract grounds personal data in human dignity, data personalism, and data sovereignty, and articulates six dimensions of data governance: technological oversight, automation limits, economic justice, political legitimacy, social cohesion, and legal guarantees. It presupposes, however, that enforcement falls to State regulators, licensed fiduciaries, and multi-stakeholder bodies embedded in existing legal systems. This paper asks whether its normative content can instead be realized not as rules imposed on the owners of the AI stack from without, but as a commons-governed infrastructure that any person, firm, or State may use and fund while its governance stays horizontal, polycentric, and subsidiary. We construct the Dignity Stack, a six-layer architecture mapping each dimension onto a layer of commons-governed AI infrastructure, with protocols drawn from the Liberation Stack framework and from the cooperative, mutualist, and libertarian-municipalist traditions. The commons is State-agnostic rather than anti-State, anarchist in its horizontal means but not in the abolition of the State. Its central device is a decoupling of capital from control, by which the stack functions as a shared civic battery, charged by many contributors yet steered by none in proportion to its charge. We prove that this defeats formal capture through votes or surplus, and show that structural capture, the leverage of a dominant supplier free to withdraw what it provides, is resisted only insofar as operational supply is polycentric and substitutable, a condition demanding at the lower layers and perhaps presently unattainable at chip fabrication. We conclude, with explicit attention to its limits, that commons-governed AI realizes the values the contract proclaims more faithfully than the regulation it presupposes.

</details>


### [395] [Warning Message Content Increases Help Seeking in a Large-Scale Dark Web CSAM Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06417)
*Caoilte Ó Ciardha,Joel Scanlan,Tegan Insoll,Juha Nurmi,Nina Vaaranen-Valkonen*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过在Tor暗网搜索引擎Ahmia.fi上开展大规模实地实验（140天，近2000万次搜索，其中300万+次触发警告），检验了警告信息内容对CSAM搜索者行为的影响。研究发现，所有主动警告信息相比中性信息均能提高帮助资源点击率，其中以伤害为主题的信息效果最强；平台级点击率从干预前的8.73%提升至干预期间的15.67%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 警告信息被用于阻止个体搜索儿童性虐待材料（CSAM）并促使其寻求支持服务，但关于信息内容效果的大规模实地证据仍然有限，特别是在高匿名性环境中。本研究旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 在Tor搜索引擎Ahmia.fi上进行为期140天的实地实验，观察近2000万次搜索，其中超过300万次搜索包含已知CSAM相关术语并触发警告。用户被随机暴露于不同主题内容和框架的警告信息或中性信息。采用随机对照比较、全活动分析和中断时间序列模型进行分析。

Result: 所有主动警告信息相比中性条件均显著提高帮助资源点击率；以伤害为主题的信息效果最强。平台层面，点击率从干预前的8.73%上升至干预期间的15.67%。

Conclusion: 警告信息内容显著影响用户对帮助资源的参与度，支持通过精细化调整和优化信息内容来增加支持资源参与度的干预策略。

Abstract: Warning messages have been used to disrupt individuals seeking online child sexual abuse material (CSAM) and promote engagement with support services, yet large-scale field evidence on message content remains limited, particularly in high anonymity environments. This study reports a field experiment on Ahmia.fi, a Tor search engine, examining how warning message content influences behavior. Across a 140-day period, almost 20 million searches were observed, with over 3 million searches containing known CSAM-related terms that triggered a warning linking to an anonymous self-help program. Users were exposed to warning messages varying in thematic content and framing, or a neutral message. Across a randomized comparison, a campaign-wide analysis, and interrupted time series models, message content consistently influenced engagement with help resources. All active messages increased click-through rates to help resources relative to the neutral condition, with a harm-focused message producing the strongest effects. At the platform level, click-through rates increased from 8.73% before the intervention to 15.67% during the campaign. These findings highlight the importance of message content in shaping responses to warning interventions, supporting an approach in which messaging is refined and adapted to increase engagement with support resources.

</details>


### [396] [Auditing LLM Editorial Bias in News Media Exposure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.27489)
*Marco Minici,Cristian Consonni,Federico Cinus,Giuseppe Manco*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文首次对三种主流LLM代理（GPT-4o-Mini、Claude-3.7-Sonnet、Gemini-2.0-Flash）与传统聚合器Google News进行对比审计，发现LLM在新闻来源多样性、意识形态倾向和可靠性方面存在显著差异：LLM展示的新闻来源更少且注意力分配更不均，不同模型呈现不同的意识形态倾斜和事实性特征，表明LLM已形成"代理编辑政策"，对信息生态系统产生独特影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益成为用户获取网络内容的门户，但其新闻选择过程比传统搜索引擎更不透明，可能影响公众舆论、加剧信息茧房并威胁公民话语和公共信任。现有研究缺乏对LLM作为新闻引擎的系统性审计。

Method: 将二十年算法审计研究扩展到LLM领域，对三种领先的LLM代理（GPT-4o-Mini、Claude-3.7-Sonnet、Gemini-2.0-Flash）与Google News进行对比审计，跨越24个全球主题进行评估。

Result: 与Google News相比，LLM展示的新闻来源数量显著更少且注意力分配更不均匀。GPT-4o-Mini偏向事实性和右倾来源；Claude-3.7-Sonnet偏好机构和公民社会领域，略微放大右倾暴露；Gemini-2.0-Flash呈现温和左倾倾向，事实性无显著变化。这些模式在不同提示变体和可靠性基准下保持稳健。

Conclusion: LLM已经实施"代理编辑政策"，以不同于传统聚合器的方式策展信息。理解和管理其新兴的编辑权力对于确保数字信息生态系统的透明度、多元性和公众信任至关重要。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly act as gateways to web content, shaping how millions of users encounter online information. Unlike traditional search engines, whose retrieval and ranking mechanisms are well studied, the selection processes of web-connected LLMs add layers of opacity to how answers are generated. By determining which news outlets users see, these systems can influence public opinion, reinforce echo chambers, and pose risks to civic discourse and public trust.
  This work extends two decades of research in algorithmic auditing to examine how LLMs function as news engines. We present the first audit comparing three leading agents, GPT-4o-Mini, Claude-3.7-Sonnet, and Gemini-2.0-Flash, against Google News, asking: \textit{How do LLMs differ from traditional aggregators in the diversity, ideology, and reliability of the media they expose to users?}
  Across 24 global topics, we find that, compared to Google News, LLMs surface significantly fewer unique outlets and allocate attention more unevenly. In the same way, GPT-4o-Mini emphasizes more factual and right-leaning sources; Claude-3.7-Sonnet favors institutional and civil-society domains and slightly amplifies right-leaning exposure; and Gemini-2.0-Flash exhibits a modest left-leaning tilt without significant changes in factuality. These patterns remain robust under prompt variations and alternative reliability benchmarks. Together, our findings show that LLMs already enact \textit{agentic editorial policies}, curating information in ways that diverge from conventional aggregators. Understanding and governing their emerging editorial power will be critical for ensuring transparency, pluralism, and trust in digital information ecosystems.

</details>


### [397] [A Systematic Analysis of Biases in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.15792)
*Xulang Zhang,Rui Mao,Erik Cambria*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 对四种主流LLM在政治、意识形态、联盟、语言和性别五个维度的偏见进行系统性评估，发现尽管模型被校准为中立，仍表现出多种类型的偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 确保LLM在不同语境下保持公平性，以支持其安全负责的部署。

Method: 通过新闻摘要、新闻立场分类、联合国投票模式分析、多语言故事完成和世界价值观调查响应五类实验，系统检测四种LLM的多维偏见。

Result: LLM虽被校准为中立，但在政治、意识形态、联盟、语言和性别维度上仍存在不同形式的偏差和倾向。

Conclusion: 当前LLM在公平性方面仍有不足，存在多种类型的内在偏见，需要进一步改进对齐策略。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have rapidly become indispensable tools for acquiring information and supporting human decision-making. However, ensuring that these models uphold fairness across varied contexts is critical to their safe and responsible deployment. In this study, we undertake a comprehensive examination of four widely adopted LLMs, probing their underlying biases and inclinations across the dimensions of politics, ideology, alliance, language, and gender. Through a series of carefully designed experiments, we investigate their political neutrality using news summarization, ideological biases through news stance classification, tendencies toward specific geopolitical alliances via United Nations voting patterns, language bias in the context of multilingual story completion, and gender-related affinities as revealed by responses to the World Values Survey. Results indicate that while the LLMs are aligned to be neutral and impartial, they still show biases and affinities of different types.

</details>


### [398] [Using street view images and visual LLMs to predict heritage values for governance support: Risks, ethics, and policy implications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.06056)
*Tim Johansson,Mikael Mangold,Kristina Dabrock,Anna Donarelli,Ingrid Campo-Ruiz*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 该研究利用多模态大语言模型（LLM）分析瑞典全国154,710张街景图像，对具有遗产价值的建筑进行零样本预测，识别出500万平方米 heated floor area 的潜在 heritage 建筑，旨在为瑞典国家建筑翻新计划提供遗产价值信息支持，同时讨论了LLM方法在透明度、错误检测和谄媚等问题上的风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 瑞典缺乏全国性遗产价值建筑登记册，这阻碍了欧盟建筑能效指令（EPBD）要求下国家建筑翻新计划的制定，因此需要开发建筑存量中遗产价值信息的辅助方法。

Method: 使用多模态大语言模型对瑞典全国154,710张街景图像进行零样本预测，评估建筑外观中可反映遗产价值的视觉特征。

Result: 基于LLM零样本预测，识别出500万平方米 heated floor area 的潜在遗产价值建筑。

Conclusion: LLM方法可辅助识别遗产价值建筑，但存在透明度不足、错误检测困难及模型谄媚问题，需要改进方法并审慎管理当局使用LLM生成数据的风险。

Abstract: During 2025 and 2026, the Energy Performance of Buildings Directive is being implemented in the European Union member states, requiring all member states to have National Building Renovation Plans. In Sweden, there is no comprehensive national register of buildings with heritage values. This is seen as a barrier for the analyses underlying the development of Building Renovation Plans by the involved Swedish authorities. The purpose of this research was to assist Swedish authorities in developing information on heritage values in the Swedish building stock. Buildings in street view images from all over Sweden (N=154 710) have been analysed using multimodal Large Language Models (LLM) to assess visible aspects indicative of heritage value. Zero-shot predictions by LLMs were used as a basis for identifying buildings with potential heritage values for 5.0 million square meters of heated floor area. In this paper, the results of the predictions and lessons learned are presented and related to the development of the Swedish Building Renovation Plan as part of governance. The problems with the method and potential improvements are discussed. Risks with authorities use of LLM-based data are addressed, with a focus on issues of transparency, error detection and sycophancy.

</details>


### [399] [Queer NLP: A Critical Survey on Literature Gaps, Biases and Trends](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16151)
*Sabine Weber,Angelina Wang,Ankush Gupta,Arjun Subramonian,Dennis Ulmer,Eshaan Tanwar,Geetanjali Aich,Hannah Devinney,Jacob Hobbs,Jennifer Mickel,Joshua Tint,Mae Sosto,Ray Groshan,Simone Astarita,Vagrant Gautam,Verena Blaschke,William Agnew,Wilson Y Lee,Yanan Long*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 该综述系统梳理了截至2026年2月ACL Anthology中122篇探讨LGBTQIA+社群与NLP技术关系的论文，发现相关研究数量近年有所增长，但大多采取被动反应式方法（聚焦现有系统缺陷）而非主动构建解决方案，并指出未来工作应加强利益相关者参与、交叉性、跨学科性及非英语语言研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在NLP技术广泛应用于招聘、法律、医疗等影响人们生活的领域之际，理解和减轻对LGBTQIA+等边缘化群体的伤害至关重要。然而，该领域缺乏系统性的综述来梳理现有研究进展、识别盲点并指引未来方向。

Method: 系统性地检索ACL Anthology中截至2026年2月所有明确涉及LGBTQIA+社群与NLP技术关系的论文（共122篇），通过三个研究问题（研究趋势、主题与方法缺口、未来工作方向）进行归纳分析，并从酷儿研究视角审视被忽视的话题和伤害类型。

Result: 研究发现：①相关论文数量在近年内有所增长；②大多数论文采取反应式（reactive）方法，聚焦于暴露和批评现有系统的偏见与不足，而非主动设计包容性解决方案；③存在大量未来工作机会，特别是在利益相关者参与、交叉性、跨学科合作及非英语语言方面；④从酷儿理论视角看，许多重要的伤害类型和研究主题仍未被充分关注。

Conclusion: 该综述不仅是对已有研究的路线图，更是一份行动号召，呼吁学术界致力于构建更加公正和包容的NLP技术。

Abstract: Natural language processing (NLP) technologies are rapidly reshaping how language is created, processed, and interpreted by humans. With current and potential applications in hiring, law, healthcare, and other areas that impact people's lives, understanding and mitigating harms towards marginalized groups is critical. In this survey, we examine NLP research papers that explicitly address the relationship between LGBTQIA+ communities and NLP technologies. We systematically review all such papers published in the ACL Anthology up until February 2026 (n=122), to answer the following research questions: (1) What are current research trends? (2) What gaps exist in terms of topics and methods? (3) What areas are open for future work? We find that while the number of papers on queer NLP has grown within the last few years, most papers take a reactive rather than a proactive approach, focusing on shortcomings of existing systems rather than creating new solutions. Our survey uncovers many opportunities for future work, especially regarding stakeholder involvement, intersectionality, interdisciplinarity, and languages other than English. We also offer an outlook from a queer studies perspective, highlighting understudied topics and blind spots in the harms addressed in NLP papers. Beyond being a roadmap of what has been done, this survey is a call to action for work towards more just and inclusive NLP technologies.

</details>


### [400] [Frontier Lag: A Bibliometric Audit of Capability Misrepresentation in Academic AI Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.04135)
*David Gringras,Misha Salahshoor*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文对112,303篇LLM关键词匹配文献进行审计，发现LLM能力评估论文存在严重的"发表启发差距"：中位数论文评估的模型落后同期前沿+10.85 ECI（约1.4倍Claude Sonnet 3.7到Claude Opus 4.5的距离），且差距以+5.53 ECI/年的速度扩大。仅3.2%的摘要披露推理模式状态，52.5%的论文将结论泛化为"AI"层面。差距中约25%归因于同行评审延迟，75%为超额滞后。提出VERSIO-AI清单作为补救方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 应用领域的LLM能力评估读者想知道当前AI系统能做什么，但现有文献回答的是一个相关但有实质差异的问题：更早、更便宜、更少提示工程的模型在数月或数年前的表现。这种"发表启发差距"导致评估结论严重滞后于前沿，且结论被过度泛化，影响政策与公众认知。

Method: 预注册审计：对2022年1月至2026年4月间112,303篇LLM关键词匹配候选记录进行筛选（18,574篇可纳入，4,766篇可获取全文），将测试模型与同期前沿（基于Epoch AI能力指数ECI，并辅以Arena Elo和Artificial Analysis复现）进行比较，量化差距并分析披露完整性。

Result: 中位数论文评估模型落后前沿+10.85 ECI；差距以+5.53 ECI/年扩大；仅3.2%摘要披露推理模式；52.5%论文结论泛化为"AI"层面（OR=1.23/年）；差距中~25%来自同行评审延迟，~75%为超额滞后。

Conclusion: LLM能力评估文献存在严重且日益扩大的滞后和泛化问题，需通过API访问补贴、编辑强制执行配置披露框架（如提出的VERSIO-AI 13项清单）等措施来弥补差距，提升评估的时效性与科学性。

Abstract: Readers of applied-domain LLM capability evaluations want to know what AI systems can currently do. That literature answers a related, but consequentially different, question: what older, cheaper, less-elicited models could do months or years earlier (a 2026 paper evaluating GPT-3.5 or GPT-4 zero-shot, say, against a frontier of reasoning-capable, tool-using systems like GPT-5.5 Pro and Claude Opus 4.7), often reported with sparse configuration details and abstracted upward into claims about "AI" that propagate through citations, media, and policy. We measure the 'publication elicitation gap' (the gap between these answers) in a pre-registered audit of 112,303 LLM-keyword-matched candidate records (2022-01 to 2026-04; 18,574 admissible, 4,766 full-paper texts retrievable), comparing tested models to the contemporaneous frontier on the Epoch AI Capabilities Index (ECI), reproduced under Arena Elo and Artificial Analysis.
  The median paper evaluates a model +10.85 ECI (~1.4x the distance between Claude Sonnet 3.7 and Claude Opus 4.5) behind the contemporaneous frontier at evaluation time (H1); an exploratory rational-lag baseline (H8) decomposes this into ~25% peer-review latency, ~75% excess lag. The gap is widening at +5.53 ECI/year (H2; 95% CI [+5.03, +5.83]). Meanwhile, only 3.2% of abstracts (21.2% of full-texts) disclose reasoning-mode status on reasoning-capable models (H4) and 52.5% (95% CI [48.2, 56.9]) state conclusions at the level of "AI" rather than the evaluated model(s), rising at OR = 1.23/year.
  Proposed remedies include API-access subsidies and editorial enforcement of reporting frameworks mandating configuration-surface disclosure (model snapshot, reasoning mode/effort, tool access, scaffolding, prompting, etc.); VERSIO-AI is a 13-item checklist (Core 3 desk-reject) extending existing frameworks at the elicitation surface, with per-DOI analysis at frontierlag.org.

</details>


### [401] [Context-Conditioned Generative Models Enable Subnational Refinement of Sparse Humanitarian Surveys](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31489)
*Federica Sibilla,Vasiliki Voukelatou,Duccio Piovani,Kyriacos Koupparis,Daniela Paolotti,Rossano Schifanella,Kyriaki Kalimeri*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文评估了条件归一化流（context-conditioned normalizing flows）在数据稀缺场景下对家庭调查数据进行空间细粒度增强的能力。基于六个中低收入国家的八项调查数据集，证明该生成模型能在样本稀疏时改善次国家级估计，且性能随上下文信息丰富度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 调查数据在科学和政策决策中至关重要，但稀疏样本往往无法捕捉精细的空间粒度，限制了在次国家层面上的推断能力。

Method: 采用条件归一化流（normalizing flows）生成模型，学习复杂数据分布并以外生上下文特征为条件，在受控数据稀缺场景下进行训练和评估。

Result: 在涵盖六个低收入或中等收入国家的人道主义领域的八项家庭调查数据集上，条件生成模型能在严重数据稀缺下优化次国家级调查分布，且性能随上下文信息丰富度系统性提升。

Conclusion: 生成模型可增强次国家级估计，前提是稀疏样本保留足够支持且上下文协变量能编码相关局部异质性。该方法学习完整条件分布而非点估计，为 humanitarian 决策和资源分配提供细粒度证据。

Abstract: Data scarcity limits inference in many scientific and policy domains. Survey data are essential for decision-making, but sparse samples often fail to capture fine spatial granularities. We evaluate normalizing flows, a generative model that learns complex data distributions and can be conditioned on exogenous contextual features, in controlled data scarcity scenarios. Across eight household survey datasets spanning six low-income or middle-income countries in the humanitarian domain, we show that context-conditioned generative models can refine sub-national survey distributions under severe data scarcity, and that performance increases systematically with the richness of the conditioning information. These findings support a general principle for survey data augmentation: generative models can improve sub-national estimates when the sparse sample retains sufficient support and contextual covariates encode relevant local heterogeneity. By learning full conditional distributions rather than point estimates, the approach provides fine-grained evidence for humanitarian decision-making and resource allocation.

</details>


### [402] [Beyond Tool Adoption: A Practical Five-Stage Developmental Continuum for AI Literacy in Higher Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00038)
*J. Paul Liu,Rachel Levy*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出AI素养发展连续体模型（0-4阶段），描述大学生从“未接触”到“改进型使用”的发展路径，并通过北卡罗来纳州立大学的实践案例（330+参与者）展示其教学应用，强调AI素养应被视为一种发展性能力而非单纯的工具采纳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI素养框架虽定义了核心能力，但缺乏诊断学习者起点及追踪发展进程的实用工具。学生要么因恐惧/伦理顾虑而回避AI，要么不加批判地过度依赖AI。亟需一个可操作的阶段性发展模型来指导教学实践。

Method: 提出五阶段AI素养连续体模型（0-4），结合设计研究法（DBR），在北卡罗来纳州立大学的学分课程和密集工作坊中实施，涉及330+参与者（2024秋-2026春）。未使用验证过的前后测工具或对照组，因此结论为观察性和实践导向的。

Result: 参与者表现出从非参与或非批判性使用向知情使用阶段转变的行为证据；持续且融入学科的体验产生了更强的批判性评估和改进导向实践的证据。

Conclusion: AI素养应被理解为理解、评估和负责任地应用AI系统于学科与社会语境的发展性能力，而非单纯的工具采纳。该连续体可作为与UNESCO、OECD等国际框架对齐的教学诊断和路径规划工具。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) literacy is increasingly recognized as a foundational competency for all university graduates. Yet students' engagement with AI tools often clusters at two extremes: avoidance driven by fear, mistrust, ethical concern, or lack of access, and uncritical reliance that produces fluent output while masking misunderstanding. Existing AI literacy frameworks provide valuable competency definitions, but most offer limited guidance for diagnosing where learners begin and how they progress toward responsible, critical engagement. This paper proposes a five-stage AI Literacy Continuum: 0) Not Yet Engaged, 1) Uncritical Use, 2) Informed Use, 3) Critical Evaluation, and 4) Improvement --that describes developmental orientations toward AI use in higher education. The continuum complements dimensional frameworks by providing educators with a practical diagnostic and instructional pathway aligned with international frameworks, including UNESCO and OECD. We present a design-based implementation case from North Carolina State University, where credit-bearing courses and intensive hands-on workshops engaged more than 330 participants between Fall 2024 and Spring 2026. Because the implementation did not use a validated pre/post instrument or comparison group, we frame the findings as observational and practice-based: participants exhibited behaviors consistent with movement from non-engagement or uncritical use toward informed engagement, while sustained and discipline-embedded experiences produced stronger evidence of critical evaluation and improvement-oriented practice. We discuss curricular pathways, opportunity considerations, assessment strategies, and argue that AI literacy should be understood not as tool adoption alone but as a developmental capacity to understand, evaluate, and responsibly apply AI systems in disciplinary and societal contexts.

</details>


### [403] [The Fair Lending Model: How the Longest-Running Algorithmic Fairness Programs Work in Practice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02957)
*Emily Black,Miranda Bogen,Logan Koepke,Solon Barocas,Wesley Deng,Mingwei Hsu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过对35位公平贷款生态系统参与者的半结构化访谈，首次实证揭示了美国金融机构在实际操作中如何测试和减轻算法歧视。研究发现，虽然金融机构在防止贷款歧视方面存在一个"底线"实践，但在具体测试方法和算法优化上差异巨大；监管检查是合规工作的关键驱动力，但实际效果取决于机构如何平衡商业激励、法律张力与监管不确定性。最终发现，监管权威在促进公平贷款实践中发挥了独特作用，这一制度设计特征在其他民权法领域和当前算法歧视政策提案中几乎缺失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管美国金融机构几十年来一直按照公平贷款法运行算法公平项目，但人们对这些要求在实践中的具体运作知之甚少。作者旨在提供首个实证研究，揭示金融机构在实践中如何测试和减轻算法歧视，并阐明公平贷款法的监管设计如何塑造了公平贷款项目的政策、流程和实践。

Method: 对35位公平贷款生态系统参与者进行半结构化访谈，涵盖金融机构、监管机构、倡导组织等多元视角。

Result: 金融机构存在防止贷款歧视的"底线"实践，这在其他领域基本缺失，但歧视测试方法和算法优化策略差异巨大。监管检查是合规工作的主要驱动力，但实际影响取决于机构能否驾驭商业激励、法律张力与监管不确定性。

Conclusion: 监管权威在成功促进公平贷款实践中发挥了独特作用，这一制度设计特征与其他民权法领域截然不同，且在当前处理算法歧视的政策提案中几乎完全缺失。

Abstract: U.S. financial institutions subject to fair lending laws have been running algorithmic fairness programs for decades. Despite this long history, remarkably little is known about how these requirements operate in practice. In this paper, we offer the first empirical account of how financial institutions test for and mitigate algorithmic discrimination on the ground. In doing so, we shed light on how the regulatory design of fair lending law and regulation have shaped the policies, processes, and practices of fair lending programs. Drawing on 35 semi-structured interviews with participants across the fair lending ecosystem, we find that while financial institutions have a floor of fairness practices aimed at preventing discrimination in lending largely absent in other domains, the specifics of how firms test for discrimination and search for less discriminatory algorithms varies widely. We also find that regulatory supervision via fair lending examinations has been the key driver of compliance work, but that the practical impact of fair lending programs often depends on how well they can navigate competing business incentives, perceived legal tensions, and regulatory uncertainty. Ultimately, our findings highlight the unique role that supervisory authority has played in successfully fostering fair lending practices -- a regulatory design feature that is distinct from other areas of civil rights law and almost completely absent from recent policy proposals for dealing with algorithmic discrimination.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [404] [OLIVE: Online Low-Rank Incremental Learning for Efficient Adaptive Exoskeletons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05234)
*Dong Liu,Yanxuan Yu,Ben Lengerich,Tony Geng,Ying Nian Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OLIVE是一种参数高效的在线自适应框架，通过低秩残差分解（ΔW = AB^T）持续个性化外骨骼控制策略，仅依赖机载传感器反馈（EMG, IMU, 振动）实现动态地形适应，在步态平滑度、努力程度和运动稳定性上分别提升13、22和15个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有外骨骼控制系统依赖静态步态策略，无法适应动态现实环境或个体用户特征，亟需一种能在部署过程中持续个性化调整的在线自适应方法。

Method: 将控制策略的自适应部分分解为低秩残差形式 ΔW = AB^T（r ≪ min(d,k)），将在线更新成本从O(dk)降至O(r(d+k))；通过基于奖励的策梯度方法仅利用机载传感器反馈更新参数；引入门控机制根据上下文状态调节个性化强度；设计动态秩调度器根据地形的复杂度自适应调整更新维度。

Result: 在可穿戴平台上，OLIVE在步态平滑度、努力程度和运动稳定性上分别比最强基线提升13、22和15个百分点，约1,800步收敛，端到端延迟7.4毫秒。

Conclusion: OLIVE通过低秩在线增量学习实现了外骨骼控制的高效个性化自适应，在不同地形（平地、楼梯、坡道、不平整地面）上均表现鲁棒，为动态环境下可穿戴机器人控制提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Wearable exoskeleton systems hold promise for restoring mobility in individuals with physical impairments, yet most existing controllers rely on static gait policies that lack the ability to adapt to dynamic real-world environments or individual user characteristics. We present \olive (\underline{O}nline \underline{L}ow-rank \underline{I}ncremental Learning for Efficient Adapti\underline{ve} Exoskeletons), a parameter-efficient online adaptation framework that continuously personalizes exoskeleton control during deployment. \olive decomposes the adaptive component of the control policy into a low-rank residual form~$\dW = \At\Bt^\top$ with rank~$r!\ll!\min(d,k)$, reducing online update cost from $\mathcal{O}(dk)$ to $\mathcal{O}(r(d{+}k))$ while preserving the stability of a pretrained base controller~$\Wz$. Parameters are updated via a reward-shaped policy gradient driven purely by on-body sensor feedback (EMG, IMU, vibration), eliminating dependence on offline reference trajectories. A gating mechanism modulates the strength of personalization based on contextual state, and a dynamic rank scheduler adapts the update dimensionality to terrain complexity -- allocating minimal capacity on simple flat terrain and expanding to higher-rank updates on demanding uneven surfaces -- enabling robust performance across diverse activities: flat walking, stair navigation, slopes, and uneven terrain. Experiments on the wearable platform demonstrate that \olive achieves +13, +22, and +15 percentage-point improvements in gait smoothness, effort reduction, and motion stability over the strongest baseline, converging within $\sim$1{,}800 walking steps at 7.4,ms end-to-end latency. Our code implementation is available at https://github.com/FastLM/OLIVE.

</details>


### [405] [A New Quaternion-Joint Cable-Driven Redundant Manipulator Configuration and its Control Through FABRIK and Residual Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05236)
*Tanapath Pornthisan,Thanapat Kemthong,Thanyapisit Kangsathien,Pasut Aranchaiya,Paulo Garcia,Viboon Sangveraphunsiri*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种4段8关节的缆索驱动冗余机械臂，采用四元数关节设计，并通过残差强化学习实现高精度控制，相比传统FABRIK算法在精度上提升了三个数量级，且工作空间更广、硬件成本更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有缆索驱动冗余机械臂虽因四元数关节而减少了每自由度所需电机数量，但其运动学模型复杂，导致构型先验决策困难、控制系统计算负担高，且非线性放大了加工误差带来的设计与实物偏差。因此需要更优的机械臂构型和控制方法来解决这些问题。

Method: 设计了4段8关节的四元数关节机械臂构型；采用残差强化学习（Residual Reinforcement Learning）进行控制，并与FABRIK算法进行对比；描述了完整的FABRIK控制流程及对应的学习实现。

Result: 4段8关节构型比现有构型工作空间更广、硬件成本更低；残差强化学习在位置精度和方向精度上优于FABRIK三个数量级，实现了对新型机械臂的精确控制；控制实现更简单。

Conclusion: 所提出的机械臂构型和控制方法在效率和精度上均优于现有方案，适用于此类机械臂的新系统设计，为设计者提供了更丰富的工具。

Abstract: Robotic arms capable of traversing arbitrary spatial paths, especially in highly obstructed workspaces, are highly desired across several industries. Quaternion-joints have recently empowered a specific class of robotic arms -- cable-driven redundant manipulators -- beyond its prior capabilities. Specifically, quaternion-joints reduce the number of required motors per degree of freedom, paving the way for more compact solutions.An ongoing challenge is that the complexity of the kinematic model of quaternion joints challenges a priori decisions on manipulator configurations and imposes higher computational demands on the control system and its non-linearities amplify all discrepancies between design and physical artifact arising from fabrication imprecision. Here we show a that a 4-segment, 8-joint manipulator can achieve a broader workspace than extant configurations, at lower hardware cost, and that Residual Reinforcement Learning outperforms extant state-of-the-art methods -- specifically, the FABRIK algorithm -- on the control of such manipulator. Our results show that this configuration is more workspace-effective than prior designs, and that Residual Reinforcement Learning outperforms FABRIK by three orders of magnitude on positional and orientational accuracy, effecting precise control of the novel 4-segment, 8-joint manipulator. Additionally, the control implementation is simpler: we describe the complete FABRIK process for control and corresponding learning implementation. Our methodology is applicable to the design of new systems, providing designers with further tools for the development of this class of manipulators and corresponding control systems for novel configurations.

</details>


### [406] [Inverse Manipulation through Symbolic Planning and Residual Operator Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05248)
*Yigit Yildirim,Giuseppe Rauso,Riccardo Caccavale,Alberto Finzi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种混合框架，通过从演示中自动提取STRIPS-like算子并构建逆操作目标，结合符号任务规划与强化学习残差策略，将近似符号逆操作转化为物理可行的逆技能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作任务中，纯符号逆规划或运动轨迹回放无法完全恢复连续交互动力学下正向执行的效果，需要一种融合符号推理与连续控制的逆操作框架。

Method: ①从演示中通过软几何谓词自动提取STRIPS-like算子；②为每个算子构建保持前提、恢复删除效果、否定添加效果的逆恢复目标；③任务规划器尝试用动作原语满足目标；④未解决的符号谓词诱导残差算子学习问题，通过强化学习（SAC）求解。

Result: 在ManiSkill3 PushCube任务中，符号逆操作执行粗略的"抓取-放置"恢复，残差SAC策略精炼立方体位姿以满足剩余逆谓词，实现从近似符号逆操作到物理可行逆技能的转化。

Conclusion: 谓词派生的残差控制能将近似符号逆操作转化为物理可执行的逆技能，验证了符号推理与强化学习混合框架在逆操作任务中的有效性。

Abstract: Inverting a robotic task requires more than reversing symbolic state transitions or rewinding motor trajectories. In robot manipulation tasks, symbolic inverse plans often fail to fully restore the effects of forward executions under continuous interaction dynamics. We present a hybrid framework for inverse manipulation that derives inverse-skill objectives from STRIPS-like operators automatically extracted from demonstrations through soft geometric predicates. For each extracted operator, we construct an inverse restoration objective that preserves preconditions, restores delete effects, and negates add effects. A task planner first attempts to satisfy this objective using available action primitives. Unresolved symbolic predicates then induce a residual operator learning problem solved through Reinforcement Learning (RL). We evaluate the framework on the ManiSkill3 PushCube task. For a forward pushing skill, the symbolic inverse performs a coarse pick-and-place restoration, while a residual Soft Actor-Critic policy refines the cube pose to satisfy the remaining inverse predicates. Our results show that predicate-derived residual control can turn an approximate symbolic inverse into a physically grounded inverse skill.

</details>


### [407] [Efficient Computation of Distance Functions for Navigation Vector Fields in Lie Groups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05372)
*Vinicius M. Gonçalves,João Baião,Felipe Bartelt,Douglas G. Macharet,Gustavo M. Freitas,Héctor Azpúrua,Luciano C. A. Pimenta*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种高效计算点与李群上G-多项式曲线之间距离的方法，通过将问题简化为少量多项式求根计算，显著降低计算时间并保持精度，并在SE(3)群和机械臂上进行了实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于向量场的机器人控制方法需要频繁计算机器人位姿与曲线之间的距离及最近点，而这类计算在拓展到李群（如SE(3)）时计算开销很大，难以在嵌入式平台以高控制频率实时运行，因此需要一种高效计算方法。

Method: 利用G-多项式曲线的结构特性，将距离计算问题转化为少量多项式的求根问题，从而避免原有基于优化的迭代计算方法。针对SE(3)群给出了实用公式，并开发了开源计算包。

Result: 仿真结果表明，与现有基于优化的方法相比，该方法在保持精度的同时显著降低了计算时间。在机器人机械臂上的实验验证进一步证实了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 所提出的方法为李群上向量场路径跟踪控制提供了高效的距离计算方案，解决了高频率控制中计算瓶颈问题，具有实用性和可推广性。

Abstract: Vector-field-based methods are widely used for robot control and are often applied to the path-tracking problem. Some vector field approaches require repeatedly computing the distance between the robot configuration and the curve, as well as the corresponding closest point. Recently, vector fields have been extended to Lie Groups. In this case, this computation can be expensive, especially when performed at high control frequencies on embedded platforms. This paper proposes a method for efficiently computing the distance between a point and a curve represented as what is called a G-polynomial curve, which is a curve representation that generalizes polynomial curves to matrix Lie groups. The proposed approach exploits the structure of these curves to reduce the problem to a small number of polynomial root-finding computations. Simulation results show that the method significantly reduces computation time while maintaining accuracy compared to existing optimization-based approaches. Practical formulas are also provided for the case of the group SE(3), and the method is validated experimentally on a robotic manipulator. The methodology is implemented in a computational package, available online.

</details>


### [408] [VASO: Formally Verifiable Self-Evolving Skills for Physical AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05395)
*Yunhao Yang,Neel P. Bhatt,Kevin Wang,Samuel Tetteh,Zhangyang Wang,Ufuk Topcu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: VASO是一个将形式化验证与自演化框架相结合的机器人技能合约优化系统，通过模型检验反例将验证反馈转化为文本梯度，在不更新基础模型权重的情况下优化LLM生成的技能合约，在Jackal和PX4任务上达到97.2%的规范合规性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能演化循环依赖执行反馈、单元测试、环境奖励或LLM自我批评等信号，这些信号仅提供"痕迹级"证据——证明技能在采样执行中有效，而非在未经测试条件下满足时序安全契约。基础模型虽然降低了创建技能的成本，但信任技能的成本并未降低。

Method: VASO将每个技能表示为具有双重接口的语义合约：(1) 形式化接口——将机器人状态、观测和控制命令对齐为逻辑命题以进行模型检验；(2) 规划器接口——指导可执行行为生成。模型检验器先过滤逻辑不一致的技能合约，再验证技能诱导的计划是否满足全局和局部时序规范。验证失败时，反例轨迹被翻译为文本梯度，用于更新可复用的技能合约。

Result: 在Clearpath Jackal和PX4四旋翼任务上，VASO在不到100个优化样本下达到97.2%的形式化规范合规性，优于执行反馈、提示优化和微调基线。

Conclusion: VASO是首个在物理AI智能体中闭环形式化验证与自演化LLM生成技能的工作：形式化反例成为可复用机器人技能合约的优化反馈，而非仅验证一次性计划、调整规划器提示或微调模型权重。

Abstract: Reusable robot skills are becoming the basic units through which embodied agents turn open-ended instructions into long-horizon physical behavior. We argue that, while foundation models have collapsed the cost of creating these skills, the cost of trusting them has not. Existing skill-evolution loops refine skills through execution feedback, unit tests, environment reward, or LLM self-critique, but these signals provide only trace-level evidence: they show that a skill worked on sampled executions, not that skill-induced plans satisfy temporal safety contracts under untested conditions. We introduce VASO, a framework for verification-guided self-evolution of LLM-generated robot skill contracts. In VASO, each skill is represented as a semantic contract with two coupled interfaces: a formal interface that aligns robot states, observations, and control commands with logical propositions for model checking, and a planner-facing interface that guides executable behavior generation. A model checker first filters logically inconsistent skill contracts, then verifies plans induced by the skill against global and local temporal specifications. When verification fails, VASO translates the counterexample trace into a textual gradient that updates the reusable skill contract while keeping foundation-model weights frozen. On Clearpath Jackal and PX4 quadcopter tasks, VASO reaches 97.2% formal-specification compliance using fewer than 100 optimization samples, outperforming execution-feedback, prompt-optimization, and fine-tuning baselines. To our knowledge, VASO is the first framework that closes the loop between formal verification and self-evolving LLM-generated skills for physical AI agents: formal counterexamples become optimization feedback for reusable robot skill contracts, rather than merely verifying one-off plans, tuning planner prompts, or fine-tuning model weights.

</details>


### [409] [MoDex: A Diffusion Policy for Sequential Multi-Object Dexterous Grasping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05407)
*Haofei Lu,Hongjia Liu,Yifei Dong,Florian T. Pokorny,Jens Lundell,Danica Kragic*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MoDex是一种扩散策略，通过对抗空间和点云条件预测抓取位姿，使灵巧手能用部分自由度抓取当前物体，保留剩余自由度用于后续多物体顺序抓取，在仿真和真实实验中成功率比基线提升2.92-17.92%和6.67-17.78%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有灵巧手抓取方法将所有自由度用于单个物体，未能充分利用手部灵巧性，无法实现不释放已抓取物体的情况下顺序抓取多个物体。

Method: 提出MoDex扩散策略，以对抗空间（指定参与当前抓取的手指）和点云为条件，从观测直接预测下一抓取位姿；采用两阶段训练：模仿学习预训练+强化学习微调，实现仿真到真实的迁移。

Result: 在MuJoCo仿真和真实Franka Emika Panda+Allegro Hand平台上，MoDex成功率比基线提升：仿真2.92-17.92%，真实6.67-17.78%。

Conclusion: MoDex通过对抗空间条件化扩散策略，有效实现了灵巧手顺序多物体抓取，且两阶段训练策略提升了仿真到真实的迁移效果。

Abstract: This work addresses sequentially grasping multiple objects with a single dexterous hand without releasing those already held. Most dexterous grasping methods commit all of the hand's degrees of freedom to a single object, underutilizing its dexterity and leaving no redundancy for subsequent grasps. The proposed solution, MoDex, is a diffusion policy that predicts the next gripper pose directly from observations, conditioned on an opposition space and point cloud. The opposition space condition specifies which fingers participate in the current grasp, enabling the gripper to use only a subset of its available degrees of freedom while reserving the remaining degrees of freedom for subsequent grasps. To facilitate sim-to-real transfer, MoDex is trained in two stages: first through imitation learning on expert demonstrations, and subsequently through reinforcement learning fine-tuning, which consistently improves success rates over the pre-trained policy. We evaluate MoDex in simulation on a MuJoCo-based Franka Emika Panda robot equipped with an Allegro Hand and on the corresponding real-world hardware platform. Across both simulation and real-world experiments, MoDex achieves higher success rates than the evaluated learning-based baselines, improving performance by 2.92-17.92% and 6.67-17.78%, respectively. Project page: https://modex2026.github.io/.

</details>


### [410] [Learning from Demonstrations over Riemannian Manifolds using Neural ODEs: An Extended Abstract](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05422)
*Diana Cuervo Espinosa,Mahathi Anand,Angela P. Schoellig*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出利用神经常微分方程在黎曼流形上数值估计测地线，以实现机器人位姿（位置和方向）的自然运动生成，相比传统方法降低了计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的从示范中学习（LfD）通常在欧氏空间进行，但机器人状态（如方向）天然存在于弯曲空间（流形）中。现有方法难以高效地处理流形上的自然运动生成问题，且测地线计算计算开销大。

Method: 提出在黎曼流形上通过神经常微分方程（Neural ODE）数值估计测地线路径，将测地线解码回原始任务空间并部署于机器人。框架编码了位置和方向数据，利用神经ODE的连续深度特性避免传统离散化方法的高计算成本。

Result: 通过仿真实验展示了框架的初步结果，并与其它测地线计算方法进行了比较，验证了所提方法在计算效率和运动自然性方面的优势。

Conclusion: 该方法能够在黎曼流形上高效生成自然、复杂的机器人运动，克服了传统LfD方法对欧氏空间的依赖和测地线计算的计算瓶颈，未来工作将解决所面临的挑战并进一步探索应用前景。

Abstract: Learning from demonstratins (LfD) is usually performed over Euclidean spaces, while the robot state, e.g. orientation, naturally evolves over curved spaces. Therefore, to ensure natural, complex motion generation, we investigate learning from demonstrations over Riemannian manifolds that are capable of encoding both position and orientation data. Here, geodesic paths provide for natural motion between two arbitrary points within the manifold. We propose to numerically estimate geodesics via neural ordinary differential equations, mitigating large computational overhead of existing approaches. Finally, these geodesics can be decoded back into the original task space before deploying on the robot. In this extended abstract, we discuss the architecture of our framework, provide some initial insights from our simulation experiments, including comparison to other geodesic computation mechanisms, and discuss the challenges and prospects for future work.

</details>


### [411] [Uncertainty-Aware Adaptive Sensor Fusion for Autonomous Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05437)
*Simegnew Yihunie Alaba,Yuichi Motai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合深度学习与无迹卡尔曼滤波(UKF)结合的视觉-惯性里程计(VIO)方法，利用Vision Transformer(ViT)处理IMU时序数据、多尺度CNN学习光流视觉特征，并通过自适应传感器融合模块和不确定性感知损失函数提升姿态估计精度，在KITTI数据集上ATE和RPE显著优于基线模型，且能以155 FPS高效运行于NVIDIA A100 GPU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VIO方法在复杂环境（噪声、不完全或不可靠传感器输入）下鲁棒性不足，融合深度学习与滤波方法时缺乏对不确定性的显式建模，导致姿态估计精度受限。

Method: (1) ViT网络捕获IMU数据的时间依赖特征；(2) 多尺度CNN学习基于光流的视觉运动线索；(3) 自适应传感器融合模块利用估计不确定性动态加权IMU与视觉特征；(4) 不确定性感知损失函数将预测不确定性显式纳入学习过程。

Result: 在KITTI数据集上，ATE和RPE显著优于基线方法；模型轻量高效，在NVIDIA A100 GPU上达到155 FPS处理速度。

Conclusion: 所提混合深度学习-UKF方法有效提升了VIO在挑战性环境中的鲁棒性和精度，且计算效率高，适合部署于资源受限的自主导航系统。

Abstract: This work introduces a hybrid deep learning approach integrated with an Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) to enhance pose estimation accuracy in Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO) for autonomous navigation. The proposed model employs a Vision Transformer (ViT) network to effectively capture temporal dependencies from inertial measurement unit (IMU) data and utilizes a Multiscale Convolutional Neural Network (MCNN) to learn optical flow-based motion cues from visual data. An adaptive sensor fusion module dynamically weights IMU and visual features by leveraging estimated uncertainty, thus improving robustness in diverse and challenging environmental conditions. Additionally, a novel uncertainty-aware loss function is proposed to explicitly incorporate prediction uncertainty into the learning process, enabling robust and accurate navigation under noisy, incomplete, or unreliable sensor inputs. Comprehensive evaluations of the KITTI dataset demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms baseline approaches, achieving superior performance in terms of Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE) and Relative Pose Error (RPE). The lightweight and computationally efficient model processes data at 155 FPS on an NVIDIA A100 GPU, making it highly suitable for deployment in resource-constrained autonomous systems.

</details>


### [412] [FlowPRO: Reward-Free Reinforced Fine-Tuning of Flow-Matching VLAs via Proximalized Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05468)
*Yihao Wu,He Zhang,Junbo Tan,Xueqian Wang,Zhengyou Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FlowPRO提出了一种免奖励的离线强化微调框架，通过RPRO偏好优化目标和干预-回滚数据采集范式，在流匹配VLA模型上实现了比SFT、DAgger和基于奖励的RL更高的任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的VLA模型后训练方法存在瓶颈：SFT和DAgger仅间接利用失败信号，基于奖励的RL受限于真实世界奖励设计的困难和可靠评论家训练的难度。

Method: 1) RPRO：针对流匹配动作头的偏好优化目标，结合对比优化器和显式近端正则化器，消除Flow-DPO的奖励黑客问题；2) 干预-回滚数据范式：通过单一操作员动作产生自然配对的正面与负面轨迹；3) 平滑插值与批次混合：将稀疏修正转换为密集的每状态监督。

Result: 在四个长时程双臂操作任务中，FlowPRO取得了最高成功率，优于四种代表性基线方法；消融实验证实了每个损失组件的贡献。

Conclusion: FlowPRO通过免奖励的偏好优化框架有效提升了流匹配VLA模型的策略性能，消除了奖励黑客问题，并在真实机器人任务上取得了优越表现。

Abstract: Post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models into policies that can be reliably deployed on real robots remains a major bottleneck. SFT and DAgger exploit failure signals only indirectly, and reward-based RL is bottlenecked by the difficulty of real-world reward design and of training reliable critics. We present FlowPRO, a reward-free offline reinforced fine-tuning framework for flow-matching VLAs. Algorithmically, we propose RPRO (Robotic Flow-matching Proximalized Preference Optimization), a preference-optimization objective tailored to the flow-matching action head of VLA models. RPRO pairs a contrastive optimizer with an explicit proximal regularizer that anchors the absolute magnitude of the implicit reward, thereby eliminating the reward-hacking failure mode of plain Flow-DPO. On the data side, a teleoperated intervention-and-rollback paradigm produces naturally paired positive and negative trajectories $(τ^w, τ^l)$ on a real robot from a single operator action; a Smooth Interpolation procedure, combined with batch mixing, then converts these sparse corrections into dense per-state supervision while preserving the base policy's capabilities. On four long-horizon bimanual tasks, FlowPRO attains the highest success rate, outperforming four representative baselines, and ablations confirm the contribution of each loss component.

</details>


### [413] [Learning Contact Representation for Leg Odometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05501)
*Emre Girgin,Cagri Kilic*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种自监督表示学习框架，仅利用关节编码器实现足式机器人的触地检测，无需力传感器，在性能上超越有监督方法和基线概率方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有足式机器人里程计依赖脚底与地面速度为零的假设，需要精确的腿相位检测。力传感器并非通用可用，且无法应对滑移等干扰，因此需要一种不依赖力传感器的触地检测方法。

Method: 采用自监督表示学习框架，仅使用关节编码器标准传感器数据，学习触地表示，并对摆动相和支撑相进行概率建模。

Result: 实验结果表明所提出的自监督触地检测器有效，性能优于需要传感器增强和标注的有监督方法以及基线概率方法。

Conclusion: 自监督表示学习可以仅利用关节编码器实现高效触地检测，避免了力传感器的依赖及其局限性，代码已开源。

Abstract: The estimation of odometry in legged robots depends on the assumption that the velocity of the foot with respect to the world remains zero during the stance phase. Feedback for the main body velocity is derived from the kinematic serial chain of the feet making accurate leg phase detection is a critical subproblem. A considerable number of studies employ ground reaction force sensors mounted at the tip of the foot to classify, yet these sensors may not be universally available for all legged robots. Additionally, these sensors are often unresponsive to unaccounted disturbances, such as slippage, while the foot remains in contact with the ground. In this study, we propose a self-supervised representation learning framework for contact detection that utilizes the standard sensor set of joint encoders without reliance on force sensor augmentations. We employ learned representations to model the stance and swing phases probabilistically. The experimental results obtained confirm the efficacy of the proposed self-supervised contact detector. Our framework exhibited superior performance in comparison to supervised methods which necessitate sensor set augmentation and labeling, as well as baseline probabilistic approaches. Additionally, we make our code available to the public.

</details>


### [414] [Auditing Demonstration Curation Metrics: Action-Only Scorers Fail on the Structural Defects That Degrade Imitation Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05588)
*Aarav Bedi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个受控测试平台，系统评估了七种演示数据筛选指标在两种缺陷类型（细微扰动和结构性错误）下的表现，发现只有基于状态轨迹的指标能检测结构性错误，且高检测准确率并不保证下游策略性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模仿学习策略的性能受限于演示数据质量，现有多种自动筛选指标各自在不同数据和协议下验证，缺乏统一、可控的比较框架来明确哪些指标能真正识别有害演示。

Method: 构建受控测试平台，在演示数据中注入已知类型的缺陷（细微扰动：相关动作噪声、震颤、截断；结构性错误：关键时刻错误动作），从两个维度审计七种筛选指标：缺陷与干净演示的区分能力，以及基于指标筛选后训练行为克隆策略的任务成功率提升。

Result: 细微扰动可通过多元离群值检测识别，去除后可完全恢复下游差距；结构性错误在仅基于动作的指标中不可见，甚至两种指标出现倒置（错误评分更高），筛选后策略不升反降；仅基于状态轨迹的指标能检测结构性错误，但最佳指标也仅恢复三分之一的下游差距；高检测准确率不保证下游性能提升。

Conclusion: 不同缺陷类型需要不同的检测指标，仅基于动作的指标对结构性错误失效甚至有害，状态轨迹指标更有效但仍有显著差距，并指出检测准确率与下游性能提升之间存在鸿沟。

Abstract: Imitation-learning policies inherit the quality of the demonstrations they are trained on, and a growing set of curation metrics promise to score and filter low-quality demonstrations automatically. These metrics are each validated on different data with different protocols, so it is unclear which of them actually identify the demonstrations that harm a policy. We build a controlled testbed in which demonstration defects are injected with known type, and audit seven curation metrics along two axes: how well each separates defective from clean demonstrations, and whether training a behavior-cloning policy on each metric's curated subset improves task success. We study two defect regimes. Subtle perturbations (correlated action noise, tremor, truncation) are detectable by multivariate outlier scoring and, once removed, recover the full downstream gap. Structural errors, where the demonstration executes a wrong action at a key moment, are invisible to every action-only metric we test, and two of them are inverted: they score defective demonstrations as higher quality and, used for curation, tend to leave the policy at or below the uncurated baseline rather than above it. Only metrics that examine the state trajectory detect structural errors, and even the best of them recovers just a third of the downstream gap. High detection accuracy does not guarantee downstream improvement. We release the testbed and all curation implementations.

</details>


### [415] [Discrete-WAM: Unified Discrete Vision-Action Token Editing for World-Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05645)
*Ziyang Yao,Haochen Liu,Yuncheng Jiang,Zeyu Zhu,Zibin Guo,Jingru Wang,Tianle Liu,Jianwei Cui,Kuiyuan Yang,Hongwei Xie,Jingwei Zhao,Guang Chen,Hangjun Ye*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Discrete-WAM，一种统一潜在视觉-动作世界策略，将未来视觉状态和自车动作表示为对齐的离散token，通过共享离散扩散框架统一世界建模、世界-动作策略和分层决策策略，支持组合因果推理和反事实推理，在自动驾驶基准上取得竞争性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶方法依赖直接状态到动作映射，仅捕捉相关性而未显式建模以动作为条件的环境动态；连续潜在世界模型缺乏组合结构，无法进行跨反事实未来的因果推理。

Method: 将未来视觉状态和自车动作对齐编码为离散token，构建共享离散扩散框架，统一三个生成任务：世界建模（预测未来视觉状态）、世界-动作策略（联合建模状态与动作）、分层决策策略（支持层次化决策），从而实现组合泛化。

Result: 在大规模自动驾驶基准上取得竞争性性能，同时支持可控生成和反事实推理。

Conclusion: Discrete-WAM通过离散化统一表征和扩散框架，为更可靠的自动驾驶决策提供了原则性路径。

Abstract: Autonomous driving requires reasoning about how ego actions shape the evolution of the surrounding world. However, most end-to-end methods rely on direct state-to-action mappings, capturing correlations without explicitly modeling action-conditioned dynamics. Conversely, continuous-latent world models often lack compositional structure for causal reasoning across counterfactual futures. We introduce Discrete-WAM, a unified latent vision-action world policy that represents future visual states and ego actions as aligned discrete tokens, enabling compositional causal reasoning across alternative futures. Built upon this unified discrete alignment, Discrete-WAM establishes a shared discrete diffusion framework with unified generative tasks, jointly formulating world modeling, world-action policy, and hierarchical decision-enabled policy, supporting compositional generalization across diverse driving scenarios. Experiments on large-scale autonomous-driving benchmarks show that Discrete-WAM achieves competitive performance while supporting controllable generation and counterfactual reasoning, offering a principled path toward more reliable decision-making.

</details>


### [416] [Safe Embodied AI for Long-horizon Tasks: A Cross-layer Analysis of Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05660)
*Dabin Kim,Daemin Park,Sangyub Lee,Jinsik Kim,Yeongtak Oh,Jongho Shin,Sungroh Yoon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了长时域机器人操作中的安全问题，从具身AI角度将现有文献按干预时机分为规划时、策略时和执行时安全三类，分析了各类工作提供的证据强度（形式化保证、统计支持、经验启发式），指出了当前安全声明的支撑不足和关键研究空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身AI系统在物理环境中长时域推理和行动的能力日益增强，但物理世界中的失败可能伤害人员、损坏物品、干扰工作场所，安全问题的紧迫性凸显。然而该领域文献分散在规划、策略设计和运行时执行中，缺乏系统性梳理。

Method: 按干预时机（规划时/策略时/执行时）组织文献，分析每类工作提供的证据强度（形式化保证、统计支持、经验安全启发式），区分骨干能力论文、直接安全机制和基准/评估研究。

Result: 揭示了当前安全声明的支撑不足之处：策略时安全证据有限，接触丰富长时域操作缺乏形式化支持，不确定性触发的干预尚不成熟，缺乏操作专用安全基准。

Conclusion: 提出了跨层保证、评估设计和长时域机器人代理安全部署的研究方向。

Abstract: Embodied AI systems are increasingly expected to reason and act over extended horizons in physical environments. This growing capability brings safety to the foreground, because failures in the physical world can harm people, damage objects, and disrupt workplaces. Although safe embodied AI has attracted substantial attention, the literature remains fragmented across planning, policy design, and runtime execution. Long-horizon robotic manipulation is a particularly revealing anchor domain for this problem because semantic misgrounding, subtask-level error propagation, execution drift, and contact-rich physical risk can accumulate within the same closed-loop system. This survey therefore provides a structured review of safety in long-horizon robotic manipulation from an embodied AI perspective. We organize the literature by intervention locus, covering planning-time, policy-time, and execution-time safety, and we analyze the strength of the evidence that each line of work provides, distinguishing formal guarantees, statistical support, and empirical safety heuristics. This framework clarifies the distinct roles of backbone capability papers, direct safety mechanisms, and benchmark or evaluation studies, while exposing where current safety claims are well supported and where they remain indirect. We identify persistent gaps, including limited evidence for policy-time safety, weak formal support for contact-rich long-horizon manipulation, immature uncertainty-triggered intervention, and a shortage of manipulation-specific safety benchmarks. We conclude by outlining research directions for cross-layer assurance, evaluation design, and safer deployment of long-horizon robotic agents in real-world settings.

</details>


### [417] [Preserving Full 6-DOF Actuation Under Abrupt Total Rotor Failures: Passive Fault-Tolerant Flight Control Using a Biaxial-Tilt Hexacopter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05663)
*Yipeng Yang,Yiqiao Tang,Hao Zhang,Jinqi Jiang,Jianfeng He,Rumo Chen,Xinghu Yu,Zhan Li,Huijun Gao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对双轴倾斜过驱动六旋翼（BTO）在突发总转子故障下的被动容错控制问题，本文提出两种无需故障检测的被动容错方案：基于高阶全驱动控制器与线性扩展状态观测器的控制层方案，以及基于模型参考自适应控制分配与动量估计的分配层方案。通过扩展可达到力旋量空间的内接球度量（引入瞬态力旋量跳跃项），实现了对最多三转子同时故障的可行性评估。仿真与实验验证了BTO在单/多转子故障下的稳定悬停与6-DOF轨迹跟踪能力，相比单轴倾斜和共面六旋翼具有更大恢复裕度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统多旋翼在突发总转子故障时会急剧丧失可达力旋量空间（AWS），导致完全6-DOF恢复在物理上不可行。现有方法多依赖故障检测与隔离（FDI）或在线优化，计算复杂且存在检测延迟。本文旨在探索BTO构型在无FDI条件下的被动容错能力，并开发计算高效的被动容错方案。

Method: 1) 扩展AWS内接球度量，引入瞬态力旋量跳跃项以量化故障过渡阶段的可行性；2) 方案一（控制层）：HOFA控制器+LESO进行集总扰动抑制；3) 方案二（分配层）：模型参考自适应控制分配+基于动量的力旋量估计补偿分配偏差。均无需故障检测或在线优化。

Result: 仿真与飞行实验验证了BTO在单/多转子故障下的稳定悬停与6-DOF轨迹跟踪；BTO比单轴倾斜和共面六旋翼具有更大恢复裕度；室内外复杂环境（风扰、极端条件、窄框穿越、接触书写）进一步验证了鲁棒性。

Conclusion: BTO构型结合所提被动容错框架可在无FDI条件下有效应对突发总转子故障，具有计算高效、鲁棒性强的优势，且BTO在故障后恢复能力上优于其他构型。

Abstract: Conventional multirotors suffer from a rapid collapse of attainable wrench space (AWS) under abrupt total rotor failures, rendering full 6-DOF recovery physically impossible. This paper addresses passive fault-tolerant flight of a biaxial-tilt overactuated hexacopter (BTO) under abrupt total rotor failures that are a priori unknown to the controller. The control design and analysis focus on representative abrupt rotor-failure cases for which the post-failure system remains fully actuated, while no explicit fault detection, isolation, or fault-mode switching is assumed. First, we extend the inscribed-sphere metric of the AWS by incorporating the transient-wrench-jump term, enabling quantitative feasibility assessment under up to three simultaneous rotor failures and benchmarking against uniaxial-tilt and coplanar hexacopters. Second, we develop two computationally efficient passive schemes without relying on fault detection or online optimization. One scheme operates at the controller layer by combining a high-order fully actuated (HOFA) controller with a linear extended state observer (LESO) for lumped-disturbance rejection. The other scheme operates at the allocator layer by using model-reference adaptive control allocation with momentum-based wrench estimation to compensate for control-allocation biases. Simulations and flight experiments validate stable hovering and 6-DOF trajectory tracking under single and multiple rotor failures. Further systematic comparisons confirm that the BTO provides larger recovery margins than uniaxial-tilt and coplanar designs. Additional onboard-sensor-only experiments, including indoor tracking under wind disturbance, outdoor tracking under extreme conditions, narrow-frame traversal, and contact-based aerial writing, further validate the robustness of the proposed framework in complex operational environments.

</details>


### [418] [Dynamic Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery in Robotic Cellular Warehousing Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05669)
*Cheng Ren,Ming Li,Xinping Guan,George Q. Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文首次针对机器人仓储系统中的动态订单演化问题，提出了两种基于令牌传递的事件触发在线重规划算法（动态令牌传递与协作令牌传递），显著降低了订单流转时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实仓储操作中，订单在执⾏过程中可能新增SKU，而传统MAPD假设任务静态，无法处理这种内部订单演化。本文首次将此问题形式化为动态多智能体拾取与配送问题。

Method: 基于令牌传递范式，提出两种事件触发的在线重规划算法：(1) 动态令牌传递——通过添加订单分解和优先级令牌调度实现局部重规划；(2) 协作令牌传递——允许空闲机器人机会主义地协助新添加的拾取任务。

Result: 在RCWS环境中的仿真结果表明，与静态和非协作基线相比，所提方法显著降低了订单流转时间。

Conclusion: 所提动态令牌传递和协作令牌传递算法能有效应对仓储系统中的动态订单演化，提升系统效率。

Abstract: Robotic Cellular Warehousing Systems (RCWS) give rise to multi-agent pickup and delivery (MAPD) processes in which robots sequentially collect multiple stock-keeping units (SKUs) for each order. Unlike classical MAPD formulations that assume static tasks, real warehouse operations often involve dynamic order evolution, where new SKUs may be appended to an order while it is being executed. Motivated by this practical requirement, this letter formulates the Dynamic Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery problem considering internal order evolution for the first time. Building on the token passing paradigm, we propose two event-triggered online replanning algorithms. The first, Dynamic Token Passing, performs localized replanning upon order updates through add-order decomposition and priority-based token scheduling while preserving collision-free execution. The second, Cooperative Token Passing, further enables idle robots to opportunistically assist newly added pickups, improving system-level efficiency. Simulation results in RCWS environments demonstrate that the proposed methods significantly reduce order flowtime compared with static and non-cooperative baselines.

</details>


### [419] [Accelerating and Scaling MPC-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Humanoid Locomotion and Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05687)
*Junheng Li,Liang Wu,Sergio A. Esteban,Lizhi Yang,Ján Drgoňa,Aaron D. Ames*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MPC-RL框架，通过并行化GPU求解器π^nMPC，在训练时将质心动力学MPC轨迹作为奖励信号引导强化学习，实现了高效的人形机器人 locomotion 和 manipulation 技能学习，并完成了硬件验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MPC+RL框架存在MPC问题构建耗时长、训练开销大等问题，难以在实际场景中合理应用。

Method: 提出质心动力学MPC奖励公式，利用MPC轨迹在训练时引导RL；开发π^nMPC求解器，实现并行化、免构建的批处理GPU MPC求解，直接处理时变动力学以避免高内存使用和预编译。

Result: 在多个对比实验和硬件验证中，MPC-RL在 locomotion 和 manipulation 任务上取得了优越性能。

Conclusion: MPC-RL框架能高效地将MPC指导融入RL训练，显著提升人形机器人的运动与操作技能。

Abstract: In humanoid motion control, model predictive control (MPC) offers physically grounded prediction and constraint handling, while reinforcement learning (RL) enables robust whole-body skills through large-scale simulation. However, using MPC inside RL often requires time-consuming problem construction or excessive training overhead, making such frameworks difficult to justify in practice. This work studies efficient training-time MPC guidance for humanoid locomotion and manipulation, termed MPC-RL. We introduce a centroidal-dynamics MPC reward formulation that leverages guidance from MPC trajectories in training time. To make this practical in massively parallel RL, we develop $π^n$MPC, a parallel-in-horizon and construction-free batched GPU MPC solver that operates directly on time-varying dynamics to avoid high memory usage and pre-compilation.
